papers.title: Food selectivity and grazing responses of the Lawnmower Blenny ( Salarias fasciatus ) to nutrient enrichment and ammonia exposure
papers.authors: Plazas‐Gómez, Ramón Alejandro; Bejarano, Sonia; Rodríguez‐Díaz, Sara Catalina; Fujitani, Marie
papers.abstract: Abstract Nutrient enrichment can alter the nutritional quality of the epilithic algal matrix (EAM) and modify the feeding environment of herbivorous and detritivorous reef fishes. However, wastewater inputs can also elevate ammonia concentrations, which may disrupt fish physiological processes, yet the effects of ammonia exposure on grazing activity and feeding selectivity remain poorly understood. In our nutrient enrichment experiment, the nutritional value of the EAM increased under higher nutrient levels, with enriched EAMs containing more lipids, carbohydrates and proteins. The Lawnmower Blenny ( Salarias fasciatus ) grazed more on these nutrient‐enriched tiles, suggesting that feeding preferences were associated with differences in EAM nutritional composition. Ammonia exposure of up to approximately 10 μM did not significantly affect grazing rates, food selectivity or diet composition over the short term. Instead, grazing rates increased over the experimental period after accounting for measured NH 3 concentration, suggesting behavioural acclimation to the experimental conditions and/or the offered food. These results indicate that, under short‐term and sub‐lethal exposure, feeding behaviour in S. fasciatus responded strongly to differences between nutrient‐enriched and low‐nutrient EAMs, while no detectable effect of ammonia on grazing rate was observed. This response may help explain why small benthic detritivorous fishes can persist under moderate nutrient disturbance. Further work is needed to determine whether these responses are maintained under longer exposure periods, higher ammonia concentrations and multi‐stressor conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 研究通过营养富集与氨暴露实验，探究了食草性礁鱼 Salarias fasciatus 对附石藻类基质（EAM）的摄食选择及放牧响应。营养富集提升了 EAM 的脂质、碳水化合物和蛋白质含量，该鱼对富营养化基质表现出更强的摄食偏好；而约 10 μM 的氨暴露在短期内未显著影响其放牧速率、食物选择性或食谱组成，放牧速率随实验进程反而上升，提示行为驯化。结果表明，在短期亚致死氨暴露下，S. fasciatus 的摄食行为主要受 EAM 营养质量差异驱动，而非氨浓度，这或可解释小型底栖碎食性鱼类在中度营养扰动下的存续能力。

papers.title: Market Systems Integration in Zambia's Aquaculture Sector: A Scoping Review of Value Chains, Supply Chains and Sustainability Challenges
papers.authors: Siankwilimba, Enock; Maulu, Sahya; Mphande, Joseph; Phiri, Msumenji; Shaba, Elvas G.; Ndhlovu, Ipaalo; Siavwapa, Sillah; Bwalya, Henry; Mbewe, Given; Shimbetu, Mweemba
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aquaculture is increasingly important to food security, nutrition, livelihoods and economic development in Zambia, yet sectoral growth depends on more than production capacity. This scoping review synthesised evidence on Zambia's aquaculture market systems, focusing on value chains, supply chains and persistent evidence gaps. Web of Science, Scopus and Google Scholar were searched alongside relevant grey literature for records published between 2000 and 2026. Of 652 records retrieved, 563 remained after removal of duplicates and clearly ineligible records, 152 full texts were assessed, and 107 sources were charted through the formal review process; 14 supplementary sources identified during manuscript revision were subsequently incorporated, giving 121 sources in the final synthesis. Evidence was synthesised across six value‐chain stages and four sustainability dimensions. The sector is increasingly dualistic, with rapid production growth alongside persistent structural constraints. Reported production increased from 21,567 t in 2017 to 52,922 t in 2022, whereas the share attributed to establishments captured in Zambia Statistics Agency surveys increased from 74% to 79%; Southern Province accounted for 73% of production in 2022. Administrative and survey estimates for the same year differed by 43%. Feed costs and weak cold‐chain infrastructure recurred across the value chain, alongside reported post‐harvest losses of 20%–30% and formal credit access of 12%–16%. Evidence on smallholder aquaculture was mixed: Some studies characterised it as unsustainable as a primary livelihood activity, whereas farm‐level analyses indicated that individual ponds could be financially viable, suggesting constraints beyond production itself. Major evidence gaps remain in cold‐chain and aggregation economics, gender‐disaggregated analysis, environmental performance, policy evaluation and household production dynamics. Future development requires stronger market‐system integration alongside production growth and targeted empirical and policy research.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了赞比亚水产养殖市场体系的证据，聚焦价值链、供应链及可持续性挑战，检索2000—2026年间121篇文献并按六个价值链阶段和四个可持续性维度进行综合分析。研究发现该行业呈二元化发展：产量从2017年的21,567吨增至2022年的52,922吨，但饲料成本高企、冷链基础设施薄弱、采后损失达20%–30%、正规信贷可得率仅12%–16%等结构性约束持续存在，且同一年的行政统计与调查估计相差43%。小农养殖的证据存在分歧，部分研究认为其作为主要生计不可持续，而农场层面分析显示单个池塘具有财务可行性，表明约束不仅来自生产环节。冷链与集散经济、性别分项分析、环境绩效、政策评估及家庭生产动态等方面仍存在重大证据缺口。

papers.title: The Optimism Ignited by Nature‐Based Solutions: Mobilizing Public Support and Policy Champions in a “First‐Ever” Oyster Reef Restoration Project
papers.authors: Drew, Georgina; Wawryk, Alexandra S.; McAfee, Dominic; Kenny, Ishtar; Connell, Sean D.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In recent years, a major push to restore oyster reefs has helped to revive the marine environments that were depleted in South Australia. Categorized as “Nature‐based Solutions” (NbS) that foster the return of biodiversity, these efforts have led to pockets of environmental optimism while countering an otherwise gloomy marine health forecast. By focusing on the personnel behind the push for oyster reef restoration, this discussion attends to the underappreciated “policy champion” roles that people undertook to attract the support of decision‐makers and the public in the pursuit of ecological repair. In telling this story while drawing upon work in emotional political ecology, we argue that it is essential to recognize the human emotions that promote and propel NbS as a viable approach. This work highlights the central role of human decision‐making in the facilitation of Nature‐based Solutions, thereby underscoring our capacity to support multispecies flourishing amidst biodiversity decline.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以南澳大利亚首次牡蛎礁修复项目为案例，探讨“政策倡导者”（policy champion）在动员公众支持和决策者参与NbS（Nature-based Solutions）中的关键作用。基于情感政治生态学视角，研究强调人类情感是推动NbS落地的重要动力，凸显了人类决策在促进多物种繁荣中的核心地位。

papers.title: Genomic characterization, stress tolerance and cardiac transcriptomic responses of a virulent Edwardsiella piscicida strain from farmed largemouth bass
papers.authors: Liu, Wenwen; Zhao, Feng; Wu, Wenchao; Mu, Cuimin; Yu, Lanping; Wang, Xuepeng
papers.abstract: Abstract Edwardsiella piscicida is an important intracellular pathogen in finfish aquaculture. During a mortality episode in farmed largemouth bass ( Micropterus salmoides ) in Foshan, South China, we isolated a virulent E. piscicida strain (B202203044) from diseased liver and characterized its pathogenicity, stress tolerance and genomic features. The strain was identified as E. piscicida based on biochemical profiling, species‐specific PCR and 16S rRNA sequencing, and caused typical Edwardsiellosis signs in experimentally infected bass. Intraperitoneal challenge caused dose‐dependent mortality, reaching 100%, 50% and 20% at 3 × 10 7 , 3 × 10 6 and 3 × 10 5 CFU/fish, respectively, and produced severe lesions in the liver, spleen and intestine. B202203044 displayed resistance to several commonly used antibiotics but remained susceptible to trimethoprim and cotrimoxazole. A genome assembly of strain B202203044 (3.85 Mb; 3395 predicted coding sequences) encoded 21 predicted two‐component‐system‐associated modules, complete type III and type VI secretion‐system gene clusters and 143 putative virulence‐associated genes. CAZy annotation identified 209 predicted glycosyltransferase‐associated genes, suggesting a substantial repertoire of functions related to glycoconjugate synthesis. Comparative genomics with four published E. piscicida genomes revealed high overall synteny but distinct sets of strain‐specific gene families. To explore host responses, we infected a largemouth bass cardiac cell line and performed RNA‐seq. Infection induced 4276 differentially expressed genes (2258 upregulated and 2018 downregulated; false discovery rate (FDR) <0.05), with enrichment of innate immune (mitogen‐activated protein kinase (MAPK), retinoic acid‐inducible gene I (RIG‐I)‐like, cytosolic DNA‐sensing, apoptosis/necroptosis, phagosome) and adhesion/cytoskeleton‐related pathways (extracellular matrix (ECM)–receptor interaction, focal adhesion). qPCR of eight representative genes confirmed RNA‐seq trends. Together, these data provide an integrated genomic and host transcriptomic characterization of a virulent E. piscicida strain from farmed largemouth bass.
papers.summary_cn: 从佛山养殖大口黑鲈（Micropterus salmoides）病死肝脏中分离到一株强致病性 Edwardsiella piscicida（B202203044），经生化鉴定、种特异性PCR和16S rRNA测序确认，腹腔攻毒呈剂量依赖性死亡（3×10⁷、3×10⁶、3×10⁵ CFU/尾分别达100%、50%、20%），并引起肝、脾、肠严重病变。该菌株对多种常用抗生素耐药，但对 trimethoprim 和 cotrimoxazole 敏感；基因组组装3.85 Mb、含3395个预测编码序列，携带完整的III型和VI型分泌系统基因簇及143个推定毒力相关基因。大口黑鲈心脏细胞系感染后RNA-seq显示4276个差异表达基因，富集于先天免疫（MAPK、RIG-I样、胞质DNA感知、凋亡/坏死性凋亡、吞噬体）及黏附/细胞骨架相关通路，为养殖大口黑鲈源强毒株提供了基因组与宿主转录组的整合性特征描述。

papers.title: <b>From Conservation to Commodification? A Comparative Analysis of Quota-Based Fisheries Governance in Indonesia, Iceland, and New Zealand </b><b></b>
papers.authors: Arafat, Yasser; Handayani, I Gusti Ayu Ketut Rachmi; Karjoko, Lego
papers.journal: Uti Possidetis: Journal of International Law
papers.abstract: Background: Quota-based fisheries management aims to reconcile stock conservation with efficient access, yet harvesting entitlements may evolve from public allocations into asset-like interests. International lawof the Sea provides conservation frameworks but does not mandate private rights or quota markets. MethodologyThis research employs a qualitative doctrinal-comparative design, combining doctrinal interpretation, content analysis, comparative matrices, and process tracing across UNCLOS 1982, UNFSA 1995, national legislation, policy documents, and literature. Objectives: This study examines how international obligations and domestic legal choices regulate the transformation of harvesting rights from conservation instruments into commodity-like economic interests in Indonesia, Iceland, and New Zealand, and identifies regulatory safeguards for Indonesia's Measured Fishing Policy. Findings: UNCLOS and UNFSA require science-based conservation, precaution, cooperation, monitoring, and adaptive adjustment, but do not mandate private ownership, transferability, or quota markets. Commodification develops cumulatively through domestic choices concerning exclusivity, security, duration, divisibility, leasing, transferability, capitalisation, and concentration. Iceland and New Zealand demonstrate stronger legal and market commodification while retaining formal public authority over catch limits. Indonesia remains closer to an administrative allocation model, although unequal access to capital, information, infrastructure, contracts, and bureaucratic capacity may generate functional commodification. The Conservation-Commodification Continuum framework shows that each country's position depends on the balance between rights strength, market intensity, access and rent distribution, and State corrective capacity. Originality/Novelty: This research develops the Conservation-Commodification Continuum as a multidimensional diagnostic framework integrating international law, property-rights analysis, common-pool resource governance, and Blue Justice. Its theoretical contribution connects international normative dimensions with domestic institutional choices and distributive effects. Its practical contribution formulates conditional, reviewable, transparent, and socially protective regulatory safeguards for Indonesia's Measured Fishing Policy.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于UNCLOS 1982与UNFSA 1995等国际法及国内立法，采用比较法律分析方法，考察印度尼西亚、冰岛和新西兰三国配额制渔业治理中捕捞权如何从养护工具演变为类商品化经济权益。研究发现，国际法仅要求科学养护与预防性管理，并未强制私有化或配额市场；商品化程度取决于排他性、可转让性、资本化等国内制度选择，冰岛和新西兰商品化程度较高，印尼仍接近行政分配模式，但资本与信息不对称可能导致功能性商品化。作者提出“养护—商品化连续体”框架，用于诊断权利强度、市场强度、租金分配与国家纠偏能力的平衡，并为印尼Measured Fishing Policy提出可审查、透明且具社会保护性的监管保障建议。

papers.title: Environmental DNA metabarcoding for identifying fish communities near established and developing mines in the Canadian Arctic
papers.authors: Johnson, Wesley; Gussakovsky, Daniel; Schultz, Sarah Kai-Leigh; Tomy, Gregg T.; Stetefeld, Jörg
papers.abstract: In Canada, resource development projects require biodiversity monitoring as part of their permitting and approval processes. The assessment of fish species in freshwater lakes near mines can be challenging due to limited accessibility to remote locations and low efficiency of conventional monitoring methods, in particular in the Canadian Arctic. The utility of environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding for detecting fish species has grown due to its high sensitivity, non-invasive sampling methods, and comprehensive data collection. Herein, we demonstrate the use of eDNA metabarcoding targeting the fish 12S rRNA gene in Arctic freshwater lakes adjacent to established and developing mining sites. We also report the novel detection of pygmy whitefish (Prosopium coulterii) in Nunavut, Canada, in multiple lakes across multiple sampling years. Overall, this study demonstrates the stability of fish communities near an established mining site and highlights the utility of eDNA metabarcoding for biodiversity monitoring in Arctic freshwater lakes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了 environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding 在加拿大北极矿区淡水湖泊鱼类多样性监测中的适用性，针对已开发与在建矿点周边湖泊，以 fish 12S rRNA 基因进行扩增子测序。结果显示已开发矿区附近鱼类群落保持稳定，并在 Nunavut 多个湖泊、多个采样年份中首次检出 pygmy whitefish (Prosopium coulterii)。研究表明 eDNA metabarcoding 是北极偏远淡水湖泊生物多样性监测的有效工具。

papers.title: Embryonic and larval development of the Pacific saury Cololabis saira : Distinctive characteristics of a rapidly growing beloniform fish
papers.authors: Kusakabe, Rie; Yamauchi, Shinya; Kuraku, Shigehiro
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Pacific saury Cololabis saira is one of the important food resources drawing attention for its recent rapid decline of catch. Their life cycle and embryonic development have been largely unknown. It is important to clarify how the habitat and reproduction of this species have been affected by the global changes of the aquatic environment. Results We obtained fertilized eggs of C. saira by spontaneous spawning and artificial fertilization and observed the embryonic development up to larval stages. Embryonic stages are documented with major periods of developmental events: cleavage, gastrulation (epiboly), and somitogenesis and organogenesis. Remarkably, segmentation of somites starts in the middle of epiboly, unlike other well‐documented teleost species such as zebrafish and medaka. Morphological changes in the larval stage up to feeding juvenile are also described. Growth speed of larval Pacific saury is dramatically rapid in comparison to closely related beloniform fish such as medaka. Conclusions In comparison to medaka, early embryogenesis of saury proceeds relatively slowly, but is followed by an earlier onset of somitogenesis, revealing a distinct developmental timetable. Despite reaching adult body length exceeding 20 cm in only half a year, the developmental basis of the remarkable growth of saury remains unclear. The developmental staging framework established here provides a foundation for future studies investigating the molecular mechanisms underlying saury development, as well as the effects of environmental factors, including ocean warming, on embryonic development and early life‐history traits.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在阐明太平洋秋刀鱼（Cololabis saira）的胚胎及仔鱼发育特征，以弥补其生活史早期阶段知识的不足。作者通过自然产卵和人工授精获取受精卵，系统观察并记录了从卵裂、原肠胚（epiboly）到体节发生和器官形成的胚胎发育过程及仔鱼阶段形态变化。结果显示，秋刀鱼体节分割始于epiboly中期，与其他硬骨鱼（如斑马鱼和青鳉）不同，且仔鱼生长速度远快于近缘beloniform鱼类。该发育分期框架为后续研究秋刀鱼发育分子机制及海洋变暖等环境因素对早期生活史的影响奠定了基础。

papers.title: Mercury in Fish from Guanabara Bay, Southeast Brazil: Tissue-Specific Accumulation and Human Health Risks
papers.authors: Toledo, Bruno Soares; da Silva Júnior, Fábio José Targino Moreira; Carneiro, Carla da Silva; Cipriano, Lévison da Costa; Pereira, Thaís Regina de Castro; Castro, Jane Silva Maia; Neto, Arthur Ayres; Mársico, Eliane Teixeira
papers.journal: Thalassas: An International Journal of Marine Sciences
papers.abstract: Abstract Guanabara Bay is Brazil’s second-largest bay and has a long history of intense industrial and domestic pollution. Some local communities rely on fish as a primary protein source, justifying an assessment of mercury (Hg) contamination. This study determined total mercury (THg) concentrations in nine fish species and evaluated the toxicological risks associated with human consumption. One hundred specimens were analyzed, and samples of muscle, liver, and gills were collected. THg analyses were performed using atomic absorption spectrometry following thermal decomposition, employing a DMA80 ® analyzer. The liver showed the highest mean THg concentrations, followed by muscle and gills, reflecting its role in metal biotransformation. Predatory species exhibited higher levels, particularly Centropomus parallelus and Alosa fallax . One A. fallax individual exceeded the maximum permissible limit established by the Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency (ANVISA) (1.0 mg·kg⁻¹). Correlation analysis showed a significant positive association between liver and gill THg concentrations (ρ = 0.531; p < 0.0001), suggesting shared physiological mechanisms in Hg accumulation. A weak negative correlation was observed between body weight and muscle THg concentrations (ρ = − 0.242; *p* = 0.0153), whereas no significant association was found with fish length. These results suggest that body size alone did not explain the variability in muscle THg concentrations. Dietary habits and other ecological and physiological factors can also influence this. Risk assessment based on fish consumption data from 126 residents showed HQ < 1 across all scenarios, indicating low risk. However, the occurrence of a specimen exceeding the legal limit demonstrates the need for continued Hg monitoring in Guanabara Bay.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究测定了巴西瓜纳巴拉湾9种鱼类100尾样本的肌肉、肝脏和鳃中总汞（THg）浓度，并基于126名居民的消费数据评估食用风险。肝脏THg均值最高，其次为肌肉和鳃；掠食性鱼类（如Centropomus parallelus和Alosa fallax）汞含量较高，其中1尾A. fallax超过ANVISA限值（1.0 mg·kg⁻¹）。肝与鳃THg显著正相关（ρ=0.531），体重与肌肉THg呈弱负相关，所有消费情景下HQ<1，但超标个体的出现表明需持续监测该湾汞污染。
