papers.title: Molecular Stress Biomarkers in Aquaculture: A Systematic Review
papers.authors: Sellés-Egea, Alba; Valcarce, David G.; Robles, Vanesa
papers.abstract: This systematic review of the literature aimed to explore the molecular biomarkers used for the detection of stress in the aquaculture sector over the last decade. Relevant studies were retrieved from the Web of Science, Scopus and PubMed databases, which were last searched on 13 June 2025. After screening according to predefined eligibility criteria and PRISMA 2020, 64 peer-reviewed original research articles published between 2015 and 2025 were included. The included studies were qualitatively synthesised. These studies evaluated molecular biomarkers of stress across 31 fish species, with Salmo salar being the most frequently studied, followed by Oncorhynchus mykiss. China, Spain and Canada contributed the largest numbers of included studies. In total, 20 different stressors were identified. Temperature was the most frequently investigated stressor, followed by stocking density, hypoxia and exposure to various chemicals. Publication activity has grown over the last decade, with a clear increase since 2020. This systematic review was conducted to integrate current knowledge and emerging evidence on molecular markers in teleost fish, aiming to provide a comprehensive understanding of both established biomarkers and novel molecular candidates identified through recent studies. Although considerable heterogeneity was observed among fish species, stress protocols and biomarker assessment methods, the evidence supports the growing value of integrated biomarker approaches for stress assessment in aquaculture. Overall, the evidence supports integrated, context-specific biomarker approaches that combine molecular endpoints with established physiological indicators to improve stress assessment in aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 该系统性综述旨在梳理近十年水产养殖中用于应激检测的分子生物标志物，检索Web of Science、Scopus和PubMed数据库，最终纳入2015—2025年间发表的64篇同行评审原创研究。研究涵盖31种鱼类，以Salmo salar和Oncorhynchus mykiss研究最多，识别出20种应激源，其中温度最为常见，其次为养殖密度、低氧和化学物质暴露。尽管物种、应激方案和标志物评估方法存在较大异质性，证据支持将分子终点与生理指标相结合的综合生物标志物方法用于水产养殖应激评估。

papers.title: The Menace of Microplastics and Their Physiological Implications in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Ranjan, Amit; Sriranjani, Kaliyaperumal; Uma, Arumugam; Thangarani, Albin Jemila; Kathiravan, Ravichandran
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of aquaculture has increased its reliance on plastic-based infrastructure and materials, creating opportunities for microplastic (MP) contamination from culture systems, surrounding waters, and formulated feeds. This review synthesises current evidence on MP sources, exposure pathways, biological fates, and toxicological effects in farmed fish, with emphasis on their interconnected implications for fish health and aquaculture performance. MPs enter aquaculture systems through degraded equipment, contaminated water, atmospheric deposition, and feed ingredients, including fishmeal derived from MP-exposed fish. Ingestion represents the principal exposure route, with particle size and shape, polymer composition and concentration, exposure duration, life stage, and species influencing retention, translocation, and biological responses. Although gastrointestinal accumulation is common, smaller particles may translocate to internal organs, while evidence for trophic transfer does not yet establish consistent biomagnification. Across studies, MP exposure is associated with intestinal and gill damage, altered digestive enzyme activity, impaired feeding and feed utilisation, metabolic disturbances, haematological and histopathological alterations, and reduced growth. Oxidative stress emerges as a central, but not exclusive, mechanistic pathway, linking reactive oxygen species imbalance and altered antioxidant defences with inflammation, immunotoxicity, neurotoxicity, behavioural alterations, and endocrine and reproductive disturbances. These responses are highly heterogeneous, reflecting differences in species, polymer type, particle characteristics, exposure concentration, duration, life stage, environmental conditions, and experimental design. Interactions between MPs and co-occurring contaminants may further modify their biological effects. Overall, the evidence indicates that MP exposure represents a multidimensional stressor capable of connecting environmental contamination with physiological dysfunction and impaired aquaculture performance. Understanding these interconnected responses is essential for strengthening MP risk assessment and supporting effective feed and farm management, fish health protection, food safety, and sustainable aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 水产养殖对塑料基设施和材料的依赖使其面临来自养殖系统、周边水体及配合饲料的微塑料（MP）污染风险。本文综述了养殖鱼类中MP的来源、暴露途径、生物归趋及毒理效应，指出摄入是主要暴露途径，受粒径、形状、聚合物类型、暴露时长、生活史阶段和物种等因素影响。MP暴露可导致肠道和鳃损伤、消化酶活性改变、摄食与饲料利用下降、代谢紊乱及生长受阻，氧化应激是核心但非唯一的机制通路，且效应高度异质。MP作为多维胁迫因子，将环境污染与生理功能障碍及养殖性能下降相关联，对MP风险评估、饲料与养殖管理及水产养殖可持续发展具有重要意义。

papers.title: Effects of aquaculture sludge and duckweed on redworm (Eisenia fetida) productivity, nutritional composition and feed safety
papers.authors: McDermott, Sean; Amaral, Diogo; Marshman, Phoebe; Harley, Matthew; Hilali, Soukaina; Stierlin, Emilie; Kearney, Paul; Peres, Helena; Ozorio, Rodrigo O. A.; Wan, Alex H. L.
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture is the fastest‑growing agricultural sector. However, improving this industry’s waste management is vital to ensure long-term sustainability. This study assessed the use of aquaculture sludge and duckweed ( Lemna sp. , grown in aquaculture wastewater) as a feed substrate for culturing redworms ( Eisenia fetida ). The study examined how the different substrate mixtures influenced redworm performance and nutrient utilisation. Five feed substrate treatments were tested: 100% sludge (100 S); 75:25 sludge: duckweed (75 S:25D); 50:50 sludge: duckweed (50 S:50D); 25:75 sludge: duckweed (25 S:75D); and 100% duckweed (100D). Each replicate received 10 g of feed substrate each week, and the trial ran for 72 days. The results showed that survival remained high in all groups, but growth and fecundity varied significantly. The 75 S:25D, 50 S:50D, and 25 S:75D mixtures led to the highest weight gain and specific growth rate, while the 50 S:50D and 25 S:75D mixtures showed the greatest reproductive output. The redworm protein content was highest when reared in 25 S:75D substrate, at 15.6% (wet weight), while lipid and ash contents were higher in the 100 S treatment. Calcium, magnesium, and sulphur levels in the redworm showed a linear decrease with increasing sludge replacement by duckweed, while calcium, magnesium, and sulphur contents were significantly higher in redworms reared on 100% sludge than in those reared on 100D. Analysis of the potentially toxic metals in the redworms showed that arsenic concentrations had exceeded the EU maximum level for undesirable substances in feed materials (2 mg/kg total As; Directive 2002/32/EC) in all treatments. Rearing redworms on aquaculture sludge combined with duckweed grown on wastewater shows promising results as a waste valorisation strategy. However, further optimisation, particularly to reduce the arsenic bioavailability and accumulation, is required to meet current regulatory compliance and commercial viability.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了水产养殖污泥与浮萍（Lemna sp.）不同配比作为赤子爱胜蚓（Eisenia fetida）养殖基质的可行性，考察其对蚯蚓生长、繁殖及营养成分的影响。结果表明，75:25至25:75的污泥:浮萍混合组生长和繁殖表现最佳，25:75组蚯蚓蛋白含量最高（15.6%湿重），但所有处理组砷含量均超过欧盟饲料原料限量标准（2 mg/kg）。该策略在养殖废弃物资源化利用方面具有潜力，但需进一步优化以降低砷的生物可利用性和积累。

papers.title: Mechanisms Driving Antimicrobial Resistance in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Stratev, Deyan
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is a rapidly growing industry, with worldwide production reaching new levels. Intensive aquaculture often leads to the occurrence of bacterial diseases, which cause large economic losses. Antibiotics are the first choice for the treatment of these diseases, but their frequency or improper use results in the development of antimicrobial resistance. The aim of this study was to present the mechanisms of antimicrobial resistance to the most widely used groups of antibiotics, such as quinolones, tetracyclines, and phenicols, for controlling bacterial diseases in fish. The selective pressure exerted by these pharmaceuticals drives the emergence of resistant bacterial strains and the horizontal transfer of genes encoding this resistance. The transmission of resistant pathogens from aquaculture to other animals and humans is well documented, which complicates the treatment of emerging bacterial diseases. Hence, the aquatic environment is a major reservoir of resistant bacteria, genes, and antimicrobials. Efforts should be made to stop the excessive and improper use of antibiotics in aquaculture and encourage farmers to use alternative means for the prevention and control of bacterial diseases. Several alternative strategies can be employed in aquaculture as substitutes for antibiotics, thereby mitigating the development of antimicrobial resistance. Among the most prominent alternative measures are vaccines, immunostimulants, and bacteriophage therapy. Encouraging the adoption of sustainable farming practices plays a critical role in fostering optimal conditions for aquaculture systems, thereby mitigating disease outbreaks and obviating the need for antibiotic treatments. Antimicrobial resistance is effectively mitigated through the implementation of a holistic One Health approach, which systematically curtails the emergence and dissemination of resistant bacteria while safeguarding human and animal health.
papers.summary_cn: 水产养殖中抗生素的频繁或不当使用导致antimicrobial resistance日益严重，本研究系统梳理了quinolones、tetracyclines和phenicols等常用抗生素在鱼类细菌性疾病防控中的耐药机制，包括选择性压力驱动的耐药菌株出现及耐药基因的水平转移。水产环境已成为耐药菌、耐药基因和抗菌药物的主要储存库，耐药病原体可传播至其他动物和人类。研究建议减少抗生素滥用，推广疫苗、immunostimulants和bacteriophage therapy等替代策略，并通过One Health框架综合遏制耐药性的产生与扩散。

papers.title: A Geometry-Aware Framework with Dynamic Edge Relation Modeling for Underwater Fish Perception and Non-Contact Body Size Estimation
papers.authors: Ding, Mu; Huang, Xiaohua; Li, Gen; Hu, Yu; Liu, Hangfei; Hu, Qingsong; Chen, Xinting
papers.abstract: Accurate underwater fish perception is a prerequisite for intelligent aquaculture, providing essential support for automated growth monitoring and precision feeding. Nevertheless, underwater imaging is severely affected by light scattering and cluttered backgrounds, making reliable fish perception and image-based non-contact fish size estimation particularly challenging. To overcome these limitations, this paper presents a geometry-aware underwater fish perception framework based on YOLOv5 for simultaneous object detection, pose estimation, and fish body size measurement. The proposed framework incorporates a Fish Geometry Coordinate Attention (FGCA) module into the backbone to enhance geometric feature representation by jointly modeling horizontal and vertical spatial dependencies, thereby improving the discrimination of elongated fish structures. In addition, a Dynamic Edge Relation Modeling (DERM) module is integrated into the neck to explicitly capture edge cues and structural relationships among key body regions, leading to more robust feature aggregation and more accurate key point localization under complex underwater conditions. Based on the predicted key points, the length and width of the fish can be estimated in a non-contact manner. Experimental results on a public underwater fish dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a Box mAP0.5 of 93.07% and a Pose mAP0.5 of 93.10%, consistently outperforming several representative YOLO-based detectors. Moreover, the proposed method maintains low body size estimation errors across different fish size categories. These results indicate that the proposed framework provides an accurate and practical solution for integrated underwater fish perception and image-based non-contact fish size estimation, offering significant potential for intelligent aquaculture and automated fish growth monitoring.
papers.summary_cn: 针对水下图像散射与背景杂乱导致鱼类感知和体尺估计困难的问题，提出基于YOLOv5的几何感知框架，同步实现目标检测、姿态估计与体尺测量。框架在backbone中引入Fish Geometry Coordinate Attention（FGCA）模块以增强细长鱼体结构的几何特征表达，并在neck中集成Dynamic Edge Relation Modeling（DERM）模块以捕捉关键身体区域的边缘线索与结构关系，提升复杂水下条件下的关键点定位精度。基于预测关键点实现非接触式体长与体宽估计，在公开水下鱼类数据集上取得Box mAP0.5为93.07%、Pose mAP0.5为93.10%，并在各体尺类别下保持较低估计误差，为智能水产养殖与自动化生长监测提供了实用方案。

papers.title: Evaluation and application of pectoral spine microchemistry to identify stocked Channel Catfish and infer fish size at stocking
papers.authors: Winstead, Morgan; Asher, Allison M; Whitledge, Gregory W
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Channel Catfish Ictalurus punctatus populations are commonly supported by stocking, and knowledge of stocked fish contribution is helpful to inform decisions regarding fish stocking locations, rates, and sizes. Calcified structure microchemistry can be useful for identifying stocked fish but has not been applied to distinguish fish stocked at different sizes. We compared pectoral spine microchemistry of Channel Catfish from hatchery and rearing facilities to four lakes in Arkansas to evaluate this technique for identifying stocked fish and estimated contributions of fish stocked as yearlings or at catchable size in three lakes. Methods Sectioned pectoral spines from Channel Catfish sampled from four lakes, one hatchery, and two rearing facilities were analyzed for strontium : calcium and barium : calcium along a transect from the spine core to the edge using laser ablation-inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry. Random forest models were used to assess classification accuracy of assigning individual fish to collection locations using pectoral spine edge strontium : calcium and barium : calcium. Lake-specific random forest models were applied to classify individual Channel Catfish sampled from each of the three primary study lakes as stocked or wild fish. For Channel Catfish identified as stocked individuals, the distance that the hatchery or rearing facility microchemical signature extended outward from the pectoral spine nucleus was used as an indicator of whether each individual was stocked as a yearling or catchable-size fish. Results Lake-specific random forest models generally yielded high accuracy (88–100%) for assigning individual Channel Catfish to their collection location using pectoral spine edge microchemistry data when lakes and hatchery or rearing facilities were in different ecoregions, although fish from two of the lakes were much more difficult to distinguish from hatchery residents (43–50% assignment accuracy). However, Channel Catfish from both of these lakes were distinguishable (88–100% accuracy) from rearing facility residents. All individuals sampled from rearing facilities showed expected changes in pectoral spine microchemistry reflective of transfer from the hatchery to the rearing facility. Estimated contributions of stocked fish ranged from 0% to 83% among lakes. Mean distances that hatchery signatures extended outward from the spine core were 549 ± 92 μm (mean ± SD) for yearlings and 1,242 ± 290 μm (mean ± SD) for catchable-size fish; 56–68% of stocked fish were identified as having been stocked at catchable size. Conclusions Pectoral spine microchemistry provides a nonlethal approach to identify stocked catfish and infer fish size at stocking when hatchery or rearing facilities and stocking locations are chemically distinct. Differences in estimated contributions of stocked Channel Catfish to study lakes may have been influenced by differences in stocking or harvest rates. We expect that the approach we used to infer fish size at stocking from microchemistry data will be applicable to other fish species and other types of calcified structures when different sizes of fish are stocked into a water body from the same hatchery sources.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了胸鳍棘微化学在识别放养斑点叉尾鮰（Channel Catfish）及推断放养规格中的应用。通过激光剥蚀电感耦合等离子体质谱（LA-ICP-MS）分析来自孵化场、培育设施和四个湖泊样本的胸鳍棘锶钙比（Sr:Ca）和钡钙比（Ba:Ca），并利用随机森林模型进行个体来源判别。结果表明，当水体与孵化场处于不同生态区时，判别准确率高达88–100%；孵化场标志从鳍棘核心向外延伸的距离可有效区分一龄鱼（549 ± 92 μm）和可捕捞规格鱼（1,242 ± 290 μm），56–68%的放养个体为可捕捞规格放养。该方法为非致死性识别放养鱼及推断放养规格提供了有效工具。

papers.title: Home Sweet Home? Habitat Occupancy of the Fuegian Sprat Sprattus fuegensis in a Sub‐Antarctic Marine Protected Area and Surrounding Environments
papers.authors: Diez, Mariano J.; Cabreira, Ariel G.; Cascallares, M. Guadalupe; Álvarez‐Colombo, Gustavo; Lovrich, Gustavo A.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The Fuegian sprat Sprattus fuegensis is an unexploited small pelagic fish that occupies a central position in sub‐Antarctic marine food webs of southern South America. Because of its role as a key forage species in wasp‐waist trophic systems, understanding the environmental drivers of its distribution and abundance is essential for ecosystem‐based management, conservation, and potential future fisheries. Here, we used acoustic surveys conducted between 2012 and 2019 to evaluate the spatial and temporal distribution of S. fuegensis schools and to identify the environmental characteristics associated with their habitat across years. Our results show that relative abundance, school morphology, and vertical distribution differed between the Namuncurá–Burdwood Bank Marine Protected Area and adjacent waters. Coastal waters of the Beagle Channel and the Atlantic Shelf of Tierra del Fuego showed the highest relative abundance, whereas the Burdwood Bank showed lower mean abundance but larger and deeper schools. Fuegian sprat abundance responded differently to the environmental variables analyzed, with chlorophyll a concentration and sea surface temperature emerging as the main drivers. Environmental clustering identified four habitat domains, indicating that S. fuegensis uses a spatially structured habitat mosaic in the southern southwestern Atlantic Ocean. Within this mosaic, the Burdwood Bank appears to function as a persistent oceanic habitat and potential regional connectivity hub. These findings provide an acoustic baseline for long‐term monitoring, climate‐sensitivity assessment, and future management of a key forage species in highly vulnerable sub‐Antarctic ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 基于2012—2019年声学调查，研究了亚南极海洋保护区（Namuncurá–Burdwood Bank MPA）及邻近水域Fuegian sprat（Sprattus fuegensis）的空间与时间分布及其环境驱动因子。结果显示，Beagle Channel沿岸和Tierra del Fuego大西洋陆架的相对丰度最高，而Burdwood Bank平均丰度较低但鱼群更大、分布更深；叶绿素a浓度和海表温度是主要驱动因子。环境聚类识别出四个栖息地类型，表明该种利用空间结构化的栖息地镶嵌，Burdwood Bank可能作为持久的海洋栖息地和区域连通枢纽。

papers.title: An assessment of oyster dredge and patent tong sampling across varying reef structure
papers.authors: Wheat-Walsh, Margaret; Olsen, Zachary; Pollack, Jennifer Beseres; Pettis, Evan; Harris, Jake
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective The Texas Parks and Wildlife Department currently uses dredge sampling to monitor eastern oyster Crassostrea virginica reefs. However, dredges have been shown to produce biased sampling data with regard to the density and relative sizes of the oysters collected. The objective of this study was to compare the sampling performance of oyster dredges in reference to hydraulic patent oyster tongs. Methods Six reefs within the Mission-Aransas Estuary were sampled during this study. At each site, the density (n/m2) and size (shell height; mm) estimate of several oyster reef components (live oysters, articulated shells of dead oysters [boxes], and brown and black disarticulated oyster shells) were enumerated. In conjunction with the tong and dredge samples, each sample area was assessed with acoustic mapping procedures to better determine the reef structure and landscape. Results Results indicate that dredges show a size bias toward larger reef components. In addition, the comparability of dredge and tong density estimates varies with the landscape-scale patchiness of reef. Reef components with higher densities and more consistent distribution show greater disparity between dredge and tong density estimates (specifically, greater tong density estimates). This study also provides a practical assessment of sample size variation among dredge and tong sampling gears, which highlights the impact of sample size on dredge and tong density estimates. Conclusions This is the first tong and dredge comparison in Texas estuaries consisting of a range of reef types and oyster densities. In addition, the study pairs this gear comparison with acoustic surveys to characterize the study sites. Overall, this study provides information on the variation in performance of dredge and tong sampling, which will help fisheries managers understand the complexities of oyster sampling biases across these two sampling gears and choose the most appropriate sampling gear given the purpose and nature of the monitoring and management scenario.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了牡蛎 dredge 与液压 patent tong 两种采样工具在 Texas 河口不同 reef 结构下的采样性能，并结合声学 mapping 评估 reef 景观特征。结果显示，dredge 对大个体 reef 组分存在尺寸偏差，且两种工具的密度估计可比性随 reef 斑块化程度而变化——密度高且分布均匀的组分中，tong 的密度估计显著高于 dredge。该研究首次在 Texas 河口涵盖多种 reef 类型和牡蛎密度条件下开展 tong 与 dredge 对比，为渔业管理者理解采样偏差并选择合适工具提供了依据。

papers.authors: Lyons, Kady; Litvin, Steven Y.; Carlisle, Aaron B.
papers.abstract: Abstract Two opportunistic sampling events were used to analyse the isotopic composition of different tissue constituents (protein and lipid) to explore maternal investment routing pathways from pregnant Common Thresher Sharks ( Alopias vulpinus ) to their near‐term embryos. Protein stable isotope signatures from embryo liver and muscle were more similar to maternal muscle than maternal liver, while lipid constituents in embryo muscle and liver were similar to those of maternal liver. Though sample size was limited, hypotheses are proposed regarding how mothers route nutrients to their embryos and the implications for maternal transfer of contaminants.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过两次机会性采样，分析怀孕Common Thresher Shark（*Alopias vulpinus*）母体与近足月胚胎不同组织成分（蛋白质和脂质）的稳定同位素组成，探讨母体向胚胎的营养传递路径。结果显示，胚胎肝脏和肌肉的蛋白质同位素特征更接近母体肌肉而非母体肝脏，而胚胎肌肉和肝脏的脂质成分则与母体肝脏相似。尽管样本量有限，作者据此提出母体营养向胚胎传递路径的假说，并讨论了其对母体污染物转移的潜在意义。

papers.title: Development of a polyclonal antibody-based sandwich ELISpot assay for interleukin-4/13B1 in rainbow trout Oncorhynchus mykiss
papers.authors: Nagai, Ryo; Rosales, Patricia Díaz; Tafalla, Carolina; Guruge, Aika Tharindie; Matsumoto, Megumi; Sano, Motohiko; Kato, Goshi
papers.abstract: Abstract In mammals, interleukin-4 (IL-4) and IL-13 are important Th2 cytokines that enhance antibody production by B cells and proliferation of Th2 cells. Salmonid fish have three homologs to both of these cytokines as a result of four rounds of whole genome duplication events, designated as IL-4/13A , IL-4/13B1 , and IL-4/13B2 . In this study, we aimed to develop a sandwich ELISpot assay for the evaluation of Th2 immune responses in rainbow trout Oncorhynchus mykiss after immersion vaccination. We first performed gene expression analyses of the three homologs after immersion vaccination with inactivated Yersinia ruckeri . IL-4/13B1 increased significantly its levels of transcription in the gills at 7 days postvaccination. Thus, we obtained two polyclonal antibodies (pAbs) in rabbit (detection antibody) and guinea pig (capture antibody) against rainbow trout IL-4/13B1 and used them for a sandwich-ELISpot assay. The ELISpot assay clearly detected IL-4/13B1 production and revealed a significant increase in the number of IL-4/13B1-producing cells in the gills at 7 days postimmersion vaccination compared with the nonvaccinated group. This new tool has allowed us to evaluate a Th2 response mediated by IL-4/13B1 in rainbow trout, and revealed that IL-4/13B1-producing cells increased mainly in the gills after immersion vaccination.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在开发检测虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）IL-4/13B1的夹心ELISpot方法，以评估浸浴疫苗接种后的Th2免疫应答。研究先对灭活Yersinia ruckeri浸浴疫苗免疫后三种IL-4/13同源基因进行表达分析，发现IL-4/13B1在免疫后7天鳃中转录水平显著升高；随后制备兔源检测抗体和豚鼠源捕获抗体，建立夹心ELISpot。该方法可清晰检测IL-4/13B1产生，并揭示免疫后7天鳃中IL-4/13B1阳性细胞数较未免疫组显著增加，表明浸浴疫苗主要诱导鳃部IL-4/13B1介导的Th2应答。

papers.title: Responsible AI Guardrails in Aquaculture, Fish and Fisheries : Enabling Innovation With Accountability and Integrity
papers.authors: Calado, Ricardo; A. Becker, Joy; Bailey, Christyn
papers.summary_cn: 该文探讨在水产养殖与渔业领域应用负责任AI的防护机制，旨在在创新与问责、诚信之间取得平衡。因无摘要，仅据标题可知其聚焦于AI治理框架的构建。

papers.title: Zander Sander lucioperca (Percidae) population state in Vazuza reservoir at present: stock assessment and potential catch volume
papers.authors: Grebonos, M. O.; Chirkova, P. N.; Vinogradov, E. V.
papers.abstract: The paper presents the main fishery characteristics of the pike-perch population in the Vazuza Reservoir, obtained during the 2025 research within the state assignment of the Russian Federal Research Institute of Fisheries and Oceanography (VNIRO). The age structure of the commercial part of the population, as well as the dynamics of linear and weight growth of fish, were evaluated. Differences in the growth rates of males and females, determined by the biological characteristics of the species and energy expenditures for primary oogenesis, were noted. It was established that the basis of the catches consists of individuals aged 2+ to 8+ years, with the dominance of two modal groups aged 4+ and 5+. The volume of possible removal was calculated taking into account a comprehensive approach to stock exploitation and amounted to 27,68 tons.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究基于2025年VNIRO在Vazuza水库的调查数据，评估了梭鲈（Sander lucioperca）种群的渔业生物学特征及可捕量。研究分析了商业种群年龄结构及线性与体重生长动态，发现雌雄生长速率存在差异，渔获以2+至8+龄个体为主，其中4+和5+龄为优势组群。综合种群开发评估，建议可捕量为27.68吨。

papers.title: Geometric Morphometric Analysis of Phenotypic Population Structure in Hatchery and Wild Stocks of Ompok pabda From Bangladesh
papers.authors: Roy, Krishna; Ara, Dewan Noor‐E‐Chashmi; Roy, Priangka; Preety, Afra Anjum; Leon, Ashikur Rahman; Parvez, Imran
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Population structure is important for broodstock management and conservation of Ompok pabda . This study evaluated phenotypic shape variation among three hatchery populations from Bogura (Kahalu), Dinajpur (Sadar) and Mymensingh (Muktagacha) and one wild population from Arial Beel , Munshiganj, using 15 landmark geometric morphometrics. After data‐quality screening and generalised Procrustes analysis, a small but significant common within‐group allometric effect explained 2.28% of shape variation (permutation p = 0.0413) and was removed before multivariate analysis. Principal component analysis of allometry‐adjusted Procrustes coordinates showed that PC1 and PC2 explained 48.08% and 18.19% of the variation, respectively (66.27% cumulative). MANOVA detected a strong population effect on shape (Wilks' λ = 0.0393, F (33, 257.02) = 15.57, p < 0.001). Canonical variate analysis showed that CV1 and CV2 accounted for 65.19% and 22.18% of the canonical discriminatory variation, respectively. Discriminant function analysis using 11 PCs that retained 95.27% of allometry‐adjusted Procrustes shape variance achieved 87.13% overall leave‐one‐out cross‐validated classification accuracy with equal prior probabilities. All pairwise Mahalanobis and Procrustes distances were significant, while UPGMA based on complete mean‐shape Procrustes distances grouped Bogura most closely with Arial Beel and identified Mymensingh as the most distant population. Thin‐plate spline visualisations localised major variation around the head and ventral pelvic‐anal region. The results demonstrate significant phenotypic structuring, but the unbalanced wild sample and absence of molecular data require caution when inferring genetic stock boundaries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用15个地标点的几何形态测量学方法，评估了孟加拉国三个孵化场种群（Bogura、Dinajpur、Mymensingh）与一个野生种群（Arial Beel）Ompok pabda之间的表型形态差异。MANOVA显示种群对形态有显著影响（Wilks' λ=0.0393, p<0.001），判别函数分析交叉验证分类准确率达87.13%，所有种群间Mahalanobis和Procrustes距离均显著。UPGMA聚类显示Bogura与野生Arial Beel种群最为接近，Mymensingh种群最为疏远，形态变异主要集中在头部及腹侧骨盆-臀鳍区域。研究表明存在显著的表型种群结构，但野生样本不平衡及缺乏分子数据，在推断遗传种群边界时需谨慎。

papers.title: Elucidating the source and metabolic impact of 2‐phenylethanol on Lactiplantibacillus pentosus 1 using a fish broth fermentation model
papers.authors: Gao, Pei; Dou, Yumeng; Jiang, Qixing; Zhang, Xiaojing; Yu, Peipei; Yang, Fang; Liu, Shaoquan; Xia, Wenshui
papers.journal: Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture
papers.abstract: Abstract BACKGROUND The quality of traditional fermented sour fish is shaped by metabolic interactions between core microbiota dominated by lactic acid bacteria (LAB) and yeasts. 2‐Phenylethanol (2‐PE) is a characteristic metabolite and quorum‐sensing molecule of Saccharomyces cerevisiae . This study aims to identify the primary source of 2‐PE via pure culture of dominant strains, and preliminarily investigate its effects on LAB in a fish broth fermentation model under different fermentation modes. RESULTS Single‐strain fermentation experiments confirmed that Saccharomyces cerevisiae 31 is the main producer of 2‐PE. Comparative analysis of different fermentation modes revealed that yeast metabolites exerted a stronger influence than cell‐to‐cell contact. Although not a dominant factor, 8 mg/L 2‐PE significantly inhibited the growth, glucose metabolism, and lactic acid accumulation of Lactiplantibacillus pentosus 1. Correlation analysis showed that 2‐PE had significant positive correlations with the formation of multiple alcohols, glucose consumption, pH, total acidity, lactic acid, and valine. It is speculated that 2‐PE may regulate fermentation performance by interfering with the glycolytic pathway, fatty acid metabolism, and valine metabolism in LAB. CONCLUSION This study clarifies the primary microbial source of 2‐PE in sour fish fermentation and verifies its specific regulatory effect on LAB, though it is not the core effector molecule through which Saccharomyces cerevisiae modulates LAB metabolism. The findings provide new insights into metabolite‐mediated microbial interactions in fermented food ecosystems, and the elucidated regulatory patterns offer reference for studies on other fermentation substrates including plant‐based foods and beverages. © 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以鱼汤发酵模型探究酸鱼发酵体系中2-苯乙醇（2-PE）的主要来源及其对乳酸菌的代谢影响。单菌发酵实验证实 Saccharomyces cerevisiae 31 是2-PE的主要产生菌，且酵母代谢产物的影响强于细胞间直接接触。8 mg/L 2-PE虽非核心调控因子，但显著抑制 Lactiplantibacillus pentosus 1 的生长、葡萄糖代谢及乳酸积累，推测其通过干扰糖酵解、脂肪酸代谢和缬氨酸代谢途径调控发酵性能。

papers.title: Growth patterns and size-weight characteristics of fish in the Upper Dnieper river
papers.authors: Nikitenko, A. I.; Artemenkov, D. V.; Goryachev, D. V.; Smirnov, A. A.; Stroganov, A. N.; Zingis, I. V.; Zhernakov, I. A.; Solodovnik, A. V.; Grebonos, M. O.; Tuylin, D. Yu.
papers.abstract: This paper presents new data on size–weight characteristics and growth parameters for 12 common fish species inhabiting the transboundary section of the Upper Dnieper River (within the Russian Federation and the Republic of Belarus), including representatives of the families Leuciscidae, Percidae, and Esocidae. The material was collected during joint Russian–Belarusian expeditions in 2018–2024. It is shown that the majority of the studied species (8 out of 12) exhibit isometric growth, in which relative body proportions do not change with increasing size. Negative allometry, indicating a relative decrease in body depth in larger individuals, was found in bream Abramis brama, white bream Ballerus ballerus, and black bream Ballerus sapa. For the first time in the region, the parameters of the von Bertalanffy growth equation were calculated for seven species. The highest growth rates (coefficient K > 0,4 year -1 ) were established for silver bream Blicca bjoerkna, roach Rutilus rutilus, and pikeperch Sander lucioperca, which corresponds to their life strategy of early maturation and high reproductive capacity. Slow growth, typical of riverine populations with long life cycles, was observed for bream (K = 0,199 year -1 ) and chub Squalius cephalus (K = 0,254 year -1 ). The obtained length–weight relationships and growth parameters can serve as regional reference values for monitoring population status, stock assessment, and improving fisheries management measures in the Upper Dnieper River basin.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2018–2024年俄白联合科考数据，报道了上第聂伯河跨界河段12种常见鱼类（鲤科、鲈科、狗鱼科）的体长-体重关系与生长参数。结果显示，8种鱼类呈等速生长，鳊、白鳊和黑鳊表现为负异速生长；首次为该区域7种鱼类计算了von Bertalanffy生长方程参数，其中银鳊、拟鲤和梭鲈生长系数最高（K>0.4 yr⁻¹），鳊（K=0.199 yr⁻¹）和圆鳍雅罗鱼（K=0.254 yr⁻¹）生长缓慢。所得体长-体重关系与生长参数可作为区域参考值，用于种群监测、stock assessment及上第聂伯河流域渔业管理。

papers.title: Assessment of Human Exposure Risk From Microplastic Contamination in Commercially Important Fish Species Sold in Local Markets of Mawlamyine, Myanmar
papers.authors: Aung, Thet Htwe; Tun, Soe Thaw Thaw; Latt, Aung Aye; Tun, Nyo Nyo
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Microplastic (MP) contamination was investigated in the gastrointestinal tract (GIT) and gills of 238 fish representing eight commercially important species collected from retail markets in Mawlamyine, Myanmar. MPs were detected in the GIT and/or gills of all examined fish, corresponding to a prevalence of 100%. Mean total abundance ranged from 5.44 ± 1.23 particles fish −1 in Rastrelliger sp. to 18.91 ± 2.74 particles fish −1 in Tenualosa ilisha , while mass‐normalized concentration ranged from 0.0464 to 0.2977 particles g − 1 . Paired gut–gill comparisons were evaluated using a Shapiro–Wilk‐dependent approach: Wilcoxon signed‐rank tests were applied to six species with non‐normal paired differences, and paired‐samples t ‐tests were applied to Polynemus paradiseus and T. ilisha , whose paired differences were compatible with normality. All eight tissue comparisons were significant at p < 0.001. Gut abundance exceeded gill abundance in six species, whereas Rastrelliger sp. and T. ilisha exhibited gill‐dominant burdens. Fibres were the dominant morphotype in six species, while paint‐like particles were prominent in Rastrelliger sp. and T. ilisha . Particles measuring 20–50 µm represented a substantial proportion of the recovered particles. ATR–FTIR analysis assigned 238 of 270 analysed particles (88.1%) to polyethylene terephthalate, polyethylene, polypropylene, polystyrene or polyamide/nylon. Under a hypothetical sole‐species consumption scenario based on a fish intake rate of 123 g person − 1 day − 1 , estimated daily intake ranged from 5.71 to 36.62 particles person − 1 day − 1 , and body‐weight‐normalized intake ranged from 0.0990 to 0.6347 particles kg − 1 day − 1 . The Exposure Risk Index ranged from 1.00 to 6.41 and was used only as a relative within‐study ranking; it is not a validated toxicological, regulatory or human‐health threshold.
papers.summary_cn: 对缅甸毛淡棉零售市场8种商业重要鱼类（238尾）的胃肠道和鳃部微塑料（MP）污染进行了调查，所有样本检出率均为100%，平均丰度为5.44–18.91 particles fish⁻¹。6种鱼胃肠道丰度高于鳃部，纤维为主要形态，20–50 µm颗粒占比较大，ATR–FTIR鉴定88.1%的颗粒为PET、PE、PP、PS或PA/尼龙。在假设单一鱼种消费情景下（123 g person⁻¹ day⁻¹），估计每日摄入量为5.71–36.62 particles person⁻¹ day⁻¹，暴露风险指数为1.00–6.41，仅用于研究内相对排序，非经验证的健康阈值。

papers.authors: Leeuwen, Travis E. Van; Coté, David; Konecny, Cassandra; Swanson, Andrew; Bungay, Julia; Pretty, Christina; Fast, Mark D.; Miller, Jordan; Kristiansen, Trond
papers.abstract: Abstract Predicting and understanding the implications of climate change on Atlantic salmon ( Salmo salar ) aquaculture is a fundamental step to understanding risk and mitigating potential impacts. Here, we statistically downscale established climate models using satellite‐based sea surface temperature data and in situ industry measurements to inform climate resiliency predictions for Atlantic salmon aquaculture on the south coast of Newfoundland, Canada. Our objectives were to (1) understand how local climate conditions and depth effects vary in the coastal marine environments that support farmed Atlantic salmon production; (2) apply these relationships to understand how seasonal chronology and forecasted interannual changes to water temperature will affect future farmed Atlantic salmon growth and sea lice ( Lepeophtheirus salmonis ) exposure; and (3) identify the seasonal mortality risk to farmed Atlantic salmon smolt under multiple climate change and sea lice scenarios. While the absolute growth of farmed Atlantic salmon was determined to be minimally affected, the chronology of growth changed with optimal growth periods predicted at deeper sea cage depths (10 and 15 m), and shifted from unimodal growth distributions throughout the summer to scenarios with two distinct growth peaks bookending a low summer growth period for 1 and 5 m depths as the time series progressed. Warm summer temperatures also increased the projected abundance of sea lice and decreased farmed Atlantic salmon smolt survival. Our results identify both resilience and vulnerabilities in Newfoundland Atlantic salmon aquaculture sites and highlight the risk to industry and an opportunity to mitigate vulnerabilities prior to their predicted onset.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用卫星海表温度数据与养殖场实测记录对气候模型进行统计降尺度，预测气候变化对加拿大纽芬兰南岸大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）养殖的影响。研究分析了局部气候条件与养殖深度对水温的影响，并评估了不同气候变化和海虱（Lepeophtheirus salmonis）情景下养殖鲑的生长与死亡率风险。结果表明，养殖鲑绝对生长量受影响较小，但生长时序发生改变——深层网箱（10和15 m）预测出现最优生长窗口，浅层（1和5 m）则从夏季单峰生长转变为双峰模式；夏季升温还增加了海虱丰度并降低幼鲑存活率。

papers.title: Optimizing Culture Density to Balance Seston Transport and Mussel Growth in Gouqi Island Suspended Aquaculture
papers.authors: Cao, Bofan; Zhong, Wei; Li, Yanjiao; Lin, Jun
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: Intensive high-density suspended mussel aquaculture frequently experiences flow attenuation and limited hydrodynamic exchange, leading to severe internal food depletion. To address this issue, this study evaluates spatial density-optimization strategies to balance stocking scale and production performance in the Gouqi Island suspended aquaculture farm for the mussel Mytilus coruscus Gould, 1861. A three-dimensional hydrodynamic-tracer-bivalve growth model was developed within the SCHISM framework. This approach established a dynamic two-way coupling between tracer transport and bivalve growth, capturing feedbacks among hydrodynamic transport, facility-induced obstruction, and biological depletion. Field observations along the surveyed transects showed that chlorophyll-a concentrations within the aquaculture layer were 64.9–85.5% of those in adjacent non-aquaculture waters. Scenario simulations revealed that while uniform density reduction improved internal food availability, it substantially reduced the total stocking scale. In contrast, a spatially heterogeneous density configuration provided a more favorable balance between food availability, growth, and stocking scale among the tested scenarios. At a total stocking scale of 2.34 million sleeves, the area with tracer concentrations below 0.65 during neap tides was reduced to 620.06 ha, representing a 25.33% reduction relative to the current scenario. Additionally, an area of 174.41 ha achieved a relative individual growth increment exceeding 0.20. Ultimately, aligning culture density with local hydrodynamic transport conditions can alleviate internal food limitation while maintaining a relatively high stocking scale.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对枸杞岛厚壳贻贝（*Mytilus coruscus*）高密度筏式养殖中水流衰减与内部饵料耗竭问题，基于SCHISM框架构建三维水动力-示踪剂-双壳类生长双向耦合模型，评估空间密度优化策略。现场观测显示养殖层叶绿素a浓度仅为邻近非养殖水域的64.9–85.5%。模拟结果表明，均匀降低密度虽改善内部饵料供给但大幅缩减总养殖规模，而空间异质性密度配置在饵料可利用性、个体生长与养殖规模间实现更优平衡：总规模234万串时，小潮期示踪剂浓度低于0.65的区域缩减至620.06 ha（较现状减少25.33%），174.41 ha区域个体相对生长增量超过0.20。将养殖密度与局部水动力输运条件相匹配，可在维持较高养殖规模的同时缓解内部饵料限制。

papers.title: Towards Season‐Specific Feeds: Maximising Protein Digestibility and Reducing Waste in Hybrid Abalone ( Haliotis rubra × Haliotis laevigata) Aquaculture
papers.authors: Hassan, Abdul Lathiff Inamul; Mock, Thomas S.; Searle, Kieren; Rocker, Melissa M.; Turchini, Giovanni M.; Francis, David S.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Australian abalone grow‐out aquaculture relies on formulated feeds to provide for the nutritional requirements of the animal. At the same time, grow‐out systems are subject to seasonal water temperature fluctuations. As such, the economic and environmental performance of cultured abalone is inherently tied to the utilisation efficiency of dietary nutrients and changes to water temperature. This study aimed to better understand the effect of water temperature and dietary protein level on nutrient digestibility in Australian hybrid abalone ( Haliotis rubra × Haliotis laevigata ). Hybrid abalone were fed five different levels of dietary protein for 150 days at three distinct water temperatures. Digestibility, nutrient utilisation and calculations of nitrogen assimilation efficiency and undigested nitrogenous waste were assessed. Protein digestibility was negatively affected during both warm (22°C) and cold (12°C) water growing conditions and appeared optimal at 17°C, whereas lipid digestibility increased as the water temperature increased from 12°C to 22°C. An increase in the dietary protein level up to 440 g kg −1 at both 17°C and 22°C improved macronutrient and amino acid digestibility, compared to diets formulated with lower dietary protein. Relationships between water temperature and diet protein level were plotted on response surfaces and showed that maximum protein digestibility occurs at 16.8°C and 46.3% diet protein, whereas maximum dry matter digestibility occurs at 18.9°C and 43.1% diet protein. Taken together, these findings can significantly contribute towards developing season‐specific feeds for Australian hybrid abalone to maximise growth performance while minimising effluent discharge.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探讨水温与饲料蛋白水平对澳大利亚杂交鲍（Haliotis rubra × Haliotis laevigata）营养物消化率的影响，在12°C、17°C和22°C三种水温下以五个蛋白水平饲料投喂150天。结果表明，蛋白消化率在17°C时最优，在22°C和12°C下均受抑制，而脂肪消化率随水温升高而增加；饲料蛋白水平提高至440 g kg⁻¹可改善大量营养素和氨基酸消化率。响应面分析显示，最大蛋白消化率出现在16.8°C、饲料蛋白46.3%时，最大干物质消化率出现在18.9°C、饲料蛋白43.1%时，为开发季节特异性饲料以减少养殖排放提供了依据。

papers.title: Evaluating the Processing and Nutrient Digestibility of Defatted Nannochloropsis sp. QH25 Co-Product for Sustainable Rainbow Trout Aquaculture Diets
papers.authors: Sarker, Pallab K.; Schoffstall, Benjamin V.; Kapuscinski, Anne R.; Fitzgerald, Devin; Datta, Anindita; Gwynne, Duncan; Greenwood, Connor
papers.abstract: The sustainability limitations of fishmeal and fish oil have increased interest in nutrient- rich microalgal co-products for aquafeeds. This study evaluated the effects of processing on the nutritional composition and apparent digestibility of a defatted Nannochloropsis sp. QH25 co-product in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss). Experiment 1 assessed the effects of extrusion at 90 °C or 127 °C, with or without precooking, and enzymatic treatment with protease, xylanase, and β-glucanase. Based on nutrient composition, the 90 °C extrusion treatment without precooking was selected for Experiment 2, which compared a reference diet with three diets containing 30% raw, extruded, or enzyme-treated co-product, using four replicate tanks per diet. Extrusion at 127 °C reduced crude protein, gross energy, and methionine concentrations, whereas extrusion at 90 °C largely preserved nutrient composition. Precooking reduced several essential amino acids but increased methionine and did not affect tryptophan. Crude protein digestibility was numerically higher in the extruded co-product than in the raw co-product, although the difference was not statistically significant. Most essential amino acids showed similar digestibility in the raw and extruded treatments, whereas enzymatic processing resulted in lower crude protein and amino acid digestibility. Omega-3 fatty acid digestibility remained high across diets. Overall, the raw co-product showed high nutrient digestibility, while extrusion resulted in only small, generally non-significant numerical differences and enzymatic processing generally resulted in lower nutrient digestibility under the conditions evaluated.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了加工方式对脱脂微藻（Nannochloropsis sp. QH25）副产物在虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）中营养成分及表观消化率的影响。实验一比较了90 °C与127 °C挤压、预煮及酶处理（蛋白酶、木聚糖酶、β-葡聚糖酶）的效果，发现127 °C挤压降低粗蛋白、总能和蛋氨酸含量，而90 °C挤压基本保持养分组成。实验二以30%未处理、挤压或酶处理副产物替代参考饲料，结果显示未处理副产物养分消化率较高，挤压处理差异较小且多不显著，酶处理则普遍降低粗蛋白和氨基酸消化率，而omega-3脂肪酸消化率在各组中均保持较高水平。

papers.title: Development of a Multiplex Quantitative PCR Assay for Simultaneous Detection of Multiple Vibrio Species in Aquaculture Samples
papers.authors: Müştak, İnci Başak; Müştak, Hamit Kaan; İnce, Seyyide Sarıçam; Uğun, Doğukan; Cengiz, Görkem; Ünal, Gültekin; Torun, Ebru; Göncüoğlu, Muammer
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Aquaculture associated Vibrio species are important bacterial pathogens causing significant economic losses in aquaculture and zoonotic infections in humans. Rapid and accurate detection of Vibrio species is therefore essential for diagnosis, surveillance and control. In this study, a multiplex quantitative PCR (qPCR) assay was developed for the simultaneous detection of Vibrio spp. together with V. alginolyticus , V. anguillarum , V. harveyi , V. ordalii , V. parahaemolyticus , V. vulnificus and V. cholerae . Species‐specific primers and probes targeting ompA, glutamate synthase, mreB, vohB, dnaJ, gyrB and lolB genes were designed, while the rpoA gene was selected for genus level Vibrio detection. The assay demonstrated 100% inclusivity for all target strains without cross reactivity against non‐target bacterial species. PCR efficiency/inhibition analyses showed stable amplification dynamics across serial dilutions, with R 2 values above 0.99, amplification efficiencies between 96.8% and 98.2%, and ΔCq values ≤ 0.13 for all targets. Limit of detection (LOD) studies performed using artificially contaminated matrices demonstrated a detection limit of 10 1 –10 0 CFU/mL for all targets, with detection performance comparable to the culture‐based recovery method. Overall, the developed multiplex qPCR assay provides a rapid, sensitive and analytically reliable approach for simultaneous detection of multiple Vibrio species associated with aquaculture and zoonotic infections.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了一种多重定量PCR（qPCR）方法，用于同步检测水产养殖样品中的多种弧菌属（*Vibrio* spp.）及溶藻弧菌、鳗弧菌、哈维氏弧菌、奥氏弧菌、副溶血弧菌、创伤弧菌和霍乱弧菌。该方法针对各目标菌种设计了特异性引物和探针，并以rpoA基因实现弧菌属水平检测，所有目标菌株 inclusivity 达100%，无交叉反应，R²>0.99，扩增效率96.8%–98.2%，检测限为10⁰–10¹ CFU/mL，性能与培养法相当。该多重qPCR方法为水产养殖相关弧菌的快速、灵敏检测提供了可靠工具。

papers.title: The value of the catches of steelhead for study of the ocean ecology of pacific salmon in the gulf of Alaska in the winter of 2022
papers.authors: Beamish, R.; Neville, Ch.; Riddell, B.
papers.abstract: В ходе исследования зимней экологии тихоокеанских лососей в зал. Аляска, проведенного с 25 февраля по 25 марта 2022 г., выловлено 57 особей микижи (также называемой стальноголовым лососем или стальноголовой форелью). Для лова тихоокеанских лососей использовались экспериментальные жаберные сети и яруса, при этом микижа ловилась исключительно в жаберные сети. Уловы микижи оказались выше, чем всех видов тихоокеанских лососей. Большинство особей выловлено жаберными сетями в верхнем 4-метровом слое, и все они были выловлены на глубинах не более 6 м. Эти результаты, а также анализ ранее опубликованных данных свидетельствуют о том, что микижа проводит практически весь период жизни в открытом океане в нескольких метрах от поверхности воды. Среди выловленной микижи рыб, присутствовали 34 особи в возрасте первого морского года и 21 особь в возрасте второго морского года; при этом 9 особей достигли половой зрелости. ДНК-анализ половозрелых особей показал, что они происходят из бассейнов рек Колумбия и Насс, а также рек зал. Пьюджет-Саунд и западного побережья о. Ванкувер. Микижа заходит в реки после окончания календарной зимы и, предположительно, вскоре нерестится. Еще для 45 особей методом ДНК-анализа были определены районы происхождения, однако эти результаты остаются предварительными из-за ограниченности исходной референсной базы. У рыб в возрасте второго морского года второе годовое кольцо на чешуе не обнаружено. У 16 из 33 особей первого морского года на чешуе имелось годовое кольцо. Количество склеритов в приросте после годового кольца варьировалось от 2 до 7, что указывает на длительный период формирования годовых колец у микижи. Микижа выловлена на станциях, где температура воды на поверхности превышала верхний температурный предел, ранее опубликованный для этого вида в зимний период. Врожденная склонность вида обитать в приповерхностных слоях в сочетании с продолжающимся потеплением океана, включая недавние волны тепла, подчеркивает необходимость более глубокого изучения океанической экологии микижи, особенно в зимний период.
papers.summary_cn: 2022年2月25日至3月25日在阿拉斯加湾开展的太平洋鲑冬季生态调查中，以实验性刺网和延绳钓采集太平洋鲑，共捕获57尾steelhead（虹鳟降海型），且仅见于刺网，渔获量高于所有太平洋鲑种类。多数个体在4 m以浅水层被刺网捕获，全部渔获深度不超过6 m，结合历史数据分析表明steelhead在开阔大洋中几乎整个生活史阶段均栖息于近表层数米范围内。渔获个体包括34尾第一海年鱼和21尾第二海年鱼，其中9尾已达性成熟，DNA分析显示其来源于Columbia河、Nass河、Puget Sound及温哥华岛西岸等流域。研究还发现第二海年鱼鳞片缺失第二个年轮、第一海年鱼年轮形成期较长（轮纹数2–7），且渔获站位表层水温超过该物种冬季已知温度上限，提示在海洋持续变暖背景下需加强steelhead冬季海洋生态研究。

papers.title: New data on the distribution and biology of the spiny king crab Paralithodes brevipes (Lithodidae) in the North-Eastern part of the sea of Okhotsk
papers.authors: Artemenkov, D. V.; Ivanov, P. Yu.; Sologub, D. O.; Deminov, A. N.; Morozov, T. B.; Ivankovich, Yu. I.; Shapovalov, A. S.
papers.abstract: The spiny king crab is a commercially fished species of aquatic biological resources in the Far Eastern seas of the Russian Federation. Published data on the biology of P. brevipes are available for populations in the Sea of Okhotsk and the Sea of Japan, off south-eastern Kamchatka, and in the waters around the Kuril Islands and Hokkaido. This is the first description of the life cycle, growth, and sexual and size structure of the spiny king crab inhabiting the Shelikhov Bay area of the Sea of Okhotsk. On the shelf of Western Kamchatka in August, the densest aggregations of males were recorded at depths of 31 to 43 m (34,7±1,5 m); the water temperature at these depths ranged from +8,9 to +10,6 °C (9,8 ± 0,4 °C), while females were found at depths of 31 to 43 m (35,7 ± 2,3 m), with temperatures ranging from +8,9 to +10,6 °C (9,8 ± 0,9°C). In September, dense aggregations of males were found at depths of 48 to 67 m (59,5±4,6 m), with water temperatures at these depths ranging from +10,4 to +10,7 °C (10,6±0,2°C), while females were found at depths ranging from 44 to 56 m (48,0 ± 2,8 m), with temperatures ranging from +10,4 to +10,7 °C (10,6 ± 0,2°C). The maximum group growth size (CWinf) for males and females was 180,4 and 132,5 mm respectively, which is higher than that of males off Hokkaido – CWinf 170,4 mm. Moulting of the spiny king crab in Shelikhov Bay presumably occurs in May, and larval release in October. The average estimated value for the onset of sexual maturity was CWmat 81,0 mm for males and 78,2 mm for females.
papers.summary_cn: 首次报道了鄂霍次克海Shelikhov湾海域spiny king crab（*Paralithodes brevipes*）的生活史、生长及性比与体长结构。8月雄蟹密集分布于31–43 m（水温8.9–10.6 °C），9月移至48–67 m；雌蟹分布深度略浅。雄、雌蟹最大群体生长体长（CWinf）分别为180.4 mm和132.5 mm，雄蟹大于北海道群体（170.4 mm）；推测换壳在5月、幼体释放于10月，性成熟起始体长（CWmat）雄蟹81.0 mm、雌蟹78.2 mm。

papers.title: Growth and reproduction of Japanese seabass, Lateolabrax japonicus , in the southern waters off the Korean Peninsula
papers.authors: Kang, Da Yeon; Park, Joo Myun; Moon, Seong Yong; Baeck, Gun Wook
papers.abstract: Abstract Japanese seabass ( Lateolabrax japonicus ) is a commercially and ecologically important species found in Korean waters, which functions as a top predator in coastal marine ecosystems. However, research on the reproduction and growth of L. japonicus in Korean waters remains limited; furthermore, comprehensive investigations integrating both reproductive and growth characteristics are lacking. Therefore, we examined the growth parameters and reproductive characteristics of L. japonicus inhabiting the southern waters of Korea. A total of 639 specimens (250 females and 389 males), ranging from 20.2 to 97.6 cm in total length (TL), were collected monthly between January and December 2020. The overall sex ratio (female: male) was 1:1.56, indicating male dominance; however, the proportion of females increased among individuals larger than 60 cm TL. Analysis of otolith marginal increments revealed that annuli formed once annually between March and April, following the spawning period. Growth parameters estimated using the von Bertalanffy growth function yielded an asymptotic TL of 117.36 cm for females and 109.58 cm for males, with a maximum estimated age of 11 years in both sexes. Based on monthly variation in the gonadosomatic index (GSI) and histological observations, spawning occurred from January to March. Males matured earlier and exhibited a longer spawning duration than females. Oocyte developmental patterns indicated that L. japonicus is a multiple spawner, releasing batches of eggs at least twice within the spawning season, and displayed group‐synchronous oocyte development. The TLs at 50% maturity were estimated to be 34.2 cm for females and 27.3 cm for males. These findings provide essential information for the sustainable management of L. japonicus stocks, and support the establishment of effective conservation measures—including the designation of spawning protection areas, implementation of minimum size limits and preservation of critical habitats.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于2020年逐月采集的639尾花鲈（Lateolabrax japonicus）样本，利用耳石边缘增量分析、von Bertalanffy生长函数及性腺组织学方法，估算了韩国南部海域该种的生长参数与繁殖特征。结果显示，雌雄渐近全长分别为117.36 cm和109.58 cm，最大年龄均为11龄；产卵期为1—3月，属多次产卵型，雌雄50%性成熟全长分别为34.2 cm和27.3 cm。研究结果为该海域花鲈的可持续管理和产卵保护措施制定提供了基础数据。

papers.title: The Pacific seaweed pipefish Syngnathus schlegeli exhibits exceptionally high levels of polygynandry among fishes with paternal egg care
papers.authors: Endo, Takehiro; Sekino, Masashi; Sogabe, Atsushi
papers.abstract: Abstract Syngnathid fishes (family Syngnathidae), characterised by male pregnancy via a brood pouch, provide an exceptional model system for studying the relationship between mating systems and sexual selection, as they display extraordinary diversity in both mating systems and sex roles within a single family. A previous study reported that the population of Pacific seaweed pipefish Syngnathus schlegeli around Zhaitang Island in China has a polygamous mating system but did not investigate whether females also mate with multiple partners. In this study, we used parentage analyses with eight microsatellite markers to investigate the genetic mating system of a northern population of S. schlegeli in Mutsu Bay, Japan. All pregnant males carried full broods of 942–1729 embryos, and paternity was exclusively assigned to the brooding male. Males mated with an average of five females (range 3–9), and eggs from different females were spatially segregated within each brood pouch. The occurrence of shared maternity across broods from different males indicated that females also performed multiple matings; however, females had a lower number of mates than males. These results clearly demonstrated that the Mutsu Bay population of S. schlegeli has a polygynandrous mating system. Notably, the maximum of nine mates per male represents the highest number of multiple matings reported for syngnathid fishes and possibly for fishes with paternal egg care. We suggest that the unusually high number of mates per male may be linked to the sexual size dimorphism in this population, where males are larger than females, which is a rare pattern among syngnathids. The comparison between the Zhaitang Island population and the Mutsu Bay population of S. schlegeli revealed clear geographic variations in body size, brood size and the number of mates per male. These patterns in S. schlegeli are similar to intraspecific latitudinal trends reported in some Syngnathus species, in which higher‐latitude populations tend to have greater body size, greater brood size and more mates per male. Further studies across a broader geographic range are needed to verify whether S. schlegeli exhibits latitudinal variation in mating systems.
papers.summary_cn: 以日本陆奥湾太平洋海龙（*Syngnathus schlegeli*）种群为对象，利用8个微卫星标记进行亲子分析，研究其遗传交配制度。结果显示，所有怀孕雄鱼均携带全同胞 brood（942–1729枚胚胎），父权专属孵育雄鱼；雄鱼平均与5尾雌鱼交配（范围3–9），不同雌鱼的卵在育儿袋内呈空间分隔，且雌鱼亦存在多配现象但配偶数少于雄鱼。该种群为 polygynandry 交配制度，雄鱼最多9个配偶为海龙科及父系护卵鱼类中已知最高记录，可能与雄性体型大于雌性的性二型有关；与斋堂岛种群的比较揭示了体型、brood size 和配偶数的地理变异，类似 *Syngnathus* 属种内纬度梯度趋势。

papers.title: Strategic fisheries closure balances harvest opportunity and stock diversity in a large Alaska river basin
papers.authors: Makhlouf, Ben; Schindler, Daniel E.; Cline, Timothy; Fernandez, Diego P.; Esquible, Janessa; Hoffman, Avery
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Effective conservation of exploited species requires balancing harvest opportunities with the protection of biodiversity. In Pacific salmon, biodiversity among populations contributes to basin-wide resilience, yet spatiotemporal dynamics of adult migrating Chinook salmon remain poorly understood in many large salmon-producing watersheds, creating uncertainty about management impacts. Declining abundance in western Alaska has led to restrictions in subsistence harvest and challenges for upstream communities. In the Kuskokwim River, a large salmon-producing river, a front-end closure limits early-season fishing to reduce exploitation of fish migrating to the upper watershed. To quantify stock-specific effects of this strategy, we reconstruct spatiotemporal dynamics of Chinook salmon return timing across six years using otolith isotope signatures. We demonstrate a consistent relationship between seasonal run timing and watershed origin, with earlier migrants contributing disproportionately to upper watershed regions. A longer simulated closure provided greater protection for upper watershed stocks but with a tradeoff of lost harvest opportunity. Protection varied substantially among years due to migration timing, highlighting how fixed closure strategies interact with dynamic ecological processes to influence overall efficacy.
papers.summary_cn: 在阿拉斯加 Kuskokwim River 流域，为保护溯河至上游的 Chinook salmon 种群，实施了前段禁渔（front-end closure）策略。研究利用耳石同位素特征重建了六年 Chinook salmon 洄游时序的时空动态，发现早洄游个体更多来自上游流域。模拟表明延长禁渔期可加强对上游种群的保护，但以损失捕捞机会为代价，且保护效果因年际洄游时序差异而显著波动。

papers.title: Current status environmental stressors and management constraints affecting fisheries in lake Hashenge, Northern Ethiopia
papers.authors: Tesfay, Solomon; Teferi, Mekonen; Gebreyohannes, Belay
papers.summary_cn: 该研究关注埃塞俄比亚北部Hashenge湖渔业面临的环境压力与管理制约，但摘要缺失，仅从标题可知其旨在评估该湖渔业的当前状况及管理瓶颈。

papers.title: From local hubs to regional impact: harnessing the social and solidarity economy in small-scale fisheries
papers.authors: Reis-Filho, José Amorim; Carvalho, Adriana R.; Giarrizzo, Tommaso; Noleto-Filho, Eurico Mesquita
papers.abstract: Abstract The global 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development calls for more equitable and sustainable pathways by integrating traditional communities into development efforts. Despite these ambitions, challenges persist, as many initiatives, including Social and Solidarity Economy (SSE) businesses, often operate in regional silos with broader transformative potential. Small-scale fisheries (SSF), particularly in the Global South, remain as one of the most affected sectors by economic imbalances and social injustices. Using Latin America fishery nations as a starting point and a particular focus on Brazil, which has the largest population of small-scale fishers in the Americas, we examine how SSE can be more effectively integrated into SSF stewardship by analyzing the quantitative and geographical landscape of SSF organizations and the broader SSE environment. We combine official data in a regional comparative perspective to assess how SSF organizations, fisher populations, labor pools, and cooperative density are configured across Latin America. Our results show that countries with larger SSF populations and related labor pools tend to sustain more numerous SSF organizations, while the broader cooperative environment is positively associated with, but does not fully determine, SSF organizational density. In Brazil, SSF organizations are widespread but remain only weakly integrated into SSE-oriented institutional frameworks, reflecting fragmented policies, limited legal support, and uneven territorial coverage of enabling programs. These findings reveal both opportunities and constraints: existing organizational networks provide a broad institutional base for SSE expansion, yet important territorial and institutional asymmetries persist. By highlighting “investment-need zones” and proposing policy and institutional recommendations, we argue that Brazil has a unique responsibility and opportunity to lead SSE–SSF integration in Latin America. Advancing this agenda could foster greater equity, strengthen social sustainability, and inspire broader transformations across the Global South toward solidarity-driven fisheries development.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以拉丁美洲渔业国家为对象、重点聚焦巴西，结合官方数据从区域比较视角分析小规模渔业（SSF）组织与更广泛的社会团结经济（SSE）环境的数量与地理分布格局，考察SSE如何更有效融入SSF治理。结果显示，SSF人口与劳动力池较大的国家往往拥有更多SSF组织，而整体合作社环境与SSF组织密度正相关但并非决定性因素；巴西SSF组织分布广泛，但与SSE制度框架整合薄弱，反映政策碎片化、法律支持有限及扶持项目地域覆盖不均。研究据此识别"投资需求区"并提出政策建议，认为巴西有责任和机遇引领拉美SSE–SSF整合，以促进公平与渔业社会可持续发展。

papers.title: Scale-Dependent Effects of Riparian and Watershed Land Use on Water Quality and Fish Assemblages: Implications for Reservoir Ecosystem Management
papers.authors: Chen, Yongjin; Yu, Zhenfei; Zhou, Qiong
papers.abstract: Watershed land-use change is a major driver of freshwater ecosystem degradation, yet whether water quality and fish assemblages respond to land use at the same spatial scale remains poorly resolved. This study examined multi-scale land-use effects on both endpoints in Songhua Lake, a large reservoir in Northeast China. Water quality and fish assemblages were surveyed from 2020 to 2022 across seven inflowing sub-watersheds and five open-lake sites. Land-use composition was quantified at five spatial scales (200–2000 m riparian buffers and the sub-watershed), and redundancy analysis was used to assess scale-dependent associations. Water quality deteriorated along the disturbance gradient, with CODMn increasing by 33.9% and water quality index declining by 10.6% from low- to high-disturbance groups. RDA showed that water quality was best explained at the 200 m buffer (97.2%), with forest as the dominant predictor. In contrast, fish assemblage variation was best captured at the 2000 m buffer and sub-watershed scales (up to 99.96%), with urban land as the dominant predictor; β-diversity showed the strongest response (p < 0.001). These results reveal a scale mismatch between physicochemical and biological responses, indicating that effective reservoir management requires a dual-layer strategy combining riparian restoration for water quality with sub-watershed regulation of urbanization for fish conservation.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以东北松花湖为对象，于2020—2022年调查7个入库子流域及5个敞水区的水质与鱼类群落，在200—2000 m河岸缓冲带及子流域共5个空间尺度上量化土地利用，并用RDA解析尺度依赖关系。结果表明水质在200 m缓冲带尺度解释度最高（97.2%），森林为主导预测因子；鱼类群落则在2000 m缓冲带及子流域尺度解释度最高（近99.96%），城镇用地为主导预测因子，β多样性响应最强。水质与生物响应的尺度错配提示，水库管理需采取河岸带修复改善水质与子流域城镇化调控保护鱼类的双层策略。

papers.title: Comparative oligo-FISH validates genome assemblies and delivers a precise karyotype for Lens Mill. species
papers.authors: Silvestrini, Alex Junior Aparecido; Ramsay, Larissa; von Wettberg, Eric Bishop; Bett, Kirstin E.
papers.abstract: Chromosome structural rearrangements play a significant role in karyotype evolution and speciation. These rearrangements pose challenges for precise karyotyping and the assembly of a genus pan-genome for crops and their wild relatives. Lens culinaris , an important cool-season legume primarily grown in India and Canada, is a cultivated species with six wild relatives. All seven Lens species exhibit distinct chromosomal arrangements, which affect introgression and complicate the development of an accurate karyotype for the genus. Using gene synteny analysis between the cultivated Lens species and six wild relatives, we developed cross-species oligo-FISH (Fluorescent in situ hybridization) probes to in situ confirm genome assemblies and synteny. Chromosome spreads were used for oligo-FISH experiments, in which the DNA was denatured and a set of red and green oligo probes was hybridized to the metaphase chromosomes. The combination of both oligo sets/probes resulted in a distinct pattern for each Lens spp. chromosome, allowing the inference of a more robust karyotype for six Lens species. The karyotyping of Lens spp. confirmed the proper assignment of chromosomes in the genome assemblies and validated the rearrangements detected in the synteny analysis. The results attest to a higher sequence-level similarity among the closest related species despite the occurrence of several chromosomal structural changes among them. Oligo-FISH probes can be used in conjunction with plant genome assembly projects, supporting the delivery of a precise representation of the physical chromosomes of a species.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用栽培兵豆（Lens culinaris）与6个野生近缘种的基因共线性分析，开发跨物种 oligo-FISH 探针，对6个 Lens 物种进行染色体原位杂交以验证基因组组装并构建核型。红绿双探针组合在各物种染色体上产生特异信号模式，确认了基因组组装中染色体的正确归属及共线性分析检测到的结构重排。结果表明，尽管近缘种间存在多处染色体结构变异，其序列水平仍高度相似；oligo-FISH 可辅助植物基因组组装项目，实现物种物理染色体的精准呈现。

papers.title: Shelf-life Assessment of Locally  Developed Coated Fish Product from Aplocheilus panchax under Frozen Storage
papers.authors: Islam, Md Rakibul; Khanam, Afrin; Sinha, Laboni Rani; Rana, Md. Masud; Newaz, Asif Wares
papers.journal: European Journal of Nutrition & Food Safety
papers.abstract: Small indigenous fish species (SIS) are highly popular among people in Bangladesh, as numerous closed and open water bodies support abundant production of these exceptionally palatable fish. Value-added, ready-to-heat fish products have gained increasing popularity globally in recent years because of their convenience and ease of consumption. The present study was conducted to determine the shelf life of a coated fish product prepared from blue panchax (Aplocheilus panchax) during frozen storage. The study was conducted from July 2023 to June 2024 at the Laboratory of Fishing and Post-Harvest Technology, Sher-e-Bangla Agricultural University, Dhaka. Major shelf-life indices, including pH, total volatile base nitrogen (TVB-N), peroxide value (PV), and total plate count (TPC), were assessed at 30-day intervals for a maximum period of 120 days. After 120 days of frozen storage, the pH of the coated fish product increased slightly from 6.15 ± 0.72 to 6.46 ± 1.17. TVB-N values increased from 8.71 ± 1.33 to 34.70 ± 3.83 mg/100 g, whereas peroxide values increased from 3.44 ± 0.72 to 11.35 ± 2.11 meq kg⁻¹. During the study period, the total plate count of the coated fish product showed a downward trend, with values of 3.60 ± 0.62, 2.90 ± 0.36, 2.60 ± 0.39, 2.30 ± 0.28, and 2.20 ± 0.44 log CFU g⁻¹ after 0, 30, 60, 90, and 120 days of frozen storage, respectively. The quality of the value-added product remained within acceptable limits for up to 90 days of storage. This study provides critical insights into the storage life of a previously developed value-added product prepared from a small indigenous fish species, Aplocheilus panchax, and demonstrates value addition as an effective approach for utilising the nutritional potential of underutilised fish species.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以孟加拉国小型本土鱼类蓝鳉（Aplocheilus panchax）为原料制备裹粉鱼制品，在冻藏条件下通过定期测定pH、TVB-N、过氧化值（PV）及总菌落数（TPC）评估其货架期。结果显示，冻藏120天内pH变化甚微，TVB-N和PV持续升高，TPC则呈下降趋势。综合各项指标，该产品在冻藏90天内品质保持在可接受范围内。研究表明，value addition是开发利用未充分利用小型鱼类营养潜力的有效途径。

papers.title: Length-weight Relationship and Condition Factor of Some Commercial Artisanal Fish Species in Bamusso Coast, Cameroon
papers.authors: Nkumbe, Nkwelle Marius; Asah, Ntugho Marvellous; Ambeno, Fidelis Narika; Arrey, Mbeng Ashu; Ojong, Geneva; Oben, Benedicta Oshuware; Oben, Pius Mbu
papers.journal: Asian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Research
papers.abstract: Background: The seasonal dynamics of the Gulf of Guinea, characterised by alternating dry and rainy seasons, exert profound influences on oceanographic conditions, primary productivity, and fish recruitment patterns. Understanding these seasonal patterns is particularly important for artisanal fisheries that depend on predictable seasonal variations in fish availability and abundance. Aims: This study investigated the length-weight relationship (LWR) and condition factor (K) of ten commercially important artisanal fish families from the Bamusso Coast, Cameroon, sampled monthly from January to June 2024. Methodology: A total of 677 specimens from families including Carangidae, Mugilidae, Clupeidae, Sphyraenidae, Polynemidae, Ariidae, Cynoglossidae, Lobotidae, Sciaenidae, and Serranidae were measured for total length (cm) and weight (g). LWR parameters were estimated using the equation W = abL, while the condition factor was calculated as K = 100W/Lb. Results: The results revealed significant interspecific variability in mean lengths (26.42–82.77 cm) and weights (0.18–4.81 g). Sphyraena barracuda exhibited the greatest mean length (82.77±37.78 cm), while Epinephelus marginatus recorded the highest mean weight (4.81±24.97 g). Length-weight relationships varied considerably among species, with Caranx hippos (b=2.30, r=0.86) and Lobotes surinamensis (b=2.96, r=0.94) showing strong positive correlations. All species displayed negative allometric growth (b<3.0), indicating a disproportionate increase in length relative to weight. Condition factor values ranged widely from 0.002±0.001 (Lobotes surinamensis) to 122.10±397 (Polydactylus quadrifilis), reflecting species-specific physiological conditions and habitat utilisation. Conclusion: These findings establish baseline biological parameters relevant to sustainable fisheries management in Cameroonian coastal waters and contribute to regional fish biology databases. The observed variability in growth patterns and condition factors underscores the need for species-specific management strategies to support the long-term conservation of artisanal fishery resources.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究对喀麦隆Bamusso海岸10个商业性手工渔业鱼类科（2024年1—6月逐月采样，共677尾）进行了 length-weight relationship (LWR) 和 condition factor (K) 分析。结果显示各种间平均体长（26.42–82.77 cm）和体重（0.18–4.81 g）差异显著，所有物种均呈负异速生长（b<3.0），K值跨种变化极大。研究为喀麦隆近岸水域可持续渔业管理提供了基础生物学参数，并强调需制定物种特异性管理策略。

papers.title: Socioeconomic potential of seaweed aquaculture in the Mekong River Delta, Vietnam: An integrative review
papers.authors: Nguyen, Huu-Tri; Phan, Phuong-Loan; Nguyen-Thi, Thuy-Hang; Nguyen, Huu-Thanh; Nguyen, Phu-Tho
papers.summary_cn: 该综述评估越南湄公河三角洲海藻养殖的社会经济潜力，综合分析了当地自然条件、养殖技术、市场前景及政策环境。文章旨在探讨海藻养殖作为该区域替代生计与沿海经济发展的可行性。

papers.authors: Deck, Annie R.; Tucker, Sarah J.; Hauser, Brianna M.; Iacchei, Matthew J.; Callan, Chatham K.; Rappé, Michael S.; Nigro, Olivia D.
papers.abstract: Ornamental fish aquaculture is receiving increasing scientific attention as a sustainable means of meeting demand for reef species from the aquarium trade. However, low juvenile recruitment in an aquaculture environment remains a key industry bottleneck for many high-demand pelagic-spawning species. Here, the microbiome of a yellow tang ( Zebrasoma flavescens ) larval cohort from hatch to the juvenile stage (76 days post-hatch) in a recirculating aquaculture system was investigated using a high throughput 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing approach. The taxonomic composition of microorganisms was assessed from the gastrointestinal tract of larval yellow tang, their feed, and the recirculating rearing water at eight key developmental timepoints. We observed a dynamic larval microbiome that displayed developmental stage-specific signatures. While some microbial taxa were ubiquitous throughout the larval stage ( i.e. , Proteobacteria), others, including Fusobacteriota, were restricted to specific growth stages. In addition to the role of ontogeny on host microbiomes, shifts in the microbial communities associated with feed types were found to coincide with pronounced changes in specific bacterial genera obtained from larval-derived microbiomes. Notably, in larval samples the relative abundance of the genus Vibrio peaked at 36 and 55 days post-hatch (97.2% and 94.2%, respectively), coinciding with the addition of enriched Artemia franciscana brine shrimp into their diet. The introduction of Vibrio species from prey cultures, specifically with Artemia , highlights that feed-associated microbiomes may play a substantial role in determining host microbiomes in early life, and illustrates the importance of further understanding the nature of Vibrio species present in food items used in an aquaculture setting.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以16S rRNA基因扩增子测序，追踪黄高鳍刺尾鱼（Zebrasoma flavescens）幼体在循环水养殖系统中从孵化至76日龄的微生物组演替，同时分析饲料与养殖水体微生物群落。结果显示幼体微生物组呈发育阶段特异性，Fusobacteriota等类群仅出现于特定阶段，而Vibrio属相对丰度在孵化后36天和55天分别达97.2%和94.2%，与卤虫（Artemia franciscana）强化投喂时间吻合。研究表明饲料相关微生物组对早期宿主微生物组构建具有重要影响，需关注养殖饵料中Vibrio的种类组成。

papers.title: Coupling SVM classification and CA-Markov simulation: four decades of land cover evolution and 2056 projection in Egypt’s northern Nile Delta — dual-dimensional analysis of aquaculture expansion and agricultural land loss
papers.authors: Mostafa, Wael; Aldosari, Ali Abdullah; Kheir, Ahmed M. S.; Abdelzaher, Mohamed R.; Chen, Shuisen; El-Khalafy, Mohamed M.
papers.abstract: Introduction This study provides the first spatially explicit, multi-decadal modeling of land use and land cover (LULC) dynamics in El-Hamoul District, Egypt—the largest district in Kafr El-Sheikh Governorate and a critical transition zone between intensive agriculture and the globally protected Lake Burullus Ramsar wetland. Methods Using Landsat 5, 7, 8, and 9 imageries from five benchmark years (1986–2025), classified via Support Vector Machine on Google Earth Engine (overall accuracy: 87–98%; Kappa: 0.83–0.97), six LULC classes were mapped: Agricultural Lands, Bare Lands, Fish Farms, Lake Burullus, Natural Vegetation, and Urban Areas. Results Between 1986 and 2025, 192.5 km 2 (29.97% of the district) underwent net transition. Fish farms expanded by 359% (from 24.9 to 114.4 km 2 ; +2.24 km 2 /year), primarily converting agricultural lands (59.0 km 2 ) and bare lands (34.5 km 2 ). Agricultural lands declined by 34.1 km 2 (−7.0%), while urban areas grew by 189% to 33.1 km 2 . Bare lands were nearly eliminated (−99.9%), removing the spatial buffer that once absorbed conversion pressures. A CA-Markov model, calibrated using the 1986–2025 transition matrix and validated against 2025 actual maps (difference: 0.1 km 2 , 0.017%), simulated LULC up to 2056. Results indicate continued aquaculture expansion to 143.9 km 2 (+25.8%), agricultural decline to 408.0 km 2 (−9.6%), and urban growth to 42.3 km 2 (+27.6%). Natural vegetation would increase modestly (to 33.7 km 2 ; +13.4%), driven by reed bed establishment in shallow lake margins, alongside limited bare land regeneration (2.8 km 2 ) from cyclical fish farm abandonment. Critically, Lake Burullus’s portion within El-Hamoul would shrink to 11.6 km 2 (−14.95% from 2025; −45.9% since 1986). Conclusion These findings reveal an accelerating loss of the lake–agriculture interface, direct encroachment on a Ramsar site, and the elimination of fallow buffers—pointing to urgent needs for spatially explicit land-use planning that balances aquaculture economics with wetland conservation and agricultural sustainability in one of Egypt’s most ecologically sensitive deltas.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用1986–2025年五期Landsat影像，通过SVM分类与CA-Markov模型，对埃及尼罗河三角洲El-Hamoul区（毗邻Ramsar湿地Lake Burullus）的土地覆盖演变进行多时段空间显式模拟，并预测至2056年。结果显示，鱼塘面积扩张359%（+2.24 km²/年），主要侵占农地（59.0 km²）和裸地（34.5 km²）；农地减少7.0%，裸地几近消失，削弱了缓冲转换压力的空间功能。CA-Markov预测至2056年水产养殖将持续扩张至143.9 km²，农地进一步下降9.6%，Lake Burullus在区内面积将缩减至11.6 km²（较1986年减少45.9%），凸显水产养殖经济与湿地保护及农业可持续性之间的紧迫权衡。

papers.title: Exploring the antimicrobial potential of marine macroalgal phenolic extracts (phycobiotics) against bacterial pathogens in aquaculture and clinical settings
papers.authors: Díaz-Formoso, Lara; Contente, Diogo; Feito, Javier; de la Fuente, Jesús; Hernández, Pablo E.; Borrero, Juan; Muñoz-Atienza, Estefanía; Cintas, Luis M.
papers.abstract: Introduction The growing threat of antimicrobial resistance has intensified the search for alternatives to conventional antibiotics in both human and veterinary medicine. Probiotics and their bacteriocins represent promising candidates; however, the complexity of microbial ecosystems and the variability in pathogen susceptibility highlight the need for complementary antimicrobial strategies based on natural compounds with distinct mechanisms of action. In this context, macroalgae have emerged as a potential source of bioactive molecules with antimicrobial activity (phycobiotics). Methods Phenolic extracts from different marine macroalgae collected along the northern coast of Galicia (Spain) were obtained and quantified. Moreover, macroalgal phenolic extracts were evaluated for antimicrobial activity against clinically and veterinary relevant pathogens, probiotic strains, and bacteriocin-resistant mutants (curvacin G14/curvacin G15-resistant Streptococcus parauberis LMG22252 and LJDL21, nisin Z-resistant Lactococcus garvieae CF00021, and garvicin A/garvicin Q/nisin Z-resistant Lc. garvieae CF00021). Results The highest phenolic contents were quantified in Pelvetia canaliculata , Fucus vesiculosus , and Cystoseira tamariscifolia , which also exhibited the greatest antimicrobial activity against pathogens with minimal effects on probiotic strains, supporting their potential combined use. Their inhibitory effect remained effective against bacteriocin-resistant St. parauberis LMG22252 and LJDL21, and Lc. garvieae CF00021, suggesting different mechanisms of action. Whole-genome sequencing of wild-type and bacteriocin-resistant mutant strains was performed to identify genetic variations associated with bacteriocin resistance, revealing that it was mediated by multifactorial adaptive responses. Discussion Macroalgal phycobiotics represent a promising antimicrobial strategy, exhibiting broad-spectrum activity against pathogens while exerting minimal effects on beneficial probiotic bacteria. Their efficacy against bacteriocin-resistant mutants further supports their potential for use in combination with probiotics as a complementary or synergistic strategy for pathogen control in both aquaculture and clinical settings.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探索海洋大型藻类酚类提取物（phycobiotics）作为抗生素替代物，用于水产养殖和临床环境中对抗病原菌的抗菌潜力。研究测定了西班牙Galicia北部海岸采集的多种大型藻类酚类提取物的含量及其对临床和兽医相关病原菌、益生菌株及bacteriocin抗性突变株的抗菌活性。结果显示，Pelvetia canaliculata、Fucus vesiculosus和Cystoseira tamariscifolia酚类含量最高，抗菌活性最强，且对益生菌株影响极小，并对bacteriocin抗性突变株保持有效抑制作用，提示其作用机制不同于bacteriocin。全基因组测序表明bacteriocin抗性由多因素适应性响应介导，大型藻类phycobiotics有望与益生菌联合用于水产养殖和临床病原菌控制。
