papers.title: Sustainable liquisolid compact system using fish viscera oil for enhanced dissolution and antioxidant activity of Baicalein
papers.authors: Malkawi, Ruba
papers.abstract: Background Baicalein (BA) is a flavonoid with significant pharmacological and antioxidant activities; however, its poor aqueous solubility and high crystallinity limit its dissolution and oral bioavailability. Liquisolid compact technology represents a promising approach for improving the dissolution behavior of poorly soluble drugs. Objective This study aimed to develop a sustainable liquisolid compact formulation of BA using extracted fish viscera oil as a non-volatile solvent and to evaluate its physicochemical characteristics, dissolution behavior, and antioxidant activity. Methods Fish oil was extracted from salmon viscera and used as a liquid vehicle for preparing BA liquisolid compacts using corn starch as a carrier and talc as a coating material. The prepared formulation was characterized using Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (FTIR), Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC), and Powder X-Ray Diffraction (PXRD) to evaluate drug–excipient interactions and changes in crystallinity. In vitro dissolution studies were conducted using USP apparatus II in phosphate buffer (pH 6.8). Antioxidant activity was assessed using the DPPH radical scavenging assay in a 96-well microplate reader. Results FTIR analysis confirmed the absence of chemical incompatibilities between BA and the formulation components. DSC and PXRD analyses demonstrated a significant reduction in the crystalline nature of BA, indicating its transformation into an amorphous or molecularly dispersed state within the liquisolid compact. The liquisolid compact showed a marked improvement in drug dissolution compared with pure baicalein and the physical mixture. Furthermore, the fish oil–BA formulation exhibited enhanced antioxidant activity compared with BA alone. Conclusion The developed fish oil–based liquisolid compact system significantly improved the dissolution and antioxidant performance of BA. In addition, the use of fish viscera oil provides a sustainable formulation approach by repurposing marine waste into a functional pharmaceutical excipient.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以鲑鱼内脏提取的鱼油作为非挥发性溶剂，采用玉米淀粉为载体、滑石粉为包衣材料，制备了黄芩素（baicalein）的 liquisolid compact 制剂，旨在改善其溶出度与抗氧化活性。FTIR、DSC 和 PXRD 表征显示黄芩素结晶度显著降低，转为无定形或分子分散状态；体外溶出（USP apparatus II，pH 6.8 磷酸盐缓冲液）及 DPPH 抗氧化实验表明，该制剂较纯黄芩素及物理混合物均显著提升了溶出度和抗氧化活性。该研究为利用鱼类内脏油将海洋废弃物转化为功能性药用辅料提供了可持续的制剂策略。

papers.title: Turning red: comparative biology of secondary carotenoid induction in carotenogenic green algae
papers.authors: Komarysta, Viktoriia
papers.abstract: A limited number of green microalgae develop conspicuous red or orange stress phenotypes through massive accumulation of secondary carotenoids in diverse habitats, including marine lagoons and coastal salterns, hypersaline lakes, freshwater habitats, snowfields, and aeroterrestrial environments. These “turning red” phenotypes occur in phylogenetically distinct algae exposed to extreme or highly variable environmental conditions and represent integrated stress-acclimation responses rather than simple changes in pigment composition. This work compares stress-tolerant, red-forming green algae across contrasting habitats to distinguish shared physiological responses from lineage-specific regulatory, metabolic, and intracellular sequestration strategies. Carotenoid induction is a quantitative response to interacting stresses, particularly irradiance and nutrient limitation, with the relative hierarchy and optimal intensity of these factors differing among taxa. Secondary carotenogenesis is frequently coupled with lipid metabolism, chloroplast remodeling, and redistribution of cellular carbon. Although carotenoid biosynthesis is primarily plastidial, the reviewed taxa differ markedly in intracellular trafficking and sequestration, ranging from plastid-retained β-carotene in Dunaliella to extraplastidial ketocarotenoid storage in cytoplasmic lipid-rich compartments, with some Coelastrella strains additionally producing water-soluble AstaP carotenoproteins. Despite this cellular and regulatory diversity, photoprotection, mitigation of oxidative stress, and enhanced survival under unfavorable conditions emerge as broadly convergent adaptive functions. Several carotenogenic algae are established industrial sources of high-value carotenoids, whereas others offer emerging opportunities for integrated environmental and circular biotechnologies, with production constraints differing across platforms. This cross-habitat comparative framework identifies conserved and lineage-specific features of secondary carotenogenesis and provides a basis for mechanistically informed optimization of carotenoid production.
papers.summary_cn: 部分绿色微藻在强光、营养限制等胁迫下大量积累次级类胡萝卜素，呈现红色或橙色表型，本文跨生境比较了耐逆产红绿藻的生理响应与谱系特异性调控、代谢及胞内隔离策略。类胡萝卜素诱导是对多重胁迫的定量响应，常与脂质代谢、叶绿体重塑和碳再分配耦合，其胞内转运与储存方式在类群间差异显著（如 Dunaliella 的质体滞留β-胡萝卜素与部分 Coelastrella 的胞质酮类胡萝卜素及水溶性 AstaP 蛋白）。尽管细胞与调控机制多样，光保护、氧化胁迫缓解和逆境存活增强是趋同的适应功能，该比较框架为高产类胡萝卜素的机制性优化提供了依据。

papers.title: Environmental DNA Monitoring of Narwhal (Monodon monoceros) and Fish Biodiversity with Inuit Communities
papers.authors: Duporge, Isla C; Parent, Geneviève J; Mablik, Tommy; Watt, Cortney A.
papers.abstract: The Northern Hudson Bay (NHB) narwhal (Monodon monoceros) population is geographically and genetically distinct and represents a vital cultural and subsistence resource for Inuit communities in Nunavut. While aerial surveys provide abundance estimates for population models and sustainable harvest limits, complementary approaches are needed to expand spatial and temporal monitoring in the rapidly changing Arctic. Here, we demonstrate how Inuit community members can actively contribute to monitoring narwhals and co-occurring taxa using environmental DNA (eDNA). Opportunistic water samples collected by hunters during subsistence outings detected narwhal eDNA alongside multiple fish and marine mammal species, providing ecological information difficult to obtain from aerial surveys, particularly for smaller-bodied taxa such as fish that are rarely detectable from aircraft. We also compare two metabarcoding assays, 12S160 and MiFish-U, for detecting marine mammal and fish DNA. MiFish-U primarily detected narwhal in the hunting context, whereas 12S160 mainly detected fish. These findings highlight the potential to collect multi-taxa ecological data during traditional hunting activities using a minimally invasive method. Incorporating eDNA sampling into long-term monitoring in collaboration with Inuit communities can enhance biodiversity assessments and advance our understanding of narwhal ecology in Arctic marine ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探索因纽特社区居民通过 eDNA 采样参与北极独角鲸（Monodon monoceros）及共现物种监测的可行性。猎人在传统狩猎活动中机会性采集水样，成功检测到独角鲸及多种鱼类和海洋哺乳动物的 eDNA，提供了航空调查难以获取的小型鱼类等类群的生态信息。比较 12S160 和 MiFish-U 两种 metabarcoding 方法发现，MiFish-U 在狩猎情境下主要检测独角鲸，而 12S160 主要检测鱼类。将 eDNA 采样纳入与因纽特社区合作的长期监测，可增强生物多样性评估并深化对北极海洋生态系统中独角鲸生态学的理解。

papers.title: Effects of temperature on standard metabolic rate, hypoxia tolerance, and critical thermal maxima in invasive cichlids
papers.authors: Moreland, Jacob A; Neal, J Wesley; Dunn, Corey G; Little, Logan; Allen, Peter J
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Jaguar Guapote Parachromis managuensis and Red Devil/Midas cichlids Amphilophus spp. are highly invasive species in the family Cichlidae native to Central America. These cichlids are popular within the aquarium trade, leading to their broad introduction outside of their native range. Information about potential environmental plasticity of a species can improve predictions of invasion potential. In this respect, measures of environmental influences on metabolic rate and hypoxia tolerance are important for understanding limitations in adaptability and subsequently guiding the management of invasive species. Methods Standard metabolic rate (SMR), hypoxia tolerance, and critical thermal maxima (CTmax) were compared between Jaguar Guapote and Amphilophus spp. For SMR and hypoxia tolerance, a range of temperatures spanning subtropical to tropical environments (i.e., 22, 28, and 34°C) was used, followed by stepwise decreases in oxygen saturation until loss of equilibrium. Results Jaguar Guapote and Amphilophus spp. both had lower SMR at 28°C than at 34°C, SMR at 22°C was not different from either temperature. Both Jaguar Guapote and Amphilophus spp. were the most sensitive to hypoxia at the coolest temperature (22°C) relative to warmer temperatures (28°C and 34°C). Upper thermal tolerance (CTmax) was similar between species (∼42°C), although Jaguar Guapote were more resilient based on a higher agitation temperature and recovery following high temperature exposure. Conclusions These results indicate temperatures that are representative of their natural distribution (i.e., near 28°C) offer energetic savings for Jaguar Guapote and Amphilophus spp. relative to warmer temperatures (34°C), with cooler temperatures (22°C) having higher metabolic costs than expected. Both Jaguar Guapote and Amphilophus spp. are sensitive to hypoxia at cooler temperatures (22°C). Therefore, these species are relatively resilient to high temperatures, but low temperatures may restrict their invasiveness.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了入侵性慈鲷 Jaguar Guapote（*Parachromis managuensis*）与 Red Devil/Midas cichlids（*Amphilophus* spp.）在不同温度（22、28、34°C）下的标准代谢率（SMR）、低氧耐受性及临界高温（CTmax），以评估其环境可塑性与入侵潜力。结果显示，两种鱼在28°C时SMR最低，22°C时对低氧最为敏感，CTmax均约42°C，但 Jaguar Guapote 的高温耐受与恢复能力更强。研究表明，低温可能限制这两种慈鲷的入侵扩散，而高温适应性较强。

papers.title: Growth patterns of Ceratothoa oxyrrhynchaena parasitizing Doederleinia berycoides in the northeastern Sea of Japan
papers.authors: Motomura, Yusuke; Sato, Hiroki; Asada, Yo; Kojima, Shigeaki
papers.abstract: Abstract Ceratothoa oxyrrhynchaena Koelbel, 1879 is a cymothoid isopod that parasitizes marine fishes including the blackthroat seaperch Doederleinia berycoides (Hilgendorf, 1879). In 2025, 50 individuals of D. berycoides parasitized by C. oxyrrhynchaena were collected from the northeastern Sea of Japan. Total length (TL) and body weight (BW) of the host fish and body length (BL) of the isopods were measured. Mostly fewer than three isopods parasitized a single fish, with only one individual hosting five isopods. This suggests the possible existence of a mechanism that limits the number of parasites per host. No difference in size was detected between the smallest fish parasitized by a single parasite and the smallest fish by two parasites, suggesting that dual parasitism begins when the host is still young. Significant positive correlations were detected between the host body size (TL and BW) and BL of parasites, indicating that the isopods grow concurrently with their host fish. The smallest host fish was indirectly estimated to be younger than 1 year of age, whereas the age of the largest fish was estimated to be close to 5 years of age. This finding suggests that the isopod parasite may inhabit the host’s buccal cavity for at least 4 years.
papers.summary_cn: 对日本海东北部黑喉海鲈（Doederleinia berycoides）寄生等足类Ceratothoa oxyrrhynchaena的生长模式进行了研究。2025年采集50尾被寄生宿主，测量宿主全长、体重及寄生虫体长，分析寄生数量与宿主及寄生虫体长的关系。多数宿主仅寄生不足3只等足类，仅1尾寄生5只，提示存在限制单宿主寄生数量的机制；宿主规格与寄生虫体长呈显著正相关，表明寄生虫随宿主同步生长。最小宿主估计不足1龄，最大宿主接近5龄，推测该寄生虫可在宿主口腔内栖息至少4年。

papers.title: Reverse taxonomy of fish-scale geckos (Geckolepis) using shotgun sequencing for museomics-based assignment of historical names to genetic lineages
papers.authors: VENCES, MIGUEL; GLAW, FRANK; KÖHLER, JÖRN; MIRALLES, AURÉLIEN; PREEZ, LOUIS DU; PREICK, MICHAELA; RAKOTOARISON, ANDOLALAO; SCHERZ, MARK D.; HOFREITER, MICHAEL; PETZOLD, ALICE
papers.abstract: Fish-scale geckos (Geckolepis), endemic to Madagascar and the Comoro Islands, are nocturnal, arboreal lizards with large, imbricate scales that can be shed and regenerated in their entirety, most likely as an antipredator mechanism. Their species-level taxonomy has remained partly unresolved because morphology alone has proven insufficient to reliably assign genetic lineages to scientific names. Here, we use a museomics approach to extract and shotgun-sequence DNA from twelve liquid-preserved historical and mostly name-bearing type specimens of six historical nomina in the genus, and assemble sequences of the mitochondrial genes for 12S rRNA, 16S rRNA, and nd4 for ten of these specimens. Despite relatively low coverage, the assembled sequences robustly placed all these type specimens in a phylogenetic tree with 113 ingroup samples collected across Madagascar. Our results demonstrate the efficiency of this approach to recover mitochondrial evidence for taxonomic purposes, but also show its failure to recover reads matching single-copy nuclear genes. We discuss the promise of a renewed focus on nuclear ribosomal genes as complementary nuclear-encoded DNA barcodes for vertebrates, as we found 18S rRNA sequences to be well-represented among the reads of the historical specimens studied here. Based on evidence from the mitochondrial tree, two nuclear-encoded genes (C-MOS, RAG-1), and morphology, we resurrect G. typica var. modesta Methuen & Hewitt, 1913 as a full species, G. modesta, from north-western Madagascar, confirm the current use of the name G. maculata Peters, 1880 for specimens from northern and eastern Madagascar, of G. polylepis Boettger, 1893 for specimens from western and north-western Madagascar, and of G. typica Grandidier, 1867 for specimens from southern and south-western Madagascar. We also recognize G. typica var. anomala Mocquard, 1902 as a subspecies, G. typica anomala, and confirm G. petiti Angel, 1942 to be a synonym of this subspecies. We also describe two new species, G. bekira sp. nov. and G. spania sp. nov. from northern Madagascar. The new classification provides a robust baseline to identify the remaining taxonomic issues in the genus and tackle them, preferably using genomic approaches which are also promising to better understand the molecular mechanisms of scarless wound healing and skin regeneration in these geckos.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对马达加斯加及科摩罗群岛特有的鱼鳞守宫（Geckolepis），采用 museomics 方法对12件历史液浸模式标本进行 shotgun sequencing，成功组装了10件标本的线粒体 12S rRNA、16S rRNA 和 nd4 序列，并将其稳健地嵌入包含113个内群样本的系统发育树中。结果表明该方法可有效获取线粒体证据用于分类学修订，但未能回收单拷贝核基因序列，而 18S rRNA 序列在历史标本中代表性良好，提示核糖体基因可作为脊椎动物补充性 DNA barcode。基于线粒体树、两个核基因（C-MOS、RAG-1）及形态学证据，作者恢复了 G. modesta 为独立种，确认了 G. maculata、G. polylepis 和 G. typica 的现行命名使用，将 G. typica var. anomala 认定为亚种并确认 G. petiti 为其同物异名，同时描述了马达加斯加北部两个新种 G. bekira sp. nov. 和 G. spania sp. nov.。

papers.title: Evolution of freshwater reproduction in a marine fish: Evidence from genetics and otolith microchemistry
papers.authors: Ferreira-Araújo, Thais; Kemppainen, Petri; Tanner, Susanne E; Reis-Santos, Patrick; Gillanders, Bronwyn M; Kahilainen, Kimmo K; Merilä, Juha; Momigliano, Paolo
papers.abstract: Abstract The evolution of distinct reproductive strategies within the same species can offer unique insights into adaptive divergence. Since the discovery of European flounder (Platichthys flesus) in the freshwater environment of the isolated Lake Pulmanki in the 1970s, the evolutionary origin and reproductive strategy of this euryhaline fish has remained a mystery. Using otolith chemistry and whole-genome resequencing, we tested the hypothesis that flounders in Lake Pulmanki constitute a freshwater-adapted lineage, distinct from their marine ancestors. Otoliths confirmed that most of the flounders caught in Lake Pulmanki were born and lived exclusively in freshwater, providing the first evidence for a fully freshwater confined life cycle in Platichthys. Unexpectedly, most individuals in nearby fjords were also born in freshwater. While the genome-wide differentiation among marine- and freshwater-born flounders was weak, 77 SNPs across 18 chromosomes were significantly associated with habitat-use type, mapping to 35 genes. Moreover, outlier loci show strong interchromosomal linkage disequilibrium (LD), suggesting divergent selection for allelic combinations associated with reproductive habitat use. This pattern is consistent with a genetic basis for early habitat use differences involving epistatic interactions among alleles in different chromosomes, pointing to a genetic adaptation for freshwater reproduction in Lake Pulmanki.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以欧洲川鲽（Platichthys flesus）为对象，结合 otolith microchemistry 与全基因组重测序，检验芬兰 Lake Pulmanki 淡水种群是否构成独立于海洋祖先的淡水适应谱系。Otolith 分析证实该湖多数个体终生栖息于淡水，首次揭示 Platichthys 存在完全淡水封闭生活史，且邻近峡湾多数个体亦出生于淡水。全基因组分化较弱，但77个 SNP（分布于18条染色体、对应35个基因）与栖息地利用类型显著关联，且离群位点呈现强染色体间 linkage disequilibrium，提示不同染色体等位基因间的上位互作受到分化选择，支持 Lake Pulmanki 淡水繁殖的遗传适应基础。

papers.title: Morphological and dietary shifts during ontogeny in Asian seabass (Lates calcarifer): insights into feeding ecology
papers.authors: Rathnayake, R. R. M. Udara N. B.; Munasinghe, D. Hemali N.; Bandara, K. V. Sandun N.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究以尖吻鲈（Lates calcarifer）为对象，探讨其个体发育过程中形态与食性的变化，以揭示其摄食生态特征。摘要缺失，具体方法与结果不详。

papers.title:
The habitat use of ariid catfishes in coral reefs in northeastern
                    <scp>Brazil</scp>
papers.authors: Lima, Romullo Guimarães; Soares, Bruno Eleres; da Silva Pereira, Clecio; Bezerra, Wesley Ruan Fernandes; da Silva, Paloma Rocha; Jesuino, Livian Kertleen Pôrto; dos Santos Gemaque, Mariana Vitória; Soares, Carlos Alberto Cavalcanti; Vendel, Ana Lúcia; Marceniuk, Alexandre P.
papers.abstract: Abstract Ariidae species occur across a wide range of habitats from freshwater to fully marine environments and are typically associated with soft‐bottom substrates. However, they are sometimes associated with hard‐bottom substrates such as coral reefs, but such association is poorly documented. This study describes the occurrence and habitat use of six ariid species in the coral reef of Penha Beach, northeastern Brazil. We deployed gill nets monthly alongside the coral reef over a year between 2023 and 2024, and we sampled 256 individuals representing six ariid species. Bagre filamentosus , a marine catfish, was the most abundant species throughout the year. Species composition varied seasonally, and an RDA analysis showed that variation in species abundances was associated with precipitation and air temperature, with Cathorops spixii occurring primarily during the wet season. B. filamentosus and Sciades proops showed male‐biased sex ratios across all seasons (exact binomial tests), and males of B. filamentosus exhibited higher mass gain per unit length during the dry season (t‐test). Diet composition varied among months and according to the species' habitat affinity, although effect sizes were small and seasonal differences were weak. These findings suggest that ariid catfishes use coral reef systems as opportunistic foraging and refuge habitats, with habitat use probably linked to their life cycle and the connections between coral reefs and estuaries.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在揭示巴西东北部珊瑚礁中海鲶科（Ariidae）鱼类的栖息地利用模式，该类群通常与软底质环境相关，其在硬底质珊瑚礁中的出现记录甚少。作者于2023—2024年在Penha Beach珊瑚礁旁每月布设刺网，共采集6种256尾个体，并结合RDA分析环境因子与物种丰度的关系。结果显示，Bagre filamentosus为全年优势种，群落组成呈季节性变化，与降水量和气温相关；B. filamentosus和Sciades proops各季节均呈雄性偏倚的性比，且前者旱季单位体长增重更高。研究表明，海鲶科鱼类将珊瑚礁作为机会性摄食与庇护栖息地，其栖息地利用可能与生活史及珊瑚礁—河口连通性有关。

papers.title: Nutritional Profiling of Dried Puntius sophore (Hamilton, 1822), a Principal Raw Material for the Traditional Fermented Fish Product Ngari in Manipur, India
papers.authors: Bipinchandra, Urikhimbam; Singh, Pebam Bidyananda; Devi, Thounaojam Babina; Meetei, Khangembam Brajamani; Nongmaithem, Bijayalakshmi Devi; Ngangbam, Ajit Kumar
papers.abstract: The small indigenous fish species Puntius sophore is an important raw material used in the preparation of Ngari, a traditional fermented fish product of Manipur, India. Fresh adult P. sophore were collected from Loktak Lake, Manipur, during August to September 2025 and processed into dried fish for nutritional evaluation. The fish were cleaned, washed, sun-dried, pulverised and stored before laboratory analysis. This study analysed the proximate composition, fatty acid profile and amino acid composition of dried P. sophore to generate baseline information relevant to its use in traditional fermentation. Analyses were performed in triplicate, and the results were expressed as mean±standard deviation. The dried sample had a low moisture content of 3.34±0.12%, indicating effective dehydration. Crude protein and crude fat contents were 40.03±0.24% and 30.15±0.008%, respectively, while ash and carbohydrate contents were 14.42±0.02% and 12.06±0.024%, respectively. Fatty acid analysis showed saturated fatty acids at 13.25±0.04%, monounsaturated fatty acids at 12.66±0.03% and polyunsaturated fatty acids at 4.24±0.016%, with no trans fat detected. Amino acid profiling confirmed the presence of both essential and non-essential amino acids. Glycine (3.14±0.01%), glutamic acid (3.06±0.01%), proline (2.39±0.008%), leucine (2.72±0.03%) and phenylalanine (1.88±0.01%) were the major constituents recorded, whereas histidine and lysine were not detected in the sample. Overall, the findings indicate that dried P. sophore is a protein- and lipid-rich fish material with appreciable ash content and a diverse amino acid profile. The study provides preliminary nutritional data that may support quality assessment of dried fish used for Ngari production and related traditional fermentation systems in Manipur.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以印度曼尼普尔邦传统发酵鱼制品Ngari的主要原料——小型本土鱼类Puntius sophore为对象，对其干制品的营养成分进行了评价。测定了样品的近似组成、脂肪酸谱及氨基酸组成，结果显示干鱼水分含量低（3.34%），粗蛋白（40.03%）和粗脂肪（30.15%）含量丰富，灰分14.42%，碳水化合物12.06%；脂肪酸以饱和脂肪酸（13.25%）和单不饱和脂肪酸（12.66%）为主，未检出反式脂肪；氨基酸中以甘氨酸、谷氨酸、脯氨酸、亮氨酸和苯丙氨酸为主要成分，未检出组氨酸和赖氨酸。研究表明干制P. sophore是一种高蛋白、高脂且氨基酸组成多样的鱼类原料，为其作为Ngari发酵原料的质量评价提供了基础营养数据。

papers.title: Determination of Total Mercury in Selected Seafood Samples Using Cold Vapor Atomic Absorption Spectrometry (CVAAS)
papers.authors: Omema Khalid Atia; Safa Abd Alwahhab Albakkoush
papers.abstract: Mercury (Hg) is a persistent environmental contaminant that can accumulate in aquatic organisms and enter the human diet through seafood consumption. Monitoring total mercury concentrations in seafood is therefore important for food-safety assessment and environmental surveillance. This study aimed to determine and compare total mercury concentrations in selected seafood samples, including squid, prawn, fresh fish (mackerel), and canned fish, using cold vapor atomic absorption spectrometry (CVAAS) following microwave-assisted acid digestion. The analytical procedure was also assessed in terms of calibration linearity, recovery, and repeatability. Homogenized seafood samples (approximately 0.20 g) were digested with concentrated nitric acid using a closed-vessel microwave digestion system. Mercury was measured using a NIC RA-3000 Mercury Analyzer, with the standard addition method used to minimize matrix effects. The calibration curves demonstrated good linearity, with coefficients of determination (R²) ranging from 0.9883 to 0.9956. The measured total mercury concentrations were 1.74 ppb in squid, 1.22 ppb in prawn, 5.69 ppb in fresh fish, and 6.92 ppb in canned fish. Recovery values ranged from 65% to 102%, while repeatability assessment for canned fish produced an RSD of 5.57%. Total mercury concentrations varied among the investigated seafood samples, with the highest measured value in canned fish and the lowest in prawn. However, the limited sampling design prevents statistical generalization, and the higher value in canned fish cannot be attributed to canning. Further studies should include larger representative samples, independent biological replicates, comprehensive analytical validation, and mercury speciation to better evaluate contamination and potential dietary exposure.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用微波辅助酸消解结合冷原子吸收光谱法（CVAAS）测定鱿鱼、对虾、鲜鲭鱼和罐头鱼等海产品中的总汞含量，并评估了校准线性、回收率和重复性等分析性能。结果显示，总汞浓度分别为鱿鱼1.74 ppb、对虾1.22 ppb、鲜鱼5.69 ppb、罐头鱼6.92 ppb，回收率为65%~102%，罐头鱼重复性RSD为5.57%。各样品汞含量存在差异，罐头鱼最高、对虾最低，但受限于采样设计，尚不能进行统计推断或归因于罐装工艺，后续需扩大代表性样本并结合汞形态分析以评估膳食暴露风险。

papers.title: Synergistic effects of fish scale–derived nanohydroxyapatite and arginine on enamel surface recovery: a multi-modal in vitro analysis
papers.authors: Thomas, Nebu George; Oommen, Vimal Thomas; Xavier, Arun Mamachan; Das, Revu; Binsi, P. K.; Vellappally, Sajith; Naik, Sachin; Alfrisany, Najm M.; Mani, Blessy M.; Sunny, Steffy M.
papers.abstract: Abstract Dental caries arises from an imbalance between demineralization and remineralization of dental hard tissues, leading to progressive mineral loss and early lesion formation. Fluoride enhances remineralization but mainly affects the enamel surface. Nanohydroxyapatite (n-HA), structurally similar to enamel apatite, may promote mineral deposition, while arginine increases local pH and supports remineralization. This in vitro study evaluated the combined remineralization potential of sustainably sourced, fish scale–derived n-HA and arginine, used alongside fluoride toothpaste, for early enamel lesions using a multimodal analytical approach. Forty human premolars were demineralized for 96 h to produce artificial lesions and randomly allocated into five groups ( n = 8): (1) fluoride toothpaste, (2) 10% n-HA, (3) 10% n-HA + 10% arginine, (4) fluoride toothpaste + 10% n-HA + 10% arginine, and (5) demineralized control. Specimens underwent pH cycling with respective remineralizing slurries for 28 days. Surface changes were evaluated using surface microhardness, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and Raman microscopy. The fluoride + n-HA + arginine group showed the greatest increase in microhardness (Vickers Hardness Number [VHN] 367.48 ± 26.95 kgf/mm²), significantly higher than the demineralized control (191.24 ± 13.86; p < 0.001). The n-HA + arginine group also showed a substantial increase in microhardness (319.10 ± 28.75 kgf/mm²). SEM and AFM analyses revealed greater surface smoothing and pore reduction in the combination group compared with fluoride alone, suggesting enhanced surface recovery and mineral deposition. Fish scale–derived n-HA combined with arginine enhances the in vitro remineralization potential of fluoride toothpaste and may represent a promising strategy for managing early enamel lesions. Graphical abstract The combination of fish scale-derived n-HA with arginine increases the enamel surface remineralization capacity of fluoride toothpaste in an in vitro caries model. Forty extracted human premolar teeth were submitted to artificial demineralization and divided into five groups ( n = 8): fluoride toothpaste, 10% n-HA, 10% n-HA + 10% arginine, fluoride toothpaste + 10% n-HA + 10% arginine, and demineralized control. After 28 days of pH cycling, the highest enamel microhardness was achieved by the group treated with fluoride toothpaste + 10% n-HA + 10% arginine (367.48 ± 26.95 VHN) compared with the demineralized control (191.24 ± 13.86 VHN; p < 0.001). The results indicated reduced surface porosity and structural imperfections of the enamel surface along with a homogeneous enamel surface, confirmed by morphological and topographical analysis by SEM and AFM. Abbreviations: n-HA, nanohydroxyapatite; VHN, Vickers hardness number; SEM, scanning electron microscopy; AFM, atomic force microscopy
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估鱼鳞来源纳米羟基磷灰石（n-HA）与精氨酸联合氟化物牙膏对早期釉质病变的再矿化效果。采用离体人前磨牙人工脱矿模型，经28天pH循环后通过表面显微硬度、SEM、AFM及拉曼光谱分析。结果显示氟化物+n-HA+精氨酸组显微硬度提升最显著（VHN 367.48 vs 脱矿对照191.24，p<0.001），表面孔隙减少、结构更均匀。鱼鳞来源n-HA与精氨酸可增强氟化物牙膏的再矿化潜力，是早期釉质病变管理的潜在策略。

papers.title: Edible Fish as a Source of Klebsiella pneumoniae : Incidence, Virulence, Biofilm Formation, Antimicrobial Resistance and Control Strategies
papers.authors: Kusunur, Ahamed Basha; Medidi, Prasanna Kumar; Kumar, Sradha Dinesh; Nakka, Alekhya; Chigilipalli, Himabindu; Gattu, Rudrappa; Sivam, Visnuvinayagam; Rangasamy, Anandan; Vaiyapuri, Murugudas; Badireddy, Madhusudana Rao
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Fish sold in retail markets are prone to contamination with pathogenic bacteria. Investigations on occurrence of Klebsiella pneumoniae, its characterization in seafood are essential for the protection of consumer health. Objective The present study investigated the incidence of K. pneumoniae in fish and characterized their virulence profile, biofilm-forming ability, antimicrobial resistance and their control using water-soluble chitosan and postbiotics. Methods In total, 144 fish and processing water samples from fish retail markets of Visakhapatnam, India were screened for presence of K. pneumoniae using MacConkey agar and amplifying khe gene. Virulence characterization (entB, mrkD, kfu, allS, rmpA, ybtS, iutA) antibiotic susceptibility test (disc diffusion assay against 28 antibiotics) biofilm-forming ability and anti-K. pneumoniae activity of water-soluble chitosan (microtiter plate assay) were studied. Results Eleven fish samples showed presence of K. pneumoniae. All the isolates possessed entB gene, however, 91% of the isolates carried mrkD and kfu genes. Antibiogram studies showed that all isolates were multidrug resistant (MDR), and their Multiple Antibiotic Resistance (MAR) index ranged from 0.19 to 0.39. Resistance genes detected in K. pneumoniae were bla SHV (91%), bla TEM (27%), sul1(18%), tetA (9%), tetD (9%), and catA2 (9%). Majority of K. pneumoniae isolates were moderate biofilm formers (63.6%) and the biofilm-forming ability was potentiated by supplementation with lactose (100%) followed by fructose (90.9%) and ribose (90.9%) sugars. Water-soluble chitosan (1%) showed effective control of all K. pneumoniae. Conclusion The present study showed majority of the K. pneumoniae isolates from seafood were found to be virulent, multidrug-resistant, ESBL producers, and moderate biofilm formers indicating potential health risk to fish consumers. Water-soluble chitosan showed a significant inhibitory effect on growth of all K. pneumoniae isolates. Highlights The detection of virulent and MDR K. pneumoniae in edible fish meat, albeit at a low level, poses a significant threat to consumers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了印度Visakhapatnam零售市场鱼类及加工水中Klebsiella pneumoniae的污染情况，通过khe基因扩增确认11份鱼样阳性，并对其毒力基因、生物膜形成能力及耐药谱进行了系统表征。结果显示所有分离株均为MDR，MAR指数0.19~0.39，主要携带bla SHV（91%）和bla TEM（27%）等耐药基因，多数为中等生物膜形成者，且生物膜形成受乳糖等糖类增强。水溶性壳聚糖（1%）对所有分离株均表现出显著抑制效果，提示食用鱼中virulent且MDR的K. pneumoniae对消费者构成潜在健康风险。

papers.title: Functional distinctions in feeding behavior of two herbivorous reef fish lineages
papers.authors: Luenenborg, A; Mihalitsis, M; Wainwright, P C
papers.abstract: Abstract Understanding the mechanisms and variation of how herbivorous fishes feed is key to understanding the dynamics of herbivory on coral reefs. In our comparative study of closely related nominally herbivorous fishes, we investigate the use of ten distinct behaviors used to support feeding on algae. We found that species within Siganidae share 5 out of the 10 behaviors with Acanthuridae while also exhibiting two additional family-specific behaviors: presence of nibbling and extra jaw closure. Siganids predominantly use movements of the jaws whereas acanthurids also employ body and head movements while detaching algae from the substrate. A comparison among siganid species revealed an axis of diversity in the frequency and extent of their feeding behaviors, with the main axis of variation being strongly associated with sociality (schooling vs. pairing) and morphology (short-snouted vs. long-snouted). Overall, we show that siganids and acanthurids display distinct behaviors during feeding. Thus, our results suggest potential niche differences between two major groups of herbivorous reef fishes.
papers.summary_cn: 比较研究揭示了两种主要草食性珊瑚礁鱼类（Siganidae 与 Acanthuridae）在摄食行为上的功能差异。Siganidae 与 Acanthuridae 共享10种摄食行为中的5种，但前者具有啃咬和额外颌闭合两种科特异性行为，且主要依赖颌部运动，而后者还借助身体和头部运动剥离藻类。Siganidae 种间摄食行为频率和程度的变异主要与社群性（群游 vs 成对）和形态（短吻 vs 长吻）相关。结果表明这两大类群存在潜在的生态位分化。

papers.title: Decellularized Fish Swim Bladder Extracellular Matrix–Polycaprolactone Composite Material for Application in Small‐Diameter Vascular Grafts
papers.authors: Wu, Yifan; Xu, Minghao; Wang, Xixi; Wang, Chijia; Wang, Zhihong; Liu, Jing
papers.journal: Journal of Biomedical Materials Research Part A
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The high incidence of cardiovascular diseases has led to an increasing demand for small‐diameter vascular grafts. Polycaprolactone (PCL) is a commonly used synthetic polymer material in the construction of vascular grafts. However, PCL alone has limited bioactivity, which may affect its blood‐contacting and tissue responses when used in small‐diameter vascular grafts. Fish swim bladder‐derived extracellular matrix (FSB–ECM) contains bioactive components such as collagen and has been investigated as a cardiovascular biomaterial, although its mechanical properties are limited. In this study, fish swim bladder‐derived dECM was incorporated into PCL by electrospinning to fabricate a series of small‐diameter vascular grafts. The study first confirmed that dECM was successfully loaded onto PCL fibers and significantly improved the hydrophilicity and degradation performance of the material. Based on the in vitro and ex vivo evaluations, the 15% PCL–dECM (3:7) formulation was selected for further in vivo testing because it showed a favorable balance of mechanical properties and hemocompatibility, including low platelet activation. Subsequent in vivo evaluation in a rat abdominal artery implantation model demonstrated that this dECM‐modified graft achieved a 100% patency rate. Furthermore, it exhibited significant anti‐inflammatory effects and was conducive to the organized deposition of extracellular matrix components, such as collagen and elastic fibers. This work successfully developed a novel small‐diameter vascular graft that possesses both excellent bioactivity and mechanical properties. Our findings offer a promising strategy and a solid experimental foundation, supporting the future clinical translation of small‐diameter vascular grafts.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究将鱼鳔来源脱细胞细胞外基质（FSB-dECM）通过静电纺丝掺入聚己内酯（PCL），制备小口径血管移植物，以改善PCL单独使用时生物活性不足的问题。体外及离体评价表明，15% PCL-dECM（3:7）配方在力学性能与血液相容性间取得良好平衡，并被选用于大鼠腹主动脉植入实验。体内结果显示该移植物通畅率达100%，具有显著抗炎效果并促进胶原与弹性纤维的有序沉积，为小口径血管移植物的临床转化提供了新策略与实验依据。

papers.authors: Kovacik, Anton; Andreji, Jaroslav; Helczman, Marek; Harangozo, Lubos; Fik, Martin; Andrejiova, Miriam; Tomka, Marian; Massányi, Peter
papers.journal: Human and Ecological Risk Assessment: An International Journal
papers.summary_cn: 该研究在17年后重新评估了斯洛伐克Hron河淡水鱼中重金属的生物累积及健康风险，以检验此前监测结果的时间变化。

papers.title: Impact of light pollution on fishes: Mechanisms and ecological consequences
papers.authors: Chen, Hanxi; Candolin, Ulrika
papers.abstract: Abstract The increasing prevalence of artificial light at night (ALAN) is of growing ecological concern. By altering natural light regimes, ALAN affects the behaviour, physiology and life‐history of organisms. While research has largely focused on terrestrial ecosystems, aquatic ecosystems are increasingly exposed. Here, we systematically review current knowledge of the impacts of ALAN on fishes and the underlying mechanisms and ecological consequences. We first discuss the factors influencing fish exposure to ALAN and how light can exert both direct and indirect effects. We then examine the potential consequences of these responses for ecosystem structure and functions, considering interactions with other environmental stressors, such as warming, noise and chemical pollution. To assess the current state of knowledge, we systematically review the literature. We find that most studies have focussed on the direct effects of ALAN on fish behaviour and physiology, whereas the fitness consequences of these responses and the impacts on population dynamics, species interactions and community composition remain largely unexplored. Notably, no study has assessed the broader implications for ecosystem functions. We identify key research priorities to advance understanding of both the short‐ and long‐term effects of ALAN on fishes and to inform effective mitigation strategies. In particular, more research is needed on the ecological consequences of fish responses to ALAN. We conclude by discussing potential solutions to light pollution, emphasising the importance of integrating economic, social and environmental considerations in the development of environmentally friendly lighting practices.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述系统梳理了夜间人造光（ALAN）对鱼类的直接与间接影响机制及其生态后果，并评估了其与变暖、噪声和化学污染等环境胁迫因子的交互作用。文献分析表明，现有研究多聚焦于ALAN对鱼类行为和生理的直接效应，而对其适合度后果、种群动态、种间关系及群落组成的影响仍鲜有探讨，生态系统功能层面的研究更是空白。作者据此提出关键研究优先方向，并强调在制定环境友好型照明方案时需综合经济、社会与环境考量。

papers.title: Value chain performance and market dynamics of small-scale bivalve fisheries: a case study from coastal cox’s bazar, Bangladesh
papers.authors: Hossain, Khandakar Zakir; Rashid, Faisal; Rahman Khan, Mohammad Sadequr; Asaduzzaman, Md
papers.abstract: Small-scale bivalve fisheries in coastal Bangladesh constitute a vital yet highly informal sub-sector that is largely neglected in national fisheries governance frameworks. This study investigates the value chain performance, market dynamics, and socioeconomic contributions of artisanal bivalve fisheries across two distinct coastal systems in Cox’s Bazar, Bangladesh: Chawfaldandi (a well-connected mainland site) and Moheshkhali (a geographically isolated offshore island). A cross-sectional comparative field survey was conducted during the peak harvesting season (November 2025–April 2026). Employing a multi-stage purposive and snowball sampling strategy, primary data were gathered through face-to-face interviews from 150 stakeholders of each site across three specific nodes: harvesters/collectors (n=50), traders/retailers (n=50), and consumer households (n=50). The study focused on three economically important wild bivalve species: the Indian backwater oyster (Crassostrea madrasensis), the green mussel (Perna viridis), and the Asiatic hard clam (Meretrix meretrix). Despite substantial latent export and domestic tourism-driven potential, the sector remains constrained by its informal nature, wild stock dependence, and monsoon-driven seasonality. Implementing targeted strategies, such as community-based depuration systems, insulated ice storage, formal marketing cooperatives, certification of bivalve products, can significantly improve product safety, optimize income distribution for vulnerable coastal communities, and integrate these "hidden" small-scale fisheries into the broader blue economy framework.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以孟加拉国Cox's Bazar沿海两处典型区域（陆域Chawfaldandi与离岛Moheshkhali）为对象，通过收获季跨区域问卷调查（每站点150名利益相关者，覆盖采捕者、贸易商和消费家庭三个节点），比较分析了印度后湾牡蛎、绿贻贝和亚洲硬壳蛤三种经济双壳类小规模渔业的value chain绩效与市场动态。结果显示，该非正式子行业虽具出口与国内旅游消费潜力，但受制于野生种群依赖、季风季节性及治理缺位。作者建议通过社区净化系统、冷链储运、营销合作社和产品认证等干预措施，提升产品安全并优化脆弱沿海社区的收入分配，将其纳入blue economy框架。

papers.title: Cytotoxic and Apoptotic Effects of Sultamicillin and Cefuroxime Axetil and Their Potential Transformation Products in RTG-2 Fish Gonad Cells
papers.authors: Tuzcuoglu, Enes; Kirici, Muammer
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以RTG-2鱼性腺细胞为模型，评估了sultamicillin与cefuroxime axetil及其潜在转化产物的细胞毒性与凋亡诱导效应。该研究有助于了解这些抗生素及其降解产物对鱼类生殖细胞的潜在生态毒理风险。

papers.title: Assessment of Microplastic Ingestion in Freshwater Fish Labeo Rohita From the Indus River Crossing Dera Ismail Khan
papers.authors: Afira Afsheen; Ruqia Bibi; Nida Khalid; Sumbal
papers.journal: Kashmir Journal of Academic Research and Development
papers.abstract: The increasing contamination of MP’s in aquatic environment particularly in fresh water ecosystem has become a serious challenge for human health fresh water system like Indus river system is an important transport routes for plastic contamination however the research regarding on micro plastic ingestion in commercially impotent fish species remains limited There for the present study was aimed to investigate the ingestion of micro plastic in fresh water fish Labeo rohita on the basis of size, color and shape. A Total of 100 fish specimen were collected from three different sites of Indus River Dera Ismail Khan the three locations are named as upstream, midstream and downstream. The fish specimen were collected between November 2025 to April 2026. The Gastrointestinal Tracts of each specimen is removed after dissection for further analysis the GIT tract is digested in 30% hydrogen per oxide solution to is date organic materials the solution was incubate at 48c’ and then Filters through Filter paper the filter paper contain the remaining particles was dried in a laboratory oven at 37c’ After drying the filter paper was examined under a compound microscope. The extracted MPs were identified and characterized based on their size shape and color on way Anova and correlation test were carried out to determine the variance and relationship with fish biometric parameters. Results revealed that 78% of fish contained microplastics, with a sum of 156 molecules detected along with a mean profusion of 1.56 ± 1.21 items per fish. The predominant type was fibers (67%), then succeeded by films (14%), lines (10%), fragments (6%), and foam (3%). Black-colored particles were most prevalent (29%). Microplastic abundance was significantly higher at downstream sites (p = 0.017), and showed positive correlations with body length (R² = 0.41), body weight (R² = 0.46), and gut weight (R² = 0.39). Labeo rohita from the Indus River are significantly exposed to microplastic contamination. It is recommended that continuous monitoring, enhanced management of garbage practices, and consciousness of the public programs be implemented to reduce microplastic waste in freshwater habitat.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了印度河Dera Ismail Khan段淡水鱼Labeo rohita对微塑料的摄入情况，按尺寸、颜色和形状对胃肠道中提取的微塑料进行鉴定与表征。结果显示78%的样本含有微塑料，平均丰度为1.56 ± 1.21 items/鱼，以纤维（67%）和黑色颗粒（29%）为主，下游站点丰度显著更高，且与体长、体重及肠道重量呈正相关。研究表明该河段Labeo rohita面临显著的微塑料暴露风险，建议加强持续监测与垃圾管理。

papers.title: Grass carp reovirus activates fish Ppp1r3g to suppress innate immunity and exacerbate hemorrhage via the 14-3-3ζ/Itgb3 signaling axis
papers.authors: Wang, Ruyi; Zhou, Man; Wang, Yuxuan; Hu, Xudong; Zhang, Han; Cao, Hong
papers.abstract: Protein phosphatase 1 regulatory subunit 3G (PPP1R3G) is one of the regulatory subunits of protein phosphatase 1 (PP1). Current research on PPP1R3G is primarily focused on glycogen synthesis and lipid metabolism. However, the role of ppp1r3g in the innate immune response of fish has not been completely elucidated. This study demonstrated that ppp1r3g regulates RLR signaling pathway through interactions with Rig-I, Mda5, and Traf6. In parallel, Ppp1r3g inhibits platelet activation by regulating 14-3-3 zeta (14-3-3ζ) and consequently modulating the formation of the 14-3-3ζ-integrin-β3 (Itgb3) complex. In vivo analysis revealed that compared with the wild-type controls, ppp1r3g -null rare minnow ( Gobiocypris rarus ) and ppp1r3g -chimera grass carp ( Ctenopharyngodon idella ) exhibited significantly enhanced resistance to grass carp reovirus (GCRV), with markedly alleviated hemorrhagic symptoms post-infection. Furthermore, knockdown of ppp1r3g suppressed GCRV replication and upregulated type I interferon (IFN-1) expression in grass carp kidney (CIK) cells. Additionally, Ppp1r3g binds to the -ESKVFYLKMKGDYYRYL- fragment (EL17) of 14-3-3ζ via the Ser36/37 phosphorylation site located on the PP1c domain. This study also demonstrated that 14-3-3ζ interacts with Itgb3 through this fragment, indicating that Ppp1r3g competes with Itgb3 to bind 14-3-3ζ. Furthermore, Ppp1r3g dose-dependently promoted Itgb3 degradation via a proteolytic pathway. These findings indicate that Ppp1r3g negatively regulates innate antiviral immunity after GCRV stimulation and suppresses platelet and coagulation cascade activation by modulating the interaction between 14-3-3ζ and Itgb3 in fish.
papers.summary_cn: 草鱼呼肠孤病毒（GCRV）感染激活宿主蛋白磷酸酶1调节亚基Ppp1r3g，进而抑制先天抗病毒免疫并加重出血症状。研究发现Ppp1r3g通过与Rig-I、Mda5和Traf6互作负调控RLR信号通路，同时经14-3-3ζ/Itgb3轴抑制血小板活化与凝血级联反应。体内实验表明，ppp1r3g缺失的稀有鮈鲫和嵌合草鱼对GCRV抗性显著增强、出血症状明显减轻；细胞水平敲低ppp1r3g可抑制病毒复制并上调I型干扰素表达。机制上，Ppp1r3g通过其PP1c结构域Ser36/37磷酸化位点结合14-3-3ζ的EL17片段，竞争性阻断Itgb3与14-3-3ζ的结合，并剂量依赖性地经蛋白水解途径促进Itgb3降解。

papers.title: Wild-harvested Marphysa madrasi for biosecure aquaculture: nutritional profiling, pathogen screening, and phylogenetic assessment
papers.authors: Atchuthan, P.; Jaikumar, Muthuswamy; Ramadoss, Dineshram; Periasamy, Rengaiyan; Behera, Anil Kumar
papers.abstract: Abstract Polychaetes are widely used as high-value aquaculture feed, yet India continues to depend heavily on imported species despite the availability of locally abundant taxa. However, the nutritional potential, biosafety, and taxonomic clarity of indigenous polychaetes remain poorly characterized. This study addresses this gap by assessing the suitability of the underutilized speciesMarphysa madrasi Hutchings, Lavesque, Priscilla, Daffe, Malathi & Glasby, 2020 as a sustainable , locally sourced feed resource for aquaculture. Field observations were conducted across intertidal zones near Chennai to document harvesting activities, harvesting intensity and species occurrence. Morphological and molecular analyses confirmed the taxonomy of M. madrasi , and screening for major pathogens, including White Spot Syndrome Virus and Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei , showed no detectable infection. Nutritional profiling revealed a high protein content and a favourable fatty acid composition, including saturated, monounsaturated, and polyunsaturated fatty acids relevant to broodstock nutrition. Together, these results demonstrate that M. madrasi possesses desirable nutritional and biosafety characteristics, supporting its potential integration into Indian aquaculture value chains. These findings highlight opportunities to reduce reliance on expensive imported polychaetes, promote local livelihoods, and encourage sustainable harvesting and the development of future polychaete cultivation strategies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了印度本地未充分利用的多毛类 Marphysa madrasi 作为水产养殖饲料资源的潜力，通过形态学与分子鉴定确认其分类地位，并开展病原筛查（WSSV、EHP）及营养成分分析。结果显示该物种未检出主要病原感染，且蛋白质含量高、脂肪酸组成优良，适用于亲本营养强化。研究支持将 M. madrasi 纳入印度水产养殖价值链，以减少对进口多毛类的依赖并促进本地可持续采收。

papers.title: A quantum-inspired multi-objective learning framework for real-time sustainable aquaculture water quality prediction
papers.authors: Abdel-Aty, Abdel-Haleem; Almalki, Ali Jaber; Ghorashi, Sara A.; Voon, Betty Wan Niu; Hafez, Mohamed
papers.abstract: Management of sustainable aquaculture necessitates accurate prediction of water quality parameters, since environmental variability is an important factor in determining aquatic productivity and ecological stability. Traditional machine learning systems are usually limited by inefficient parameter optimization, feature overlap, and limited adaptability to non-linear and time-varying environmental trends. To address these issues, a new concept is proposed, which is called Quantum-Inspired Aquaculture Optimization Network (Q-AQUAOptNet). To improve the process of feature selection, hyperparameter optimization, and model stability before temporal prediction, the proposed architecture combines sustainability index modeling and quantum-inspired multi-objective evolutionary optimization. The optimization approach balances exploration and exploitation, enhancing the learning ability of the prediction model. Implementation of the framework was done through Python-based simulation tools in preprocessing, optimization, and performance evaluation. The created system had a Root Mean Square Error of 0.24, a Mean Absolute Error of 0.21, and an R 2 of 0.97, which means that it has effective predictive power and a great ability to explain the variance. Integrating evolutionary optimization and temporal learning improves generalization performance and reduces prediction uncertainty. The findings demonstrate that Q-AQUAOptNet provides effective predictive performance within a simulation-based framework and shows potential as a sustainability-oriented intelligent water-quality monitoring and decision support system for aquaculture applications.
papers.summary_cn: 针对可持续水产养殖水质参数预测中传统机器学习参数优化效率低、特征重叠及对非线性时变环境适应性差的问题，提出量子启发式多目标优化网络Q-AQUAOptNet，融合可持续性指数建模与量子启发多目标进化优化以改进特征选择、超参数优化和时序预测稳定性。基于Python仿真实现，模型RMSE为0.24、MAE为0.21、R²为0.97，显示有效预测能力与方差解释力。结果表明该框架在仿真条件下具备良好泛化性能，有望作为面向可持续性的水产养殖智能水质监测与决策支持系统。

papers.title: Defining and finding the profit for seaweed secondary extensive aquaculture
papers.authors: Froehlich, Halley E.; Campbell, Rose S.; Miller, Kathy Ann; Johnson, Kevin M.; Fleener, Gary; Kroeker, Kristy J.
papers.abstract: Seaweed aquaculture is expanding globally, yet small-scale producers, such as those emerging in the United States, face challenges in achieving economic viability. We introduce and formalize the concept of secondary extensive aquaculture (SEA): the non-target cultivation, harvest, and use of extractive species (e.g., seaweeds) that naturally recruit and grow on existing aquaculture infrastructure designed for a different primary species (e.g., oysters). To explore the economic viability of SEA, we employed a scenario-based bioeconomic modeling approach, coupling logistic seaweed growth and sustainable harvest with a simple profit function. The model was parameterized with literature-derived ranges for seaweed growth and carrying capacity, as well as data from a 2025 pilot harvest on a 65 ha oyster farm in California. Using simulations, we evaluated key ecological and economic combinations under which seaweed SEA may offset the estimated 5-10% production losses associated with typical, unharvested biofouling. We showed that profitability increased with farm size, growing season length, and intrinsic growth rate ( r ) of seaweed, with viable scenarios typically requiring &gt; 50-100 ha and &gt; 60 growing days under conservative market assumptions ($400 t -1 wet weight). Intrinsic growth rate exerted a stronger influence on profitability than carrying capacity ( K ), indicating that faster-growing seaweed species (e.g., Ulva spp., Gracilaria spp., and Pyropia spp.) are more suitable candidates for SEA. In fact, modal ecological conditions on a 65 ha farm may offset biofouling costs. Labor intensity, however, emerged as a major bottleneck, with pilot-informed labor estimates (~140-200 hrs. t -1 including processing) far exceeding the ca. 10 hrs. t -1 needed to breakeven at minimum wage, but could be achieved with realistic improved efficiency. Although our pilot SEA yields fell near the lower bound of global seaweed aquaculture production, they remain within plausible commercial ranges. Overall, SEA represents a promising complementary strategy for diversifying revenue streams and enhancing circularity in aquaculture systems, but its realization will depend on sufficient scale, favorable biological productivity, labor efficiency improvements, and supportive policy frameworks.
papers.summary_cn: 研究提出并形式化了“secondary extensive aquaculture (SEA)”概念，即在牡蛎等主养品种的现有设施上，非目标性地采收自然附生的海藻。通过耦合logistic生长模型与利润函数的生物经济情景模拟，并以加州65 ha牡蛎养殖场2025年试点采收数据参数化，评估其经济可行性。结果表明，盈利性随养殖规模、生长季长度和海藻内禀增长率(r)提升，可行情景通常需>50–100 ha及>60个生长日（保守市场价$400 t⁻¹湿重），且r的影响强于环境容纳量(K)，快速生长种类（如Ulva、Gracilaria、Pyropia）更适宜。劳动力投入是主要瓶颈，但SEA有望抵消生物污损造成的5–10%产量损失，成为水产养殖多元增收与循环化的补充策略。

papers.title: A computational intelligence framework for multimodal oceanic data analysis and predictive modeling in sustainable marine resource management
papers.authors: Liu, Xuan
papers.abstract: Introduction The rapid expansion of ocean based economic activities and increasing anthropogenic pressures have made sustainable marine resource management a critical challenge in oceanic computing. Effective management of ocean ecosystems necessitates intelligent systems capable of integrating multimodal data, capturing spatiotemporal dynamics, and operating under uncertainty. Traditional approaches often rely on static optimization models or oversimplified biological assumptions, limiting their ability to address real world complexities such as ecological feedback, regulatory compliance, and conflicts among user groups. Methods To overcome these limitations, we propose a computational intelligence framework that integrates high resolution ecological modeling with dynamic decision making and decentralized governance mechanisms. Central to this framework is the ECO STORM model (Ecologically Constrained Optimization via Stochastic Temporal Resource Management), which employs a stochastic dynamic programming approach to unify biomass evolution, habitat conditions, and enforcement factors. Neural function approximators are utilized for value iteration, while softmax parametrized policies enable adaptive effort allocation at the regional level. Complementing this, we introduce AQUA GOV (Adaptive Quota and Uncertainty Aware Governance), a multi agent governance strategy that allocates quotas under ecological and regulatory constraints, incorporating user specific preferences and compliance risks. AQUA GOV features fairness aware quota adjustments, stochastic monitoring, and a reinforcement loop that integrates stakeholder feedback. This closed loop system effectively models, forecasts, and manages marine resources under uncertainty. Results and Discussion Experiments conducted in simulated marine environments demonstrate the framework’s ability to maintain ecological thresholds, ensure policy compliance, and optimize resource distribution among diverse user groups. This work provides a scalable and intelligent solution for advancing marine governance in data rich, heterogeneous, and ecologically sensitive seascapes.
papers.summary_cn: 针对海洋资源管理中多模态数据整合与不确定性决策难题，本研究提出集成计算智能框架，核心包括基于随机动态规划的ECO-STORM生态约束优化模型与AQUA-GOV多智能体配额治理策略，利用神经函数逼近与softmax策略实现区域自适应捕捞努力量分配及公平性配额调整。模拟实验表明，该框架能维持生态阈值、保障政策合规并优化多用户群体间的资源分配，为数据丰富的异质性海域提供可扩展的智能治理方案。

papers.title: Local baselines reveal elevated groundwater nutrients, localised coastal enrichment, and broadly oligotrophic reef conditions in Laamu Atoll, Maldives
papers.authors: Arnull, Jessica; Hashim, Aminath Shaha; Ganeshram, Raja S.; Wilson, A. Meriwether W.; Moosa, Hassan; Reay, David S.; Ziyadh, Aishath Mufliha; Tudhope, Alexander W.
papers.abstract: Introduction Nutrient enrichment in coral reef systems is increasingly recognised as a major driver of ecological change, yet integrated assessments across groundwater, coastal, and reef environments remain limited in small island developing states (SIDS). Methods We assessed dissolved inorganic nutrients (total oxidised nitrogen, ammonium and phosphate), N:P ratios, and isotope-based tracers (δ 15 N, C:N) across groundwater, coastal-surface, and reef domains of Laamu Atoll, Maldives, between 2022 and 2024 to characterise spatial nutrient patterns and establish a baseline for environmental monitoring. Results Groundwater contained substantially higher nutrient concentrations – typically one to two orders of magnitude – than coastal-surface and reef waters, with several wells exceeding national drinking-water standards for ammonium. Coastal-surface waters showed localised nitrogen enrichment at several inhabited and poorly flushed shorelines, while reef waters remained characteristically oligotrophic with phosphate frequently below detection limits across most sites. N:P patterns suggested predominant, though not uniform, phosphorus limitation in groundwater, and more variable nutrient limitation across coastal and reef environments that differed by island and use-type context. Exploratory δ 15 N analysis in seagrass and macroalgal tissue showed weak group-level differences but localised enrichment near fish-processing and relative depletion near agricultural zones, while C:N ratios differed most strongly by species, with a secondary, weaker signal by land-use type. Discussion Together, these cross-domain nutrient gradients demonstrate clear spatial differences among groundwater, coastal-surface, and reef environments, consistent with localised nutrient enrichment in some nearshore settings and strong hydrodynamic control across the wider atoll. This study provides the first integrated nutrient baseline for Laamu Atoll, complemented by exploratory isotope data from a subset of islands, and contributes to the limited body of nutrient monitoring data available for coral reef systems in SIDS, supporting future monitoring and management of nutrient pressures associated with wastewater and agriculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究于2022—2024年在马尔代夫Laamu Atoll对地下水、近岸表层水和礁区水体开展溶解无机营养盐（总氧化氮、铵盐、磷酸盐）、N:P比及同位素示踪（δ¹⁵N、C:N）的综合基线调查，以刻画营养盐空间格局并建立环境监测基线。结果显示，地下水营养盐浓度较近岸和礁区水体高1—2个数量级，部分水井铵盐超国家饮用水标准；近岸水体在有人居住且水交换较差的岸段出现局部氮富集，而礁区总体维持贫营养（oligotrophic）状态，多数站点磷酸盐低于检出限。N:P格局指示地下水以磷限制为主，近岸与礁区营养限制因岛屿及利用类型而异；δ¹⁵N在鱼类加工区附近富集、农业区相对贫化。该研究提供了Laamu Atoll首个跨域营养盐基线，揭示了局部近岸富营养化与环礁尺度水动力控制的主导作用。

papers.title: A Noise-Aware Federated Learning Framework for Fish Spoilage Prediction in Small-Scale Fisheries: An Architecture-Controlled Performance Evaluation
papers.authors: Sospeter, Kelvin; Tesha, Gaudence
papers.journal: East African Journal of Information Technology
papers.abstract: Post-harvest fish spoilage remains a major challenge for small-scale fisheries in developing economies, with losses estimated at 25-30% attributed largely to inadequate cold chain monitoring at informal landing sites and markets. This paper presents a noise-aware Federated Learning (FL) framework for predicting fish spoilage risk, evaluated through an architecture-controlled comparison against a centralised baseline. Because a large, labelled dataset from operational cold chain deployments was unavailable, a synthetic dataset of 10,000 records was generated using environmental ranges reported in the literature and calibrated to reflect DHT22 sensor tolerances, explicitly separating true environmental conditions from sensor-reported values to model realistic calibration drift and measurement noise. An identical Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) architecture was used for both the centralised baseline and the federated system, implemented using the Flower framework across three simulated nodes representing distinct fisheries sites, ensuring that any observed performance difference reflects the federated training process itself rather than a difference in model capacity. The centralised model achieved 94.75% accuracy, within half a percentage point of a calculated 94.73% theoretical noise ceiling derived from the dataset’s own noise model, while the federated model achieved a comparable 94.8-95.0% accuracy across five training rounds. A STRIDE-based threat analysis identified nine cybersecurity threats affecting the system, of which the highest-severity communication threat was mitigated using Transport Layer Security (TLS), implemented and empirically measured to add negligible computational overhead. Permutation-based feature importance analysis further identified exposure duration, rather than temperature, as the dominant predictor of spoilage risk (74.48% relative contribution). These results demonstrate that federated learning’s privacy-preservation and connectivity-resilience benefits can be obtained at negligible measurable cost to predictive accuracy, supporting federated architectures as a practically competitive, rather than purely privacy-motivated, choice for connectivity-constrained fisheries contexts in developing economies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对发展中国家小规模渔业收获后腐败损失（25-30%）问题，提出一种噪声感知的 Federated Learning（FL）框架用于鱼类腐败风险预测，并采用相同 MLP 架构在三个模拟渔业节点上与集中式基线进行架构控制对比。基于合成数据集（10,000 条记录，校准至 DHT22 传感器容差）的评估显示，集中式模型准确率 94.75%，接近理论噪声上限 94.73%，联邦模型准确率相当（94.8-95.0%）。基于 STRIDE 的威胁分析识别出九类网络安全威胁，最高危通信威胁经 TLS 缓解且计算开销可忽略；置换特征重要性分析表明暴露时长而非温度为腐败风险的主导预测因子（相对贡献 74.48%）。结果表明 FL 的隐私保护与连接韧性优势可在预测精度几乎无损的前提下实现，支持其作为连接受限渔业场景中实用且有竞争力的架构选择。

papers.title: Optimal Fisheries Management Using Transferable Shares of a Convex Tax
papers.authors: Berglann, Helge; Bjørndal, Trond; Maynou, Francesc
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In this paper, we propose a fishery control scheme that happens to be first best in the context of a Gordon‐Schaefer model with asymmetric information about effort/harvesting costs. It is widely acknowledged that in the absence of regulations, competition between vessels leads to a competitive game wherein the outcome is inefficient. We introduce a management scheme that regulates the fishing industry through an individual convex tax on effort or on catches. The shares of this tax can be traded in a market, thus solving problems related to asymmetric information. This can be achieved since heterogeneous fishing firms are individually stimulated to solve the same optimality problem as a social planner would. We apply this model to the Northwest Mediterranean demersal fishery as a case study.
papers.summary_cn: 针对Gordon-Schaefer模型中努力/捕捞成本存在不对称信息的问题，提出一种基于可交易凸税份额的渔业管理方案，使异质性渔船个体激励与social planner最优解一致，从而实现first best。以西北地中海demersal fishery为案例进行了应用分析。
