papers.title: Developing Guidance for Supporting the Implementation of an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management by Deep-sea RFMOs
papers.authors: Thompson, Anthony; Hidas, Eszter; Vasconcellos, Marcelo
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: The Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries (EAF) was adopted by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) as a practical framework for fisheries management according to the Code of Conduct for Responsible Fisheries. An EAF recognises that fish and fisheries are part of and dependent upon the entire marine ecosystem and that fisheries management must balance human and ecological considerations in a comprehensive way to achieve sustainable outcomes. This paper elaborates on the inclusion of EAF in international law, the existing guidance to support EAF implementation, and the achievements and challenges remaining for the implementation of the approach by Regional Fisheries Management Organizations (RFMOs) dealing with deep sea fisheries. The implementation of EAF by the RFMOs responsible for demersal and small pelagic species is reviewed and discussed. The authors suggest that future steps should include developing and adopting specific multiannual EAF management and action plans to assist RFMOs in implementing EAF. This should include setting long-term objectives and targets. The process of developing these plans would be enhanced through discussions within joint science-management meetings and workshops within RFMOs.
papers.summary_cn: 本文探讨了深海区域渔业管理组织（RFMOs）实施生态系统方法（EAF）的现状与挑战，梳理了EAF在国际法中的纳入情况及现有指导框架，并回顾了负责底层鱼类和小型中上层鱼类的RFMOs的EAF实施进展。作者建议未来应制定并通过具体的多年期EAF管理计划与行动计划，设定长期目标与指标，并通过RFMOs内部科学-管理联合会议与研讨会推动相关进程。

papers.title: Advancing an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management in the Northeast Atlantic: ICES’s Scientific Framework, Advice Products, and Implementation Pathways
papers.authors: Salvany, Lara; Campbell, Neil; Martinez, Inigo; Cooper, Anne; Lordan, Colm
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: Achieving marine management objectives and long-term sustainability requires moving beyond conventional, single-species management, towards an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management (EAFM), that accounts for complex ecological interactions, cumulative human pressures, and environmental variability. The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) advances EAFM in the Northeast Atlantic by providing scientific frameworks and advice products that address fundamental aspects of EAFM: understanding the ecosystem’s influence on fisheries, quantifying fisheries’ impact on the wider ecosystem, contextualizing fisheries among other pressures, and analyzing trade-offs between competing management objectives. Examples are provided for ICES integration of ecosystem information into advice, including the ecosystem-based fishing mortality reference point (FECO), the regional benthic impact assessments and trade-off analysis and the ICES Framework for Ecosystem-Informed Science and Advice (FEISA). These examples illustrate how ICES is moving from the single species model and contextual ecosystem assessment towards more operational ecosystem-informed advice. Despite progress, key challenges remain, including a fragmented governance structure and a lack of clear, formalized process translating ecosystem advice into management actions. Furthermore, there are significant data gaps concerning social and economic dimensions that need to be addressed to truly achieve a comprehensive EAFM.
papers.summary_cn: 本文旨在阐述ICES在东北大西洋推进Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management (EAFM)的科学框架、建议产品及实施路径。ICES通过整合生态系统信息，开发了ecosystem-based fishing mortality reference point (FECO)、区域性底栖影响评估与权衡分析以及FEISA框架等工具，推动从单鱼种评估向可操作的生态系统知情建议转变。然而，治理结构碎片化、生态系统建议向管理行动转化的正式机制缺失以及社会经济维度数据不足，仍是全面实现EAFM的主要挑战。

papers.title: Diets of Macrobrachium species in Lower Orashi River, Niger Delta, Nigeria: Implication for Ecosystem Conservation and Sustainable Shrimp Fisheries
papers.authors: Amachree, D
papers.journal: JOURNAL OF BIOLOGY AND GENETIC RESEARCH
papers.abstract: Food and feeding habits are crucial tools for stock management and play a significant role in investigating trophic relationships within aquatic communities. The diets of three Macrobrachium species: Macrobrachium felicinum, Macrobrachium macrobrachion, and Macrobrachium vollenhovenii in the Lower Orashi River were studied over 12 months (December 2019–November 2020) using the frequency of occurrence and numerical methods. The results indicated that a total of 880 food items were observed in the guts of M. vollenhovenii. Out of which, Chlorophyta (n=339; 38.53%) was the highest and the least was Chrysophyta (n=3; 0.34%) In the Chlorophyta category, Chlorella vulgaris (n=135; 15.34%) contributed the highest. The frequency of occurrence method indicated Cyanophyta (n=31; 31.31%) as the most frequently occurred category of food item. Six hundred and ninety-seven (697) food items were found in the guts of M. felicinum with Bacillariophyta (n=400; 57.38%) recorded as the highest number of food items and the least was Crustaceans (n=6; 0.86%) Dinophyta, Charophyta and Rhodophyta were absent in the gut content. In Bacillariophyta category, Melosira varians contributed highest (n=240; 34.43%). Likewise, the frequency of occurrence method indicated Bacillariophyta (n=38; 38.77%) as the most frequently occurring food for M. felicinum. A total of 1006 food items was found in the guts of M. macrobrachion, with the highest number of food item recorded as Bacillariophyta (n=366; 36.40%) and least was Crustaceans (n=3; 0.30%). Chrysophyta, Insects, Charophyta, and Rhodophyta were absent in the gut. In Bacillariophyta category, Melosira varians contributed highest (n=223; 22.17%). For the frequency of occurrence, Chlorophyta (n=33; 33.66%) recorded the highest frequency of occurrence and least was Crustaceans (n=1; 1.02%). In conclusion, all three species of Macrobrachium from the Lower Orashi River are opportunistic omnivore feeder predominantly with preference for phytoplankton however, variations in their primary food items reflect differences in habitat preferences and ecological roles. These findings underscore the importance of phytoplankton as a foundational resource in freshwater ecosystems and the adaptability of Macrobrachium species to exploit available resources
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过12个月（2019年12月–2020年11月）的胃含物分析，采用出现频率法和数量法，调查了尼日尔三角洲Lower Orashi River中三种Macrobrachium（M. felicinum、M. macrobrachion、M. vollenhovenii）的食性。结果表明三种虾均为机会性杂食者，以phytoplankton为主，但主要饵料组成存在种间差异：M. vollenhovenii以Chlorophyta为主，M. felicinum和M. macrobrachion均以Bacillariophyta为主。研究揭示了phytoplankton作为淡水生态系统基础资源的重要性及Macrobrachium属对可用资源的适应性，为stock management和可持续shrimp fisheries提供依据。

papers.title: From Principle to Practice: A Pragmatic Pathway for Ecosystem-Based Fisheries Management in a Data-limited RFMO
papers.authors: Milardi, Marco
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: The Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA) is legally mandated through its founding agreement to implement an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management (EAFM). However, like many Regional Fisheries Management Organizations (RFMOs), translating this principle into effective practice poses significant challenges, particularly in data-limited environments. This viewpoint paper traces SIOFA’s pragmatic journey in operationalizing EAFM. We detail the organization’s early adaptive strategies, which included precautionary alignment with other RFMOs for managing seabirds and Vulnerable Marine Ecosystems (VMEs), and evidence-based conservation measures for deepwater sharks driven by targeted ecological risk assessments. While effective, these approaches highlighted a fundamental barrier: the Scientific Committee’s limited access to integrated fisheries data. In response, SIOFA developed an internal synthesis tool—the SIOFA Ecosystem Summary, to synthesize and streamline data access, thereby directly supporting science-based advice. This perspective paper argues that SIOFA’s experience demonstrates a pragmatic, phased pathway for EAFM implementation that reflects broader trends among RFMOs. While similar ecosystem synthesis tools exist in other bodies (e.g., NAFO, ICES, IOTC), SIOFA’s process is distinctive in its iterative co-development between the Secretariat and Scientific Committee within a resource-constrained setting. This paper contends that such adaptive, context-sensitive approaches offer practical insights for data-limited RFMOs seeking to operationalize EAFM.
papers.summary_cn: 本文以南方印度洋渔业协定（SIOFA）为例，探讨数据有限型RFMO如何将EAFM原则转化为实践。SIOFA早期通过与其它RFMO协同采取预防性措施管理海鸟和VMEs，并基于生态风险评估对深海鲨鱼实施养护措施，但科学委员会获取综合渔业数据的受限成为核心障碍。为此SIOFA开发了内部数据整合工具“SIOFA Ecosystem Summary”，以支持科学建议的制定。文章认为，这种在资源受限条件下由秘书处与科学委员会迭代共同开发的自适应、情境敏感路径，为数据有限型RFMO实施EAFM提供了务实的分阶段参考。

papers.title: Weak governance, cumulative impacts, and socioeconomic factors driving vulnerability in coastal small-scale fisheries
papers.authors: Jankowsky, Mayra; Machado, Ingrid Cabral; de Oliveira, Jacqueline Barbosa Mendonça; Sisdeli, Marcos; Passarelli, Isis Preti; Cardoso, Rodrigo Santana
papers.abstract: Abstract This study analyzes the dynamics of vulnerability in coastal small-scale fisheries under high level of pressure from port-industrial complex in Baixada Santista, Brazil. We employed a socioeconomic survey ( n = 401), transdisciplinary focus-group workshops ( n = 6) with fishers ( n = 40), and stakeholder semi-structured interviews ( n = 5). Our results reveal that vulnerability is multifaceted and shaped by: (i) increased exposure and sensitivity driven by cumulative environmental impacts, particularly those associated with port activities; (ii) underlying socioeconomic conditions, including gender inequality, lack of professional documentation, and irregular housing; (iii) weak governance, characterized by the absence of a formal arenas for conflict resolution and fragmented environmental licensing processes with limited participation; and (iv) adaptive capacity, present in all communities but insufficient to transform the prevailing vulnerability scenario. In addition, local environmental knowledge reveals that socioenvironmental impacts accumulated over time have intensified vulnerability by eroding the foundations of fishing livelihoods through the loss of fishing grounds and the decline of fishery resources, thereby undermining fishing territories. We conclude that transforming vulnerability in coastal small-scale fisheries requires inclusive and multi-scalar maritime governance, strengthened environmental licensing practices, and the meaningful incorporation of local ecological knowledge into decision-making processes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以巴西Baixada Santista地区为案例，综合社会经济调查（n=401）、跨学科焦点小组（n=6）及利益相关者访谈，分析了港口工业综合体高压下沿海小规模渔业的脆弱性动态。结果表明，脆弱性由累积环境影响的暴露与敏感性、性别不平等与缺乏职业登记等社会经济条件、缺乏正式冲突解决平台与碎片化环境许可程序所体现的弱治理，以及不足以扭转脆弱性局面的适应能力共同塑造；地方生态知识进一步揭示，渔场丧失与渔业资源衰退持续侵蚀捕捞生计基础。研究提出需通过包容性多尺度海洋治理、强化环境许可实践及将地方生态知识纳入决策来转变脆弱性。

papers.title: Unseen but Connected: Exploring How Connectivity Informs the Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management in the Northwest Atlantic Fisheries Organization
papers.authors: Kenchington, Ellen
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: Connectivity, a key property of marine ecosystems operating over various spatial scales, relies on movements of organisms, nutrients and energy. Those can be active, involving directed migration, or passive, the latter relying on transport by physical mechanisms that transport organisms, including gametes and larvae. Dispersal drives population dynamics and community structure, hence is an essential component to consider in an Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management (EAFM). In the Northwest Atlantic Fisheries Organization (NAFO), connectivity has been considered in a number of different contexts and applications. The distribution ranges of major marine fish species, a product of their dispersal, amongst other aspects, helped to inform the establishment of Bioregions, Ecosystem Production Units, and Ecoregions – nested spatial scales identified as relevant to the development of ecosystem summaries and management plans. For sessile and sedentary benthic species, such as the corals and sponges identified as Vulnerable Marine Ecosystem (VME) indicators, connectivity within and among high-density habitats is key to habitat formation and continuation. In such species, connectivity is governed by larval transport, predominantly by bottom currents. Recently, NAFO has used 3-D Lagrangian particle tracking models to identify connectivity networks of both the closed areas and identified VME habitats, in support of an EAFM. Here, an overview of how NAFO has incorporated information on connectivity into its decision-making processes is provided.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探讨connectivity（连通性）如何为西北大西洋渔业组织（NAFO）的Ecosystem Approach to Fisheries Management（EAFM）提供科学支撑。NAFO已将连通性信息应用于多个管理场景，包括基于主要鱼类分布范围划定Bioregions、Ecosystem Production Units和Ecoregions等嵌套空间尺度，以及利用3-D Lagrangian粒子追踪模型识别封闭区域和VME栖息地的连通性网络。对于珊瑚和海绵等VME指示种的底栖固着生物，幼虫随底层洋流的输运决定了栖息地的形成与维持。该综述系统梳理了NAFO将连通性纳入决策过程的实践路径。

papers.title: Standards to Inform an Ecosystem Approach to Deep-sea Bottom Fisheries Management in the High Seas: Examples from the South Pacific Ocean
papers.authors: Tablada, Jordi; Geange, Shane; Arkhipkin, Alexander; Biggerstaff, Andrew; Tunley, Karen; Cryer, Martin; Timmiss, Trent; Hiddink, Jan; Georgeson, Lee; Rowden, Ashley
papers.journal: Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science
papers.abstract: The South Pacific Regional Fisheries Management Organisation (SPRFMO) Convention requires consideration of risks and impacts as part of an ecosystem approach to fisheries management. In SPRFMO, assessments of the impact of demersal fisheries are guided by the Bottom Fishery Impact Assessment Standard and the Encounter Review Standard. The Bottom Fishery Impact Assessment Standard describes a standardised approach for assessing cumulative impacts of bottom fishing, including for new and exploratory fisheries, on Vulnerable Marine Ecosystems (VMEs), deep-sea fish stocks and marine mammals, reptiles, seabirds and other species of concern. The Encounter Review Standard describes responsibilities when reviewing potential encounters with VMEs, which occur when bycatch of VME indicator taxa (e.g., stony corals) in any trawl tow reach or exceed predefined encounter thresholds, resulting in temporary suspension of fishing in the encounter area. Both the Bottom Fishery Impact Assessment Standard and the Encounter Review Standard are periodically updated to reflect best practice, alignment with the FAO International Guidelines for the Management of Deep-sea Fisheries in the High Seas, and account for the best available scientific information required to protect VMEs from significant adverse impacts while ensuring sustainable management of bottom fisheries. Here, we detail the structure and function of these two standards, their periodic updates to reflect best practice and scientific knowledge, and their role in operationalising an ecosystem approach. We also discuss gaps, uncertainties, and potential future improvements for these standards, including the need for better integration of cumulative impacts (such as climate change and cross-sectoral pressures) into the standards, and the usefulness of having universal assessment standards for RFMOs. Through the examples from SPRFMO, we illustrate the importance and role standards can play in achieving sustainable, science-based management of deep-sea fisheries in areas beyond national jurisdiction.
papers.summary_cn: 南太平洋区域渔业管理组织（SPRFMO）依据其《底层渔业影响评估标准》和《遭遇审查标准》，对底层渔业累积影响及VME遭遇事件实施规范化管理，以落实生态系统方法。前者用于评估底层捕捞对新开发渔业及VMEs、深海鱼类种群和受关注物种的累积影响，后者规定当VME指示类群（如石珊瑚）兼捕量达到或超过预设阈值时，须暂停该区域捕捞。两套标准定期更新以反映最佳实践并与FAO《公海深海渔业管理国际准则》保持一致，但目前在累积影响（如气候变化和跨部门压力）整合及RFMO通用评估标准方面仍存在不足。

papers.title:
Joint Effects of
Water Quality Degradation and Non-Native
Fish Invasion on Estuarine Biodiversity and Ecosystem Stability
papers.authors: Yang, Jianghua; Li, Huizhen; Zhang, Yan; Mu, Yawen; Song, Chao; Zhang, Lijuan; You, Jing; Zhang, Xiaowei
papers.abstract: Abstract Water quality degradation and biological invasions represent major drivers of global ecosystem degradation, yet their interactive effects remain poorly understood, especially in anthropogenically disturbed estuarine ecosystems. Here, we employed environmental DNA (eDNA) metabarcoding to characterize multi-trophic biological communities in a subtropical estuary and to assess how water-quality degradation influences the invasion success of non-native fishes. The results show, firstly, the relative sequence abundance of non-native fish, rather than their species richness, emerged as the primary factor negatively associated with native fish diversity. Based on the observational dataset, we identified a statistical breakpoint, and the transition from low to high invasion pressure corresponds to a unimodal (hump-shaped) diversity pattern. Secondly, non-native fish primarily compete for food resources, thereby constraining the ecological niches of native species. Thirdly, a strong interactive effect exists between water quality degradation and non-native fish invasion. Water quality degradation acts not merely as a direct environmental stressor, but also indirectly weakens native communities. Collectively, these findings provide new insights into how declines in water quality interact with biological invasions and highlight the need for integrated invasion management strategies that simultaneously improve water quality and mitigate the impacts of invasive species in estuarine ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用 eDNA metabarcoding 解析亚热带河口多营养级生物群落，探讨水质退化与非本地鱼类入侵对本地鱼类多样性和生态系统稳定性的交互影响。结果显示，非本地鱼类的相对序列丰度（而非物种丰富度）是本地鱼类多样性下降的主要负相关因子，且入侵压力由低转高时多样性呈单峰（驼峰型）格局；非本地鱼类主要通过竞争食物资源压缩本地种的生态位。水质退化与非本地鱼类入侵存在强交互效应，水质退化不仅作为直接环境胁迫，还间接削弱本地群落，提示河口生态系统需采取水质改善与入侵物种管控相结合的综合管理策略。

papers.title: The fish assemblage of a Mexican protected spring system dominated by exotic fishes
papers.authors: Contreras-MacBeath, Topiltzin; Moreno Romero, Masiel; Mejía Mojica, Humberto; Rivas González, Juan Manuel; Sandoval Manríque, Juan Carlos; Hernández Arias, Juan Alberto; González Gavito, Enrique
papers.abstract: Springs, as sensitive freshwater ecosystems, are particularly vulnerable to anthropogenic factors such as water extraction, pollution, and climate change. Las Estacas spring in Central Mexico, managed as a water park within a state reserve, serves as an ideal space for environmental education and conservation efforts. Snorkel surveys identified 14 fish species, with 70% being invasive and most of these come from ornamental fish. We computed multiple diversity indices and evaluated sampling completeness through rarefaction analysis. The fish assemblage was dominated by Xiphophorus helerii and Amatitlania nigrofasciata with 23% and 21% of the sample respectively, it exhibited moderate diversity (Shannon H’ = 1.955) with relatively even species distribution (Pielou’s J’ = 0.741). Rarefaction analysis confirmed adequate sampling effort, with the curve approaching asymptote at approximately 3,501 individuals (95% of observed richness). The findings provide baseline biodiversity metrics essential for conservation monitoring and ecosystem management. To address this, a rewilding project is now in place, with the goal to establish a fish assemblage dominated by native species through habitat management, exotic species control, native species introduction, and education.
papers.summary_cn: 对墨西哥中部Las Estacas泉水系统（州保护区内水上公园）开展浮潜调查，记录14种鱼类，其中70%为入侵种且多源于观赏鱼。鱼类群落以Xiphophorus hellerii（23%）和Amatitlania nigrofasciata（21%）为主，Shannon H'=1.955、Pielou's J'=0.741，多样性中等且分布较均匀；稀释分析表明采样充分。研究提供了基线生物多样性指标，并据此启动rewilding项目，通过栖息地管理、exotic species控制、native species引入及环境教育，重建以本地种为主的鱼类群落。

papers.title: Prevalence of fish parasites from Lake Hawassa, Ethiopia
papers.authors: Efa, Debela Abdeta; Akasa, Megersa; Tamiru, Yobsan
papers.abstract: Background An estimated 200 species of fishes of marine and freshwater fish are known to occur in Ethiopia. Fish parasites are the main cause of the significant threat to the fish biodiversity of Ethiopia’s freshwater islands. Lake Hawassa plays a central role in the local economy of the city which supports the artisanal fishing sector. The parasite of the fishes at lake Hawassa are hitherto poorly known and there are limited reports on the type of parasites across different fish hosts such as size, age, sex, condition factor, or other biological or ecological traits. Methods A cross-sectional study was carried out in 2023–2024 to estimate the prevalence of fish parasites and host factors. In the current survey Oreochromis niloticus (n = 135 ) , Clarias gariepinus (n = 87), and Labeobarbus intermedius (n = 43) were sampled. Internal and external organs was inspected for the presence of the parasite affecting their health and wellbeing. Some external parasites were extracted from the fresh water immediately after fish were caught. The randomly selected host was classified based on species, sex, body weight, and the total body length. Parasites are identified morphologically at genera level using standard identification keys and pictorial guide. Analysed data were presented as frequencies, percentages, mean intensity, and mean abundance. Chi-square and P-values were considered for statistical association. Results The parasite distribution varies with sex, body weight, and standard length of the studied fish. The overall infection/infestation rate is 88.30% (n = 234). A total of 1748 parasites classified under Nematodes (e.g., Contracaecum), Digenean trematodes (e.g., Clinostomum, Euclinostomum, Diplostomum, encysted metacercariae), Monogeneans (Dactylogyrus), Myxozoans (Myxobolus spp.), Crustacean ectoparasites (Argulus, Dolops), Hirudinea (leeches)was collected from O. niloticus (788), C. gariepinus (642) and L. intermedius (318). The internal parasites recovered from O. niloticus were Clinostomum (65.16%), Euclinostomum (34.07%), Contracaecum (26.67%) , and Diplostomum (24.44%). Higher number of Myxobolus species, leeches, Argulus , and Dolops species was also recorded. Digenean encysted metacercaria (68.97%) and Contracaecum species (50.57%) are the most common parasite species infecting C. gariepinus . Diplostomum species , Dactylogyrus species , leeches, Argulus species , and Dolops species pose a serious threat to fish health in lake Hawassa. The mean intensity of the parasites in L. intermedius , C. gariepinus and O . niloticus was found to be 8.59, 7.92 and 6.79 while mean abundance is 7.40, 7.37 and 5.84 respectively. Conclusion This study found that various body parts are contaminated with one or more parasites. Some of those parasites have established zoonosis or cause cross infection to other fishes requiring urgent cooperation in performing pre-stock assessment for optimal production and maintaining the heath of fishery and hence human being.
papers.summary_cn: 2023—2024年在埃塞俄比亚Hawassa湖开展横断面调查，对尼罗罗非鱼（n=135）、革胡子鲶（n=87）和中间唇齿鲤（n=43）进行寄生虫检查，以评估鱼类寄生虫感染率及其与宿主性别、体重和体长的关系。共采集1748个寄生虫，隶属线虫、复殖吸虫、单殖吸虫、黏体动物、甲壳类外寄生虫及蛭类，总体感染率高达88.30%。复殖吸虫囊蚴和Contracaecum spp.在革胡子鲶中最为常见，部分寄生虫具有人兽共患风险，建议在stock assessment中纳入寄生虫监测以保障渔业健康和人类安全。

papers.title: Valorization of Aquaculture Residues by Heterotrophic Cultivation of the Extremophilic Microalga Galdieria Sulphuraria for Protein- and Phycocyanin-Rich Biomass Production
papers.authors: Kleps, Corina; Händel, Nicole; Schönfelder, Stephanie; Baum, Luisa; Ogurek, Michael; Pleissner, Daniel
papers.abstract: Abstract This study evaluated a bioprocess using the thermo-acidophilic red microalga Galdieria sulphuraria to convert shrimp- and sludge-derived residues into biomass and pigments. Shrimp residues contained 57% (w/w) protein and 11% (w/w) lipids, whereas sludge contained 28–32% (w/w) protein and 13% (w/w) carbohydrates. Enzymatic and acid-assisted hydrolyses were tested for nutrient release. Free amino nitrogen (FAN) from sludge hydrolysates remained low (1–2 mg g − 1 ), while shrimp residues produced 10-15-fold higher FAN. In flask cultures, G. sulphuraria grew in 25–50% (v/v) sludge hydrolysate, reaching a maximum growth rate of 1.3 d − 1 at 50% (v/v) with 2.5 g L − 1 glucose. Higher sludge (≥ 75%, v/v) or shrimp hydrolysate (≥ 25%, v/v) inhibited growth. In fed-batch, blending 15% (v/v) sludge and 10% (v/v) shrimp hydrolysates with 10 g L − 1 glucose increased FAN and supported 1.2 d − 1 initial growth; phycocyanin reached 8 mg g − 1 . Feeding 70% sludge and 30% shrimp hydrolysate plus 22.5 g L − 1 glucose yielded 9–10 g L − 1 biomass with 47–62% (w/w) protein. Amino-acid screening showed strong specificity: ammonium sulfate supported 0.95 d − 1 , with alanine (0.87 d − 1 ) and proline (0.80 d − 1 ) as alternatives. These results define constraints and control points for decentralized residue-to-biomass conversion in a circular bioeconomy.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了嗜热嗜酸红微藻 Galdieria sulphuraria 异养转化虾类与污泥残余物生产富含蛋白和藻蓝蛋白生物质的生物工艺。虾残余物蛋白含量达57%（w/w），污泥水解液中游离氨基酸氮（FAN）较低（1–2 mg g⁻¹），而虾水解液FAN高出10–15倍。补料分批培养中，70%污泥+30%虾水解液配合22.5 g L⁻¹葡萄糖可获得9–10 g L⁻¹生物量，蛋白含量47–62%（w/w），藻蓝蛋白达8 mg g⁻¹。结果表明该工艺在循环生物经济中具有分散式残余物转化为生物质的潜力，但需优化水解液配比以解除高浓度抑制。

papers.title: Genetic Diversity and Population Structure of Wild Macrobrachium nipponense in the Pearl River Basin: A Treasury of Germplasm for Aquaculture and Conservation
papers.authors: Dong, Hao; Fang, Xiaofan; Zhang, Yuefan; Jin, Shubo; Zhang, Wenyi; Xiong, Yiwei; Qiao, Hui; Jiang, Sufei
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the genetic diversity and population structure of wild M. nipponense populations in the Pearl River Basin based on mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) D-loop sequences. A total of 14 wild populations were collected from the West River, North River, and Pearl River Delta, and genetic diversity and population differentiation were assessed using haplotype analysis, analysis of molecular variance (AMOVA), pairwise FST, and principal component analysis (PCA). A total of 351 variable sites were identified. The overall haplotype diversity (h) and nucleotide diversity (π) were 0.947 and 0.03665, respectively, indicating high genetic diversity across the Pearl River Basin. Significant genetic differentiation was detected among populations (FST = 0.3785, p-value < 0.001), with 37.85% of genetic variation occurring among populations. PCA revealed distinct genetic relationships among populations, supporting the presence of population genetic structure within the Pearl River Basin. Populations from Tian’e County, Xilin County, Dahua Yao Autonomous County, and other upper tributaries of the West River exhibited distinct genetic characteristics compared with populations from Zhaoqing City, Guiping City, Guangzhou City, and the middle and lower reaches of the West River and the Pearl River estuary. Among the 14 populations, those from Zhaoqing City, Guiping City, and Guangzhou City exhibited relatively high genetic diversity and distinctive genetic characteristics. These findings suggest that the complex hydrological structure and historical connectivity of the Pearl River Basin have contributed to the observed population genetic structure. The genetically diverse populations identified in this study represent valuable wild germplasm resources for the conservation and selective breeding of M. nipponense.
papers.summary_cn: 基于mtDNA D-loop序列评估了珠江流域14个野生日本沼虾（Macrobrachium nipponense）群体的遗传多样性与群体结构。结果显示整体单倍型多样性（h=0.947）和核苷酸多样性（π=0.03665）较高，群体间存在显著遗传分化（FST=0.3785, p<0.001），37.85%的遗传变异来源于群体间。西江上游支流群体与中下游及珠江口群体遗传特征明显不同，其中肇庆、桂平、广州群体遗传多样性较高且具独特遗传特征，可作为种质保护和选育的宝贵野生种质资源。

papers.title: USP6-FISH Negative Nodular Fasciitis: Benign Impostor of the Orbit
papers.authors: Suri, Kashviya; Lee, April; Seth, Neha; Coombs, Allison
papers.abstract: Nodular fasciitis (NF) is a benign, rapidly growing myofibroblastic proliferation that can closely mimic sarcoma clinically, radiographically, and histologically, posing a significant diagnostic challenge. We report a case of an 11-year-old boy presenting with a painless but progressively enlarging periorbital mass initially suspected to be a dermoid cyst. Although his ultrasound was reassuring, MRI showed an enhancing lesion concerning for neoplasm, prompting surgical excision. Histopathologic evaluation revealed spindle-cell proliferation within a myxoid stroma consistent with NF. However, the USP6 fluorescence in situ hybridization analysis was negative. Further genomic analysis identified a rare USP6–PAFAH1B1 fusion. This case highlights a diagnostically challenging subset of NF in which conventional USP6 fluorescence in situ hybridization testing may be negative, necessitating next-generation sequencing for a definitive diagnosis. Increased awareness of NF and its clinical, histologic, genetic, and radiographic presentation is essential to avoid misdiagnosis and to guide appropriate management.

papers.title: In Vitro Screening of Butcher’s Broom (Ruscus aculeatus L.) Cladodes and Aerial Parts Extracts Against Fish Pathogen Isolates
papers.authors: Demirkale, İbrahim; Bikzad, Hasibullah; Etyemez Büyükdeveci, Miray; Secer, Faik Sertel
papers.abstract: The growing need for sustainable alternatives to antibiotics in aquaculture has increased interest in plant-derived antimicrobial compounds. This study characterized ethanol and methanol extracts from the cladodes and aerial parts of butcher’s broom (Ruscus aculeatus L.) by GC–MS and screened, as a preliminary in vitro assessment, their antibacterial activity against Aeromonas hydrophila, Lactococcus garvieae, Vibrio anguillarum, Edwardsiella tarda, and Yersinia ruckeri. The extracts showed distinct chemical profiles. Phytol showed the highest relative chromatographic abundance in the ethanol cladode extract (25.16% of the total ion chromatogram peak area), whereas n-hexadecanoic acid dominated the ethanol aerial parts extract (42.08%). In the methanol cladode extract, the most abundant peak was a co-eluting group (2,2-dimethylbutane/1,2-dimethylaziridine/oxalic acid isobutyl pentyl ester; 22.21%), followed by methyl 9,12,15-octadecatrienoate (14.64%) and phytol (7.86%), while the methanol aerial parts extract was characterized by a 4H-pyran-4-one derivative (16.41%). Antibacterial activity varied with extract, pathogen, and dose, with maximum inhibition zones of 25.0 ± 1.0 mm against A. hydrophila, 24.0 ± 1.0 mm against Y. ruckeri, and 23.7 ± 0.6 mm against V. anguillarum. The E. tarda isolate was the least susceptible. These preliminary findings provide the first evidence of antibacterial activity of R. aculeatus extracts against fish pathogens and support further investigation of this species as a potential source of antimicrobial phytochemicals for aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过GC–MS分析了假叶树（Ruscus aculeatus L.）叶状枝和地上部分的乙醇及甲醇提取物化学成分，并体外筛选其对Aeromonas hydrophila、Lactococcus garvieae、Vibrio anguillarum、Edwardsiella tarda和Yersinia ruckeri等鱼类病原菌的抗菌活性。不同提取物化学谱差异明显，乙醇叶状枝提取物以phytol为主（25.16%），乙醇地上部分提取物以n-hexadecanoic acid为主（42.08%）。抗菌活性因提取物、病原菌和剂量而异，对A. hydrophila、Y. ruckeri和V. anguillarum的最大抑菌圈分别达25.0 ± 1.0 mm、24.0 ± 1.0 mm和23.7 ± 0.6 mm，E. tarda最不敏感。该研究首次报道假叶树提取物对鱼类病原菌的抗菌活性，为其作为水产养殖抗菌植物化学物来源提供了初步依据。

papers.title: Spatial heterogeneity analysis of marine influence on China
papers.authors: Zhao, Yifei; Wang, Dawei; Zhang, Yiman; Yang, Zhaoqin; Liu, Wenhan
papers.abstract: Objective/Introduction The ocean has exerted a growing influence on human societal development over time. Investigating this influence at the national level is essential for informed marine spatial planning and policy-making. However, empirical assessments are often constrained by the scarcity and unstructured nature of relevant data. Methods To address this gap, this study proposes an innovative analytical framework that integrates latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) topic modeling with complex network theory. Using Internet-based marine news big data, we systematically evaluate the impact of the ocean on China across three analytical dimensions: spatial differentiation, agglomeration characteristics, and diffusion pathways. Accordingly, we construct three complex networks—namely, the network of ocean impact on China, the sea-rail intermodal transport network, and the marine ecology network—to capture the interregional associations among urban marine activities, including economy, transportation, culture, and ecology. Results The findings reveal three key insights. (i) The influence of the ocean on China exhibits pronounced regional heterogeneity. (ii) Cities affected by similar marine activities are broadly clustered into three networked regions: the Bohai Rim region, the Yangtze River Delta region, and the Pan-Pearl River Delta region. (iii) The impact extends from coastal to inland areas through three primary diffusion modes, i.e., sea-rail multimodal transport, marine culture dissemination, and marine ecological connectivity. Discussion/Conclusion This study offers a scalable and data-driven paradigm for assessing marine influence using unstructured media data. The proposed framework provides valuable references for marine spatial planning and regional coordination, and it can be adapted to other countries or regions facing similar data limitations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于互联网海洋新闻大数据，将LDA主题模型与复杂网络理论相结合，从空间分异、集聚特征和扩散路径三个维度评估海洋对中国的影响。通过构建海洋影响网络、海铁联运网络和海洋生态网络，揭示海洋影响呈现显著区域异质性，受影响城市大致聚为环渤海、长三角和泛珠三角三大网络化区域，并经由海铁多式联运、海洋文化传播和海洋生态连通三种模式由沿海向内陆扩散。该框架为海洋空间规划与区域协调提供了可扩展的数据驱动分析范式。

papers.title: Mimicking the mountains: Using spatial characteristics of unharvested habitat to guide working forest management for a rare, forest-dependent songbird
papers.authors: Longo, James P; Roth, Amber M.; Tremblay, Junior A.; Thomas, Peter W
papers.abstract: Management of the rare Bicknell’s Thrush (Catharus bicknelli) is increasingly a forestry-driven challenge, as most nesting habitat in Canada now occurs within working forest landscapes. This species primarily nests in short, dense red spruce (Picea rubens) and balsam fir (Abies balsamea) forests generated by natural disturbance and regenerating timber harvests in northeastern North America. While structural requirements of the species’ habitat are known, information about the amount and arrangement of these patches would aid foresters with timber harvest planning. Using remotely-sensed data and citizen science point count surveys, we define the specific configuration, structure, and composition of forest patches. Our results suggest that aggregated patches of short, dense, spruce-fir forest are preferred over non-aggregated patches of the same total area. Sites where Bicknell's Thrush were detected contained nearly double the amount of dense spruce-fir habitat (mean = 20.15 ha) compared to unoccupied sites (mean = 11.89 ha). Evaluation against datasets from harvested forest landscapes confirmed the spatial relationships identified in unharvested mountain habitats and reliably predicted thrush abundance. We recommend using even-aged silviculture to maintain a shifting mosaic of >20 hectare spruce-fir stands to maintain nesting habitat analogous to the natural landscape mosaics to which the species is evolutionarily adapted.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在明确稀有Bicknell's Thrush（Catharus bicknelli）巢址森林斑块的空间配置、结构与组成，以指导工作林经营规划。利用遥感数据和公民科学样点调查，发现聚集分布的矮密云杉-冷杉林斑块优于同等总面积的非聚集斑块，有该鸟分布的样地矮密云杉-冷杉林面积（均值20.15 ha）近为无分布样地（均值11.89 ha）的两倍。基于采伐林景观数据集的验证确认了上述空间关系并能可靠预测该鸟丰度，建议采用同龄林silviculture维持>20 ha云杉-冷杉林斑块的动态镶嵌格局。

papers.title: Reproductive patterns of massive Porites from the Ningaloo World Heritage Reef, Western Australia
papers.authors: Juszkiewicz, David J.; Holdsworth, Zoe A.; Nesbit, Michael L.; Kraemer, Lindsey A.; Quigley, Kate M.; Richards, Zoe T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Scleractinian coral populations are declining globally under ocean warming, with repeated mass mortality events increasingly compromising the persistence of coral reefs. Successful reproduction, larval supply and recruitment are critical processes for recovery, yet many aspects of reproductive biology remain poorly resolved for most reef-building taxa, including massive Porites . This study compared reproductive patterns among species in the Porites lobata complex ( Porites lobata Dana, 1846, Porites lutea Milne Edwards & Haime, 1851 and Porites australiensis Vaughan, 1918) using detailed macro- and micro-morphological analyses to identify key diagnostic traits. Our results provide the first insights into the reproductive phenology of massive Porites species at Ningaloo World Heritage Reef. Mature gametes were observed in P . lobata and P . lutea colonies in early autumn (March 2024), coinciding with the region’s peak mass coral spawning event. In contrast, P . australiensis colonies showed no signs of gravidity in either late winter (August 2023) or early autumn (March 2024). Differential spawning times may serve to reinforce reproductive isolation and promote the species divergence of P . australiensis at this location, and this needs to be tested within a phylogeographic framework. Early autumn spawning of P . lobata and P . lutea at Ningaloo differs from the early summer spawning reported for conspecies within the P . lobata complex at Dampier, Western Australia. Regional differences in spawning phenology have potential implications for reproductive isolation, larval connectivity, and local adaptation. Overall, these findings provide preliminary data on the timing of spawning and species boundaries of key Porites species at Ningaloo Reef and highlight the need for broader temporal, spatial, and in-situ spawning observations.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以形态学分析比较了Ningaloo世界遗产礁区 *Porites lobata* complex 中三个物种（*P. lobata*、*P. lutea*、*P. australiensis*）的繁殖模式，首次报道了该区域 massive *Porites* 的繁殖物候。结果显示 *P. lobata* 和 *P. lutea* 于2024年3月初秋出现成熟配子，与当地珊瑚大规模产卵高峰期一致，而 *P. australiensis* 在2023年8月及2024年3月均未见妊娠迹象。产卵时间的差异可能强化生殖隔离并促进 *P. australiensis* 在该地的物种分化，且Ningaloo种群初秋产卵与西澳Dampier同复合种初夏产卵的区域差异对生殖隔离、幼体连通性及本地适应具有潜在意义。

papers.title: Migration and repeat spawning dynamics of acoustically tagged Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) kelts through the Gulf of St. Lawrence
papers.authors: Perry, Heather; Daniels, Jason M; Carr, Jonathan W.; Chafe, Graham; Gillis, Carole-Anne; Jacobs, Keelan; MacNeill, Michael; Ouellet, Valerie; Reid, Jenny; Whoriskey, Frederick G.
papers.abstract: Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) display diverse life history strategies, with some spawning more than once. Repeat spawners are often overlooked in population assessments. We analyzed acoustic telemetry data from 530 post-spawned salmon (kelts) tagged in three Canadian rivers (Miramichi, Restigouche, Cascapedia) over 11 years (2008–2019) to examine (1) the frequency of repeat spawning across populations and time, (2) the relative importance of consecutive versus alternate reconditioning strategies, and (3) spatial and temporal migration dynamics through the Gulf of St. Lawrence (GoSL). Overall, 15.5% of tagged kelts were detected returning to rivers to spawn in consecutive (8.4%) or alternate years (6.8%). Alternate spawners from all three rivers entered the labrador sea through the Straight of Belle Isle synchronously, suggesting an environmental influence. Our findings reveal population-specific variation and condition-dependent plasticity in reconditioning behaviour, highlighting the importance of accounting for repeat spawners in assessments and management of Atlantic salmon populations to promote their resilience.
papers.summary_cn: 基于11年（2008–2019）加拿大三条河流530尾声学标记产后大西洋鲑（kelts）的遥测数据，分析了重复产卵频率、连续与隔年再成熟策略的相对重要性及经圣劳伦斯湾的时空迁移动态。结果显示15.5%的标记个体返回河流产卵，其中连续年份占8.4%、隔年占6.8%；三条河流的隔年产卵者同步经Belle Isle海峡进入Labrador海，提示环境因素的影响。研究表明再成熟行为存在种群特异性差异和条件依赖性可塑性，强调在 stock assessment 与管理中纳入 repeat spawners 对提升种群恢复力的重要性。

papers.title: Movement-informed projections of Bristol Bay red king crab distribution to support spatial management decisions
papers.authors: Hardison, Sean; Fedewa, Erin J; Zacher, Leah S; Thorson, James T; Ryznar, Emily Rose; Kearney, Kelly A; Hennessey, Shannon M; Daly, Benjamin J.; Goodman, Scott; Litzow, Michael A.
papers.abstract: Seasonal patterns in Bristol Bay red king crab (BBRKC; Paralithodes camtschaticus) distribution are largely informed by fisheries-independent surveys during the late spring and catch observations from the directed fishery in the following autumn. These data suggest that the stock undertakes a spring-autumn migration, although the environmental drivers associated with this migration are not well characterized. We fit an advection-diffusion model to pop-up satellite archival tag data to estimate the habitat preferences of mature male BBRKC during the late spring-autumn migration, and used this model to project BBRKC distribution from the late spring to the autumn during 2005-2024. We found that BBRKC movements were explained by a preference for cooler temperatures in central Bristol Bay in October, with preference for shallow habitats at low tidal current velocities and deeper habitats at higher velocities. Overlap analysis showed that projected distributions skillfully predicted interannual spatial variation in directed BBRKC fishery catches. Our results offer new insights into the environmental drivers of seasonal BBRKC migration and demonstrate the utility of movement-integrated species distribution models.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用弹出式卫星档案标记数据拟合 advection-diffusion 模型，估算成熟雄性 Bristol Bay 红帝王蟹（BBRKC）在春末至秋季迁移期间的栖息地偏好，并据此预测2005—2024年间的分布变化。结果显示，其移动受10月中央Bristol Bay较冷温度偏好驱动，并表现为低潮流速时偏好浅水、高流速时偏好深水。预测分布能有效反映定向渔业捕捞量的年际空间变异，表明 movement-integrated 物种分布模型可用于支持空间管理决策。

papers.title: The Critically Endangered green sawfish (Pristis zijsron): current knowledge and future directions
papers.authors: Ingelbrecht, Jack; Wueringer, Barbara E.; Dornan, Tyler N.; Dantas, Penelope T.; Fazeldean, Travis; Morgan, David L.
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.abstract: Abstract The sawfishes (Pristidae) are a group of large-bodied, shark-like rays that are among the most threatened marine fishes, having experienced substantial population declines over the past century, primarily due to overfishing and habitat loss. The green sawfish ( Pristis zijsron ) was once among the most understudied pristids; however, following an increase in scientific investigations conducted in recent years, it is currently one of the most thoroughly researched sawfish species. The purpose of this targeted literature review was to determine the current knowledge of P . zijsron and identify critical knowledge gaps in our understanding of this species. Compiled literature corresponded with the following categories: taxonomy and phylogeny; distribution, including possible extirpations and areas of uncertainty; morphology and physiology; ecology; population demography, dynamics and genetics; threats, conservation listings and protection; catch records; wildlife trade; and symbionts and pathogens. Northwestern Australia corresponded with the greatest output of contemporary P . zijsron research, likely due to the presence of viable populations in the region. Critical knowledge gaps include information on global population size and trends, area/s of occupancy, the number of subpopulations present in the wild, effective bycatch mitigation technologies, the spatial ecology of mature individuals and trophic dynamics. Furthermore, the life history, population genetics and symbionts of P . zijsron outside of Australian waters have received little attention. Successful conservation of P . zijsron will almost certainly depend on the extent to which the primary threats to this species (e.g., overfishing and habitat loss) can be effectively mitigated.
papers.summary_cn: 本文通过针对性文献综述，梳理了极危物种 green sawfish（*Pristis zijsron*）在分类、分布、形态生理、生态、种群动态与遗传、威胁及保护等方面的现有知识。研究发现，澳大利亚西北部是该物种当代研究产出最多的区域，可能与该地区存在可存活种群有关。关键知识缺口包括全球种群规模与趋势、分布区、野生亚种群数量、有效 bycatch 减缓技术、成熟个体空间生态及营养动力学，且澳大利亚水域以外的生活史、种群遗传学和共生生物研究极为匮乏。该物种的成功保护将取决于能否有效缓解 overfishing 和栖息地丧失等主要威胁。

papers.title: Description of the embryonic development in the convict cichlid ( A matitlania nigrofasciata )
papers.authors: Matsuo, Sayaka; Kusakabe, Rie; Satoh, Shun; Kambe, Kota; Fukuda, Kazuya
papers.abstract: Abstract We provide a detailed description of embryonic development in the convict cichlid ( Amatitlania nigrofasciata ) from fertilization to hatching at 26°C, together with a practical staging table anchored to established teleost reference frameworks. Fertilized eggs were obtained by both natural spawning and artificial fertilization. Oocytes were ovoid and adhesive, surrounded by a chorion and a sticky mucous layer. Early development proceeded, in broad outline, through the teleost sequence of meroblastic discoidal cleavage, blastula, gastrula, segmentation and organogenesis. The first cleavage occurred at 1.75 h post fertilization (hpf), with subsequent cleavages at 30 min intervals, reaching the 64‐cell stage at 4.25 hpf. Cleavage up to the 64‐cell stage progressed on a timescale broadly comparable to that reported for other cichlids, whereas the interval from the 64‐cell stage to early epiboly was relatively short in this species. The high, sphere and dome stages occurred at 8, 9 and 10 hpf, respectively, with epiboly initiating at the dome stage. At the dome stage, a marginal thickening interpreted as the presumptive embryonic shield became apparent. During early epiboly, the blastoderm showed pronounced spatial heterogeneity: it was consistently thicker and advanced more rapidly on the prospective embryonic axis side, yielding a readily detectable asymmetry. A morphologically distinct embryonic axis became visible at 40%–50% epiboly, and epiboly was completed at 28.5 hpf. Notably, somitogenesis began before epiboly completion (first somites at 85%–90% epiboly), indicating temporal overlap between late gastrulation and early segmentation. Major organ primordia became apparent during the overlapping segmentation/organogenesis interval, and hatching occurred around 70 hpf. Newly hatched larvae possessed three pairs of adhesive glands. This staging reference enables reproducible developmental sampling and should facilitate future comparative, mechanistic and experimental work using the convict cichlid.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在26°C条件下系统描述了九间菠萝（Amatitlania nigrofasciata）从受精到孵化的胚胎发育过程，并建立了与硬骨鱼类参考框架对应的分期表。卵为卵圆形、具黏性，经历典型的盘状卵裂、囊胚、原肠胚、体节形成和器官发生阶段，首次卵裂于1.75 hpf，孵化约在70 hpf。研究发现该物种64细胞期至早期外包阶段相对较短，且体节形成在外包完成前即已启动，表明晚期原肠胚与早期体节形成存在时间重叠。

papers.title: Heating duration alters the low-molecular-weight compound profile of fish muscle, with pyruvic acid as a potential marker of thermal history
papers.authors: Furuta, Ayumi; Sugimasab, Ryu; Saba, Miyu; Tanimoto, Shota; Mabuchi, Ryota
papers.abstract: Abstract This study used gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS)-based metabolic profiling to assess the effects of heating duration on low-molecular-weight compound profiles in fish muscle from yellowtail, chum salmon, Alaska pollock, and Pacific herring and to identify species-independent heating history markers. Heated samples were analyzed by GC-MS, followed by compound annotation and semi-quantification. Orthogonal partial least squares regression analysis indicated that heating and extended heating altered the low-molecular-weight compound profiles of fish muscle. Pyruvic acid and glycolic acid, which showed high variable importance in prediction scores, were identified as candidate heating history markers. Quantitative analysis showed that both compounds increased with heating duration. Notably, pyruvic acid showed coefficients of determination to be ≥ 0.8 for all four fish species, supporting its potential as an effective species-independent marker of fish muscle heating history.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用GC-MS代谢组学方法，分析加热时间对鰤鱼、秋鲑、阿拉斯加狭鳕和太平洋鲱鱼肌肉低分子量化合物谱的影响，以筛选不受鱼种限制的加热历史标志物。OPLS回归分析表明加热及延长加热显著改变肌肉化合物谱，丙酮酸和乙醇酸被鉴定为候选标志物。定量分析显示两者均随加热时间增加，其中丙酮酸在四种鱼中决定系数均≥0.8，可作为跨鱼种的有效加热历史标志物。

papers.title: <b>Sustainable Fisheries and Aquaculture in Kenya: Exploring Innovative Approaches to ensure Food Security while Conserving Marine Biodiversity</b>
papers.authors: OMONDI, Scholastica; OGALO, John Lenda
papers.journal: African Journal of Entrepreneurship and Innovations (AJeIN)
papers.abstract: Sustainable fisheries and aquaculture are essential for ensuring food security while conserving marine biodiversity, especially in regions dependent on aquatic resources. This paper explores innovative approaches that integrate ecological conservation with enhanced fish production, focusing on practices such as Integrated Multi-Trophic Aquaculture, community-based fisheries management, and incorporation of digital monitoring technologies. The study highlights how these innovations contribute to resilient, equitable, and sustainable ocean economies. It further examines existing governance frameworks and identifies setbacks that hinder the scalability of such approaches. The study adopts a methodology based on qualitative analysis of scholarly literature across the above identified innovative sustainable marine fisheries and aquaculture practices. It evaluates the potential of innovative advancements such as affordable recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS), Artificial Intelligence of things and integrated multi-trophic aquaculture (IMTA), and community-based fisheries management. The study finds that innovations in fisheries and aquaculture hold significant promise in enhancing productivity and reducing environmental impacts. The paper concludes that achieving long-term sustainability in fisheries and aquaculture requires coordinated efforts combining technological innovation, community-based management, and supportive policy reforms to balance food security needs with marine ecosystem health. Key Words: Blue economy, sustainable fisheries, aquaculture innovations, recirculating aquaculture systems, integrated multi-trophic aquaculture, community-based management
papers.summary_cn: 该研究旨在探讨肯尼亚在保障粮食安全与保护海洋生物多样性的双重目标下，可持续渔业与水产养殖的创新路径。通过定性文献分析，评估了 integrated multi-trophic aquaculture (IMTA)、低成本 recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS)、AIoT 数字监测技术及 community-based fisheries management 等实践的潜力。研究发现上述创新在提升生产力的同时可降低环境负面影响，但其规模化推广受制于治理框架的不足。实现长期可持续性需技术革新、社区管理与政策改革协同推进。

papers.title: Naive persistence as a benchmark for data-scarce aquaculture price forecasting: Evidence from Indonesian milkfish
papers.authors: Umam, Moch Saiful; Susanty, Aries; Sediyono, Eko
papers.summary_cn: 针对数据稀缺的印尼虱目鱼（milkfish）养殖价格预测问题，评估了朴素持续性（naive persistence）模型作为基准方法的适用性。该研究为水产养殖价格预测在数据有限条件下的模型选择提供了基准参照。

papers.title: Correction: Mixed-maturation fisheries compromise productivity and resilience of Chinook salmon
papers.authors: Gayeski, Nick; Swanson, Devin; MacDuffee, Misty; Rosenberger, Andrew
papers.summary_cn: 该文为更正说明，涉及混合成熟度渔业对奇努克鲑（Chinook salmon）生产力与种群恢复力的影响。原研究探讨选择性捕捞不同成熟度个体如何削弱种群生产力与 resilience，更正内容可能涉及数据或分析修正。

papers.title: A triangulated DPSIR assessment of fisheries sustainability and marine conservation in Pulicat region, India: integrating interview schedule and participatory rural appraisal
papers.authors: Deepak B.; Angela S., Agnes Daney; Chrispin C., Lloyd; Sudhan C.; Arunachalam R.; Kanmani S.; Sarabes N.J.
papers.abstract: Pulicat Lagoon, India's second-largest brackish water lagoon, supports diverse fisheries and coastal livelihoods but has experienced increasing environmental degradation and resource-use pressures. This study assesses the status of marine conservation and fisheries sustainability in Pulicat Lagoon using the Driver–Pressure–State–Impact–Response framework integrated with Participatory Rural Appraisal. A mixed-method sequential explanatory design was adopted. Quantitative data were collected from 213 fisheries-dependent respondents through a structured interview schedule, while qualitative information was obtained using participatory mapping, seasonal calendar analysis, and problem matrix scoring with three community focus groups. Descriptive statistics and Spearman's rank-order correlation were used for quantitative analysis, and findings from the participatory tools were triangulated with the interview schedule results. The findings indicated that high dependence on fisheries, climate variability, and increasing fishing pressure acted as major drivers of environmental change. Pollution, lagoon-mouth closure, and sedimentation emerged as the principal pressures, resulting in reduced fish availability, reduced juvenile fish observations, lower catch per unit effort, income reduction, and increased livelihood vulnerability. Although most respondents expressed willingness to adopt sustainable fishing practices, weak institutional trust and inadequate enforcement constrained effective fisheries management. The participatory tools validated the quantitative findings while providing additional insights into community priorities and seasonal livelihood dynamics. This study integrating the Driver–Pressure–State–Impact–Response framework with participatory approaches provides a comprehensive understanding of the interactions between environmental degradation, governance, and fisheries livelihoods, supporting the need for integrated, ecosystem-based, and participatory management of Pulicat region.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究采用DPSIR框架结合参与式农村评估（PRA），通过213份结构化访谈与参与式制图、季节日历及问题矩阵评分等混合方法，评估印度Pulicat潟湖的渔业可持续性与海洋保护状况。结果表明，高渔业依赖、气候变异和捕捞压力是主要驱动力，污染、潟湖口封闭和淤积为主要压力，导致鱼类资源减少、幼鱼出现率下降、CPUE降低及生计脆弱性加剧。尽管多数受访者愿意采纳可持续捕捞方式，但制度信任薄弱和执法不足制约了渔业管理成效，亟需基于生态系统的参与式综合管理。

papers.title: Translating the Policy Capacity Framework for Local  Fisheries Administration: A Theory-to-Practice Review in the  Indonesian Multilevel Governance Context
papers.authors: Fatamsya Furu; Dian Ferriswara; Ulul Albab
papers.journal: Green Social: International Journal of Law and Civil Affairs
papers.abstract: Local fisheries administration depends on policy knowledge, organizational resources, coordination, lawful authority, and public legitimacy, but these requirements are distributed across government levels and are often reduced to isolated shortages. This article examines how the Policy Capacity Framework (PCF) can support disciplined diagnosis in Indonesian local fisheries administration, using Kaimana Regency as an illustrative context grounded in public regulatory, organizational, statistical, and fisheries sources rather than as an empirical agency assessment. A theory-focused narrative review synthesized 28 verified full-text peer-reviewed sources and used four fisheries-governance studies and six official documents for contextual boundary checking. The analysis reconstructs the 3 × 3 PCF matrix, examines its contextual, dynamic, and relational boundaries, and maps the synthesis into eight diagnostic pathways. The findings show that capacity is a task-specific configuration of mutually conditioning skills and enabling resources rather than a universal score or proxy for performance. Organizational capability mediates whether individual competence can be mobilized within multilevel authority, interorganizational relations, and local operating conditions. The resulting framework covers task and demand, evidence and analysis, staff enablement, infrastructure and operations, coordination and partnerships, authority and legitimacy, adaptation and preparedness, and performance and public value. It offers diagnostic questions and conditional practice directions, not findings about the capacity of the Kaimana Fisheries Office or proof of intervention effectiveness. Responsible application therefore requires a defined policy task, verified legal authority, and organizational and contextual evidence.
papers.summary_cn: 本文旨在探讨政策能力框架（Policy Capacity Framework, PCF）如何用于印尼地方渔业行政的系统性诊断，以Kaimana Regency为背景案例，基于28篇同行评审文献及6份官方文件进行理论导向的叙事综述。研究重构了PCF的3×3矩阵，识别其情境、动态与关系边界，并归纳出八条诊断路径，涵盖任务需求、证据分析、人员赋能、基础设施、协调合作、权威合法性、适应准备及绩效公共价值等维度。研究强调政策能力是任务特定的技能与资源组合，而非通用评分，组织能力在多层治理中决定个体胜任力能否有效转化为行政效能。

papers.title: Insights into Population Structure and Spatial Connectivity of the Bluefish Pomatomus saltatrix (Teleostei: Pomatomidae) Along the Southeastern–Southern Coast of Brazil Using Fourier- and Wavelet-Based Otolith Contour Descriptors
papers.authors: Neves, Bianca M.; Daros, Felippe A.; Schroeder, Rafael; Kulzer, Rafael G.; Costa, Marcus R.; Correia, Alberto T.
papers.abstract: Otolith shape has been widely used as a tool to investigate the population structure of marine fish, as it reflects environmental, physiological, and genetic influences throughout the lives of individuals. The morphological variability of Pomatomus saltatrix sagittal otoliths along the southeastern–southern coast of Brazil was assessed using Elliptic Fourier Descriptors (EFDs) and Wavelet Transform Descriptors (WTDs). A total of 74 individuals from Rio de Janeiro (RJ, N = 25), São Paulo (SP, N = 24), and Santa Catarina (SC, N = 25) were analyzed. The coefficients obtained from both methodologies were subjected to multivariate analyses, including Permutational Multivariate Analysis of Variance (PERMANOVA) and Flexible Discriminant Analysis (FDA), combined with Jackknife Cross-Validation (JKC). The results showed high similarity in otolith shape among the sampled locations. Overall, PERMANOVA detected significant spatial differences for both EFD and WTD, although the proportion of variation explained by sampling location was low for both descriptors (<5%). After Bonferroni correction, no pairwise differences remained significant for EFD, whereas WTD indicated significant differences between SC and the other two sampling locations. Nevertheless, FDA indicated partial discrimination among sampling sites, with some overlap among groups for both descriptors. Despite this, JKC rates were high, reaching 92% for EFD and 87% for WTD. Overall, the results point to a pattern of weak spatial structuring in P. saltatrix along the southeastern–southern coast of Brazil. Although subtle morphological heterogeneity was detected among the analyzed locations, the evidence does not support the existence of completely isolated stocks. The observed patterns indicate weak spatial phenotypic differentiation and may be consistent with population connectivity; however, connectivity cannot be directly inferred from otolith shape alone and represents only one possible interpretation, as similar environmental conditions, shared growth histories, or limited discriminatory power of otolith morphology could also contribute to the observed scenario. Thus, the study reinforces the utility of otolith morphometry as a complementary tool for population studies and highlights the importance of integrating it with other phenotypic and genotypic approaches for a more comprehensive understanding of the structure of the species’ stocks.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用椭圆傅里叶描述符（EFD）和小波变换描述符（WTD）分析巴西东南—南部沿岸蓝鱼（Pomatomus saltatrix）矢耳石的形态变异，以探讨其种群结构与空间连通性。对来自Rio de Janeiro、São Paulo和Santa Catarina三个采样点的74尾个体进行PERMANOVA和FDA分析，结果显示耳石形态在各地间高度相似，采样地点仅解释不足5%的变异，空间结构微弱。尽管WTD检测到SC与其余两地间的显著差异，但整体证据不支持存在完全隔离的种群，表明该区域蓝鱼可能存在种群连通性，但耳石形态仅能作为种群研究的辅助手段。

papers.title: Immuno-FISH: Simultaneous Chromosome Painting and Immunostaining of Proteins in Maize Meiocytes
papers.authors: Zimina, Olga; Pawlowski, Wojciech P.
papers.abstract: Meiosis is of crucial importance in agriculture because it provides the genetic variation required for breeding programs. Many cytological techniques have thus been developed to study meiosis in plants. Maize provides a powerful system for cytogenetic analysis due to its large conspicuous chromosomes. This protocol outlines a method for the simultaneous visualization of specific chromosomes or their segments, alongside proteins involved in meiosis in maize germ cells. The workflow combines fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) of oligonucleotide probe cocktails (oligo-FISH) covering entire specific chromosomes, or large chromosome segments, with immunostaining of chromosomal proteins. This method enables the examination of chromosome location, structure, dynamics, and protein distribution during key meiotic events. Immuno-FISH reveals how chromosome structure and meiotic proteins interact to shape recombination, providing mechanistic insight into meiotic progression, and enabling strategies to adjust recombination patterns for plant breeding.

papers.title: Experimental and Numerical Evaluation of Fish-School Protection Configurations for a Semi-Submersible Truss Aquaculture Platform Under Severe Regular Waves
papers.authors: Cui, Wenshi; Sheng, Songwei; Zhao, Rongcheng; Yang, Shanxun; Lin, Hongjun; Rao, Xiang
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: Fish–net contact is a practical concern for exposed offshore aquaculture platforms during severe waves, yet it is seldom assessed together with platform hydrodynamics and mooring response. This study compares two protection strategies for a semi-submersible truss aquaculture platform: add-on flow-guiding structures fitted with hoods and side baffles, and a deepened-netting configuration. Tests on a 1:50 physical model under severe regular waves measured fish-school-boundary displacement, platform surge, heave and pitch, and mooring-line tension. The maximum horizontal displacement of the upwave school boundary served as an engineering proxy for the school’s tendency to approach the netting. Frequency-domain ANSYS-AQWA calculations were also used to compare wave excitation, added mass, and radiation damping. The flow-guiding structures generally reduced school-boundary displacement, but they often increased surge and mooring demand, revealing a trade-off between reduced school-boundary approach and station keeping. Under the tested conditions, the deepened-netting configuration reduced school-boundary displacement, platform motion, and mooring tension. Its fish-school response cannot, however, be attributed to netting depth alone because culture volume increased while stocking density decreased. These results provide a joint assessment of fish-school response, platform motion, and mooring load for the proposed configurations. The findings are limited to the tested severe regular waves and require validation under irregular waves, combined waves and currents, and full-scale conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 针对半潜式桁架养殖平台在极端规则波下的鱼群保护配置，该研究通过1:50物理模型试验与ANSYS-AQWA频域数值计算，比较了加装导流结构（含罩体与侧挡板）与加深网衣两种方案对鱼群边界位移、平台surge/heave/pitch及系泊张力的影响。结果表明，导流结构虽能减小鱼群边界位移，但往往增大surge与系泊需求，存在鱼群趋网抑制与station keeping之间的权衡；加深网衣配置在试验条件下同时降低了鱼群边界位移、平台运动与系泊张力，但其鱼群响应不能仅归因于网衣深度，还受养殖体积增大与放养密度降低的混杂影响。研究结论限于所测试的极端规则波条件，需在非规则波、波流联合及全尺度条件下进一步验证。

papers.title: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Aquaculture, Processing, Safety, and Traceability in the Industry of Aquatic Products: A Review
papers.authors: Chen, Jingshu; Ji, Zengtao; Sun, Chuanheng; Yang, Yi; Fan, Hongbing; Liu, Yueyue; Xu, Qian; Shi, Ce
papers.abstract: The aquatic products industry has experienced rapid development due to the growing global demand for high-quality proteins. However, conventional production models remain constrained by multifaceted impediments, including disease outbreaks, environmental stressors, microbial contamination, and operational inefficiencies in processing, quality control, and logistics. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers targeted methodological solutions to these challenges. From a functional perspective, this review categorizes artificial intelligence into four major types: perception, prediction, control, and generation, and systematically evaluates its application progress in aquaculture, processing, quality inspection, and traceability fields. Perception AI constitutes the data acquisition and digitization layer, utilizing computer vision, sonar, and multimodal fusion technologies to establish digital mappings from environmental parameters to biological indicators. Prediction AI employs machine learning and deep learning algorithms to transform historical datasets into quantitative forecasts regarding water quality dynamics, disease risks, and production trends. Control AI translates decision-making protocols into precise, autonomous regulatory actions for aquaculture environments and processing workflows through fuzzy logic and model-based predictive control. Generation AI leverages large language models and generative adversarial networks to demonstrate innovative capabilities in data augmentation, solution optimization, and virtual simulation. Collectively, these applications optimize core production processes while significantly enhancing product quality, processing efficiency, safety management, and traceability systems. Future research directions will prioritize the development of robust, interdisciplinary AI technologies with superior integration capabilities.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述针对水产行业在病害、环境胁迫、微生物污染及加工质控与物流效率等方面的瓶颈，将人工智能按功能划分为感知、预测、控制与生成四类，系统评估其在 aquaculture、加工、质量检测和 traceability 领域的应用进展。感知型AI依托计算机视觉、声呐与多模态融合实现环境参数到生物指标的数据化映射；预测型AI利用机器学习与深度学习将历史数据转化为水质动态、病害风险与产量趋势的定量预报；控制型AI通过模糊逻辑与模型预测控制实现养殖环境与加工流程的自主调控；生成型AI借助大语言模型与生成对抗网络用于数据增强、方案优化与虚拟仿真。上述应用整体上优化了核心生产流程，并显著提升了产品质量、加工效率、安全管理与 traceability 体系，未来方向为开发集成能力更强的稳健跨学科AI技术。

papers.title: Distribution and Effects of Model Palladium-Doped Nanoplastics in the Marine Mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis
papers.authors: González-Soto, Nagore; Schirinzi, Gabriella F.; Bucher, Guillaume; Bilbao, Eider; Orbea, Amaia; Mehn, Dora; Gilliland, Douglas; Serra, Miguel-Ángel; Mitrano, Denise M.; Passos, Marisa Sárria Pereira de
papers.abstract: While nanoplastics (NPs, <1 µm) concentration is anticipated to increase in the marine environment, the analytical tools for NP quantification and data on their impacts are still scarce. This work aimed to expand knowledge regarding bioaccumulation and effects of NPs on the sentinel organism Mytilus galloprovincialis. For this, mussels were dietarily exposed for 7 days to model palladium-doped-polystyrene NPs (Pd-PS NPs) of 142.6 ± 1.0 nm at 1 × 109 Pd-PS NPs/mL. ICP-MS analysis on water samples showed that after one day of exposure no Pd was detected suggesting that mussels cleared the NPs. After 7 days of exposure, 14% of the Pd introduced in the tanks was found in feces. Less than 0.02% passed into the hemolymph of mussels and consequently, no responses were observed on hemocytes. Approximately 1% of the Pd was found in soft tissues. This could be linked to the significantly higher prevalence of digestive tubule atrophy observed in exposed mussels in comparison to controls. No effects were observed at the whole organism level. In conclusion, mussels were able to uptake and to eliminate Pd-PS NPs through feces. Whether longer exposures could cause a significant accumulation of NPs and produce associated biological effects remains to be studied.
papers.summary_cn: 以模式生物紫贻贝（Mytilus galloprovincialis）为对象，通过7天膳食暴露实验研究了钯掺杂聚苯乙烯纳米塑料（Pd-PS NPs，142.6 nm）的分布与生物效应。ICP-MS分析显示，贻贝可通过粪便有效清除NPs（7天后14%的Pd经粪便排出），仅约1%进入软组织、不足0.02%进入血淋巴，未在血细胞和整体生物水平引起显著响应，但暴露组消化管萎缩发生率显著升高。研究表明贻贝能摄取并排出Pd-PS NPs，长期暴露的累积效应有待进一步研究。

papers.title: Seafood Safety Assessment of Heavy Metals in Commercial Marine Species Purchased in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia: Implications for Non-Carcinogenic Risks
papers.authors: Al-Mur, Bandar A.
papers.journal: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
papers.abstract: This study assessed the concentrations of Cd, Pb, Cu, Zn, Ni, Cr, Mn, and Fe in edible tissues of seven commercially important seafood species purchased from the central fish market in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Metal concentrations differed significantly among species (p < 0.05). Mean metal concentrations decreased in the order Fe > Zn > Cu > Cr > Mn > Ni > Pb > Cd. Overall accumulation ranking: Crustaceans > Mollusks > Cephalopods (species-dependent). The concentrations of Pb, Cu, Zn, Cr, Ni, Mn, and Fe ranged from 0.262–3.226, 0.949–18.979, 6.549–53.817, 1.007–5.686, 1.037–2.714, 0.791–4.606, and 2.183–77.490 mg/kg wet weight, respectively. Cd concentrations were below the limit of detection (LOD; 0.0234 mg/kg wet weight). Several species exceeded the applicable guideline limits for Cd and Pb. At the same time, the reference values for Cu, Zn, Ni, Mn, Fe, and Cr were interpreted descriptively, as no applicable maximum limit had been established. Individual target hazard quotient (THQ) values were below 1; however, hazard index (HI) values exceeded unity in selected species, indicating potential cumulative non-carcinogenic risks. Overall, the findings demonstrate species-specific variation in trace metal concentrations and highlight the importance of continued monitoring of commercially available seafood to support consumer safety and public health.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究测定了沙特阿拉伯吉达中央鱼市7种商业海产品可食组织中Cd、Pb、Cu、Zn、Ni、Cr、Mn和Fe的浓度，评估其非致癌健康风险。结果显示金属浓度存在显著种间差异，积累排序为甲壳类>软体类>头足类，部分物种Cd和Pb超标，单项THQ均小于1但部分物种HI超过1，提示存在累积性非致癌风险。研究强调需持续监测市售海产品以保障消费者安全。

papers.title: Ecological performance of cultivated and feral populations of an invasive freshwater fish under current and near-future climatic conditions
papers.authors: Storey, Kate; Mandrak, Nicholas E.; Ricciardi, Anthony
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Goldfish (Carassius auratus), a globally invasive species, is increasing in abundance in lakes and ponds within the Laurentian Great Lakes region. We hypothesized that current and future selection pressures imposed on feral goldfish populations adapted to urban and natural ponds would result in elevated ecological performance compared to cultivated pet-store goldfish. We tested the hypothesis experimentally by comparing the foraging efficiency (functional response metrics: maximum feeding rate and handling time) and temperature tolerance (critical thermal maximum, CTmax) of feral and cultivated goldfish under current (18°C) and projected future (26°C) surface water temperatures. After acclimation to projected temperatures, all goldfish populations displayed higher maximum feeding rates and temperature tolerances. Feral goldfish had higher maximum feeding rates than cultivated goldfish at both temperature treatments, indicating higher trophic impact potential. In contrast, CTmax did not vary significantly among populations. Collectively, these results indicate that temperature and intraspecific variation influence the foraging efficiency of goldfish and thus could mediate their ecological impacts. Population-level variation in foraging suggests that selection in urban and natural ponds may increase the ecological impact of introduced goldfish.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了入侵性金鱼（Carassius auratus）野生种群与养殖种群在当前（18°C）和近未来（26°C）水温下的生态表现，测定了功能性反应参数（最大摄食率、处理时间）和临界热耐受上限（CTmax）。结果表明，升温驯化后所有种群的摄食率和热耐受性均提高，野生金鱼在两个温度处理下的最大摄食率均高于养殖金鱼，显示其更高的营养级影响潜力，而CTmax无显著种群差异。研究表明温度与种内变异共同影响金鱼的摄食效率，城市和自然池塘中的选择作用可能增强入侵金鱼的生态影响。

papers.authors: Coetzee, Vivienne; Parker, Denham; Lamberth, Stephen; Kerwath, Sven
papers.abstract: Abstract Animal body markings such as spots, stripes and patterns play important roles in camouflage and visual communication. This study investigated phenotypic plasticity in the spot patterns of spotted grunter Pomadasys commersonnii , an estuarine‐dependent haemulid species. First, an aquarium experiment ( n = 24) examined plasticity in spot patterns under contrasting turbidity conditions. P. commersonnii reduced their spot size rapidly and reversibly in response to elevated turbidity, with spots returning close to baseline once clear less turbid conditions were restored, whereas the number and position of spots remained constant throughout the experiment, suggesting that spot patterns may be useful for short‐term individual identification. Second, spot patterns of P. commersonnii ( n = 139) from two estuaries with contrasting turbidities were compared. After accounting for body size, fish from the less turbid Breede Estuary had more numerous spots than those from the turbid Kei Estuary and accumulated spots more rapidly with growth, whereas spot size did not differ between estuaries. Spots from the Kei Estuary were, however, more elongated and differently orientated and individuals could be assigned to their estuary of origin with 83.5% accuracy on the bases of spot patterning alone. These findings are consistent with the sensory drive hypothesis, whereby individuals adapt their communication systems to local environmental conditions and indicates that spot size responds plastically to current turbidity while spot number reflected a longer‐term, developmentally accumulated difference between estuaries. Although the precise function of these spots remains unknown, environmental variables such as turbidity evidently play an important role in the phenotypic variation of P. commersonnii .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以河口依赖型石鲈科鱼类斑点鸡笼鲳（*Pomadasys commersonnii*）为对象，通过水族箱实验与野外对比，探讨浊度对其斑点表型的可塑性及种群间变异。实验表明，高浊度下个体斑点面积迅速且可逆地缩小，而斑点数量和位置保持恒定，提示斑点模式可用于短期个体识别。对两个浊度差异明显的河口种群比较发现，低浊度Breede河口的个体斑点数量更多、随生长积累更快，高浊度Kei河口的斑点更细长且方向不同，仅凭斑点模式即可83.5%准确判别个体来源河口。结果表明斑点大小对当前浊度呈表型可塑性响应，而斑点数量反映河口间长期发育累积差异，支持sensory drive hypothesis。
